‘Karfe 3:00 na yamma su Abla ne zazzaune akan kujera suna hira, sallamar Little da Prince da ta jine yasa ta d’an d’ago da kanta tana sakin murmushi “ Yaya Little” hararar ta Little yayi yana zama kan kujeran shima , kallan Prince Abla tayi kafun ta furta “ Yaya Prince mai kuma nayi ?” Hannun sa prince ya d’aga mata alamar ba ruwansa, ‘kara kallan Little , Abla tayi cikin marairaice fuska ta furta “ Haba Yaya Little me kuma nayi kake hararata”, shiru ya d’anyi kafun ya furta “ ki taso kawai ki koma part d’in ki , yanzu duk lokacin da mukesan zuwa wajan ki sai mun shigo nan? Kinsan ba masan zuwa nan wajan” cikin Sauri Fanan ta furta “ Haba mana, muma fa munaso ta zauna “ shima kallanta Little yayi kafun ya furta “ Shima can d’in ai zaku iya zuwa ku ganta”, Fanan zata yi magana Abla tayi saurin furta “ Shikenan ku tsaya please, Yaya Little Kayi ha’kuri kaji , kema Fanan kiyi hakuri “, kansa Little ya jinjina mata kafun ya mi’ke tsaye “ Wait a minutes ina zuwa “, bai jira amsar taba yayi wucewar sa zuwa hanyar fita , prince da ya fahimci abunda Little zai yi kawai zai ya ‘kyal’kyale da dariya ba tare da yace komai ba , gabaki d’aya su Eshaal basu fahimci dariyar da yake ba shiyasa suka share zancan little . Kusan mintuna 5 da faruwan hakan sukaji sallamar Little , Fanan ce ta fara d’ago da kanta zatayi magana idanuwanta suka sauka akan Simba da yake gefen Little , a rud’e ta furta “ Wa innahu min sulaimana wa innahu Bismillahir rahmanir rahim , me idanuwa na suke nuna mun ko na makance ne ?”, jin yadda Fanan take surutu ne yasa Baby da Eshaal suka d’ago kawu nan su , a rud’e Baby ta saka ‘kara tana dira daga kan kujera , Eshaal kuwa mutuwar tsaye tayi sabida rud’u, Abla tana ganin yadda suka tsorata ne yasa ta kalli Simba da Little , cikin marairaice wa ta furta “ Haba Yaya Little basu sanshi ba, Kasan dole su tsorata “, Little bai amsa mata ba sai shafa kan Simba da yayi , a kujera Simba yayi kansu, suma basu tsaya  ba suka soma gudu a falourn suna tsalle,sabida rud’u Baby har ‘ko’karin hawa flower vez tayi , ganin bala’in ba me tsayawa bane ta fara haki “ Dan Allah kayi hakuri , kai Wana irin mugu ne wai ? Mai mukai maka da zaka sako mana wannan halittar ? To Wallhi kai da Allah dan zan ha’kura wahalar dani da kayi ba “ dariya Little ya saki kafin yayi ‘karamun fito, gadan gadan Simba ya soma nufo Baby itama tace ‘kafa mai naci ban baki ba ? Tunda ta saka gudu bata san inda take takawa ba har ta fice daga part d’in , sai a lokacin Simba ya juyo saitin su Eshaal , itama sai faman had’a zufa take , hannayenta biyu ta had’e masa alamar ro’ko “Dan Allah kayi hakuri  mana , Maine ne abun d’aukar zafi da saka sako mana zaki ? Haba mana dan Allah”, Fanan kuwa sabida ‘kuluwa kasa magana tayi sai hararar da take bin Little dashi , ‘kugu Little ya ri’ke kafun ya furta “ an ina Lil zata zauna ?”, cikin Sauri Eshaal ta furta “ part d’inta “, mai da kallansa kan Fanan da ta sha’ki takaici yayi” A ina zata zauna ?” Wani irin harara Fanan ta jefa masa , a zuciye ta furta “ A nan zata zauna sai muga ta yadda zata koma part d’in”, Little najin haka kuwa ya ‘Kara tsokano musu Simba , a guje Eshaal tayi hanyar fita daga part d’in daidai lokacin da su Bobo zasu shigo suma , cikin saurin Eshaal ta ‘buya a bayan Bobo tana sakin ajiyar zuciya, Fanan kuwa tsabar haushi fad’uwa ’kasa tayi , hararar su Bobo yayi shi yayi shida prince kafun ya furta “ Follow me “ cikin Sauri Prince zai yi magana Bobo ya jefa masu wani kallo shid Little da ya d’an shafa gashin kansa “, Yaya..”.   “ If you dare …”Bobo ya bashi amsa , shiru Little yayi shima yana kallan Simba da yake zagayesa, d’an le’kowa Baby tayi a bayan Sauban da ta ‘buya “ Wallhi Allah sai ya mana hisaba, duk gudu d’aya lada goma , mugu kawai, fuskar ka fara amma zuciyar ka ba’kace kamar Diddigar gawayi “, Fanan kuwa d’an hararar sa tayi tare da barin falour, d’an fito Bobo yayi cikin Sauri Simba ya bar falourn sai a lokacin Eshaal ya fito daga bayan Bobo da ta ‘buya tana sakin ajiyar zuciya , itama Baby sai da ta ‘kara le’kowa ta tabbatar babu Simba tukunna ta fito daga bayan Sauban, ko kallan Sauban batayi ba Sabida bala’I ga idanuwanta da take hararar Little dasu kamar zasu fad’o ’kasa , “ Na gode “ cewar Eshaal tana juyawa , prince da Little kuma bayan Bobo da juya suka bi , shima Sauban Fasa shiga ciki yayi ya bi bayan Bobo.

     Baby bata huce ba ganin Yadda Abla take ‘kumshe dariyar ta “ Zakiyi dariya da kyau ai , tunda kinsan d’an uwan nan naki mugu ne , kinga tafiya ta dan saura kad’an fıtsari ya ‘kwace mun a wando”, tana gama fad’ar hakan tabi bayan Fanan , a kan kujera Eshaal ta zauna kana kallan Abla “ Fanan fa ta sha’ka abunda d’an uwan ki yayi mata muma imani ne kawai ya shiga zuciyar mu “, ‘karamun murmushi Abla ta saki “ Karki damu Eshaal Indai Yaya Little ne zaku saba da wannan halin nashi , yanxu idan nace zan je wajan Fanan ma Baby sai ta sauke mun kwandan bala’in da yake kanta “ ta ‘karasa tana sakin dariya , itama Eshaal dariya ta saki tana tuno yadda Little ya saka su tsere a falour. 
     
     Kiran sallar La’asar da akayi ne Abla ta koma d’akinta , itama Eshaal ta wuce nasu d’akin. Tana shiga kuwa ta tarar da Fanan a gaban mudubi dariya ta saki ta furta “ Amaryar Yaya Little , ku kuma soyayyar taku da tseran zaki ta soma zuwa “, Baby da ta fito daga toilet dariya tayi itama “ kuma wallahi sunyi matching “, tsaki Fanan ta saki tana hararar su , a ‘kufule ta furta “ Allah ya sawa’ke nayi soyayya da yaro, Mtsww ni kun bani haushi ma “, ri’ke ’kugu Baby tayi kafun ta furta “ Ah’ah fa wallahi kar kizo kina mana kukan idan bashi ba sai rijiya , kuma wallahi namiji baya kad’an, tsaf ya aureki zama zakiyi ko kuma ku dunga tsere da zakin ku, Ina dalili “, wani pillow  Fanan ta d’auka ta wullawa Baby, cikin Sauri Baby ta kauce itama “ Oho dai Matar yaro “, cikin jin haushi Fanan ta d’akko pillow zata jefa mata Baby ta ‘kara gocewa a haka suka soma yar tsere a d’akin.

HAJIYA SA’ADATU.

    Zaune take cikin d’akinta sai yarta Yasmeen da wata Mata chocolate colour da ta zo mata , itama da kallo d’aya zakasan ba a wahala take ba , gabaki d’aya kwal ne a jikinta tundaga kan şarka da d’an kunne har zuwa abun ‘kafa da ta saka duk ta kwal ne , bakinta kuwa wani shegen cingum ne take taunawa sai faman bada saurin ‘kas ‘kas yake , ‘kara kallanta Hajiya sa’adatu tayi “ Yaya baki ce komai ba “, yatsina fuska wacce aka kira da Yaya tayi tana ‘kara tauna cingum d’in bakinta , sai da ta gama sham’kamshinta tukunna ta kalli Hajiya Sa’adatu “ Ai ni Sa’a kece kika gama bani mamaki, yanxu duk wata kıssa da kişisina na ‘ya mace baki sani ba? Bakisan yadda zaki ‘kwato wa kanki ‘yancı ba ? Anya ke yar gidan muce kuwa ? Ina bin malam da kike ? Duk a banza ? Ki kalli Yasmeen itama da tabi sahun ki babu wani mashin shini da zai dunga bata kud’i tana watayawa duk yadda take so , abun kunya kike san kwaso mana Sa’a ?” ‘Dan ajiyar zuciya Hajiya ta saki tana kallan yayar ta “ Yaya abun duk ba yadda kike Tunani bane , akwai yaran da yake so Yasmeen ta Aura amma shima shu’umun kansa ne dan ya keta miki rashin mutumci ba wani abu bane a wajan sa , abun takaicin kuma wai har yayi Aure?” Ya tsina fuska Yayar  tata tayi “ Wanene wannan? Dan tun da kika kwallafa rai a kansa ba ‘karamin kud’ine dashi ba “, karaf Yasmeen ta kar’ba zancan “ Aunty ‘Dan Abbu da nake jin labarin su ? Süne da suka dawo kinga yadda suke da kyau Aunty, ga uban kud’i da suke dashi , musamman shegiyar matar sa da yawanci akwai sar’kar Diamond a wuyanta “, dakatawa Yayar Sa’a tayi daga taunar cingum d’in da take tana kallan Sa’a “ me take nufi ban fahimta ba ? Su wanene suka Dawo ? “, hararar Yasmeen, Hajiya Sa’a tayi ta ‘kasan ido kafun ta furta “ Ya.. ya … Yaya dama.. dama “, katseta tayi “Dama me ? Baki da bakin magana ne ko kuwa ?” Ajiyar zuciya ta sauke kad’an kafun ta furta “ Yayan Safreena ne “, da ‘karfi matar nan ta dafe ‘kirjinta “ Safreena fa kika ce ? Tabd’ijan Tashin hankali yana tunkaro wasu kenan “ sai kuma ta ‘kyal’kyale da dariya , kallan rashin fahimta Hajiya Sa’a tayi mata musamman data ga tana ‘ko’karin mi’kewa tsaye “ Ina zaki je kuma Yaya ?” Ba tare da Yayar ta kalleta ba ta furta “ matsalar ki ‘karama ce akan hutar guguwar da nake hango wa nan gama , zamuyi waya “. Ta ‘karasa tana d’aukar wayarta , wata number tayi dialing kafun ta furta “ Hello Hajiya ?” Da haka ta bar d’akin ta bar su Hajiya da sakin baki.

WASHE GARI

  Kiran Sallar asuba da akai ne ya farkar da Abla daga bacci da take , a hankali ta zame jikinta tana kallan kyakkyawar face d’insa sai kuma ta kalli jikinta , lokaci d’aya ta zabura zata mi‘ke ya ri’ko mata hannunta “ Becareful “, ya fad’a a hankali yana bud’e idanuwansa da suka lumshe , itama Abla cike da shagwa’ba ta soma kare ‘kirjinta ganin babu riga a jikinta , murmushi kawai yayi yana tashi zaune , bai ce mata komai ba ya sa’beta zuwa toilet , cikin kunnanta ya rad’a mata “ Na riga naga komai ai “, a haka ya ‘karasa toilet da su .
  
  Basu dad’e a ciki ba suka fito ynzu ma tana hannunsa ko wannan su cikin whiterub da alama wanka sukai, hannayenta gabaki d’aya yana zagaye a wuyanta har ya sauketa akan Bed d’insa , a goshi ya d’anyi mata peck “ Good Morning Sweetheart “, cewar Abla , shima a hankali ya furta “ Morning too Baby”, da haka ya saketa yana komawa hanyar da ya fito sabida Kiran sallar da ake, bai d’auki dogon lokaci ba ya shirya cikin wani ash din jallabiya me shegen kyau , itama Abla mi’kewa tsaye tayi tana kallansa “ kına san guduwa ko ?” Sunkuyar da kanta tayi tana wasa da ‘yan yatsunta, bai ce mata komai ba ya koma inda ya fito cikin ‘kan’kanin lokaci ya dawo d’auke da coat d’insa , da ta saka har kasa ta sakko mata , hannunta ya kama yanxu , ta hanyar da suka biyo jiya ta suka bi , kuma sosai ta gane hanyar itama , yana kai ta d’akin ya koma nashi part d’in sabida sallah da ake ‘ko’karin tayarwa. 

********
✨✨✨✨✨

‘Karfe 7 Abla ta koma baccin ta dan sosai take jin bacci ga yunwa da take ji a lokaci d’aya amma duk da hakan sai da ta koma baccin nata , baccin baiyi wani nisa sosai ba ta soma jin ‘kamshi kamar na abinci , ba shiri Abla ta bud’e idanuwanta , Big Boss ta gani hannunsa d’auke da wani plate , “ You’re Hungry right ?” Da Sauri Abla ta jinjina masa kai tana mi’kewa zaune , Akan table me zaman mutum biya ya ajje plate din kafun ya mi’kar da ita , da kansa ya bata abincin , ba musu kuwa ta soma ci dan sosai take jin yunwa , tana gama ci tasha Youghurt d’inta tare da jingina a jikinsa , bata d’auki dogon 2 minutes ba bacci ya d’auke ta . Shi kansa sai da yayi mamakin baccin ta , a hankali ya d’auke ta zuwa kan bed ya kwantar da ita bayan ya rage mata hasken fitila zuwan mara haske sosai . 

~~~~~

  Ina kike shirin zuwa ? Sau nawa zan ja miki kunne ? Cewar Momy Baby , ga Amma dage tsaye ta sunkuyar da kai tana bawa Momy hakuri , amma Momyn ta’ki saurararta bayan masifarta da take ta kurma mata kamar wacce zata duke ta , a har zu’ke ta cigaba da magana “ Karki manta ke ba kowa bace face ‘kas’kantacciyar baiwar da zan iya saka hannu na taka duk yadda nake so , banza ‘kazamar baiwa kawai , ko kusa kar na ‘kara ganin ki a kusa da wani na cikin gidan nan , hatta waje ban baki izinin zuwa ba, ki tsaya a matsayin ki na baiwa, daga kitchen sai abunda ya shafi bauta sune Suka dace da ke , wannan ne karo na ‘karshe da zan ja miki kunne “, cewar Momy tana bin Amma da wani irin banzan kallo , murmushi Amma tayi kafin ta furta “ kiyi ha’kuri Hajiya “, tsaki Momy taja ta nufi hanyar barin d’akin , da gangan ta sakawa Amma ‘kafa da har Saida ta kusa fad’uwa ’kasa . 

******
**********

Little da Prince ne suka shigo falourn su Didi , Daidai lokacin da su Fanan suka fito suma kamar had’in baki . Had’e fuskarta  Fanan tayi zata juya yayi saurin ‘kara sowa inda take “ Menene kuma ? Am sorry jiya Simba da na kawo muku baya cizo fa ?”, yanzu ma share sa Fanan tayi zata wuce Little ya furta “ wallahi idan baki tsaya ba har cikin d’akin zan biki, jiya har ran’kwashina yayi fa , you guys should told her naa “, yana kallan su Baby , itama Baby duk da jiya ya bata haushi yanxu sai taji bata jin haushin nasa , sai ma kannewa Eshaal ido, ‘kara ‘bata fuska Fanan tayi tana tsayawa “Mai zan maka ? Bayan abunda kayi mana ?kai da Allah “, zata soma tafiya shima ya ‘kara tafiya “ Nace fa kiyi hakuri or else na kira Yaya Big Boss , kuma idan na fad’a masa dukan mu zai yi punishing “, shiru Fanan tayi masa kafun ta furta “ kalli can “, yana juyawa kuwa ta arta a guje zuwa d’aki , mai su Baby zasuyi kuwa ban da dariya , cike da tsokana Baby ya furta “ Anya ba san Fanan kake ba ?” Kallanta Little yayi da mamaki kafun ya furta “ Zaki bani itane ?” Kanta Baby ta jinjinq masa alamar “ eh “ hannu d’aya Little ya jinjina mata “ Yawwa daga yau kece partner dina , yanzu zamuje training , idan na dawo zamuyi magana , Okay ?” Bai jira cewar taba ya bar part d’in sabida jiranshi da prince yake . “ Lalle Baby , ke yar duniya ce , wato har kin bawa Yaya Little , Fanan ?” ‘Karasowa Baby tayi kusa da Eshaal “ Nifa wallahi sai na had’asu bari ma na fad’a miki, dan ni ba Wanda nake so ya aura sai ita , bari ma kiga tun yanzu na soma aiki na “, ta fad’a tana nufar ‘kofar d’akin su .


✨✨✨✨✨✨

‘Karfe 11am na safe Abla ta farka daga baccin da take , ganin baya cikin  d’akin ne yasa ta shirya cikin wata fitted d’in atampa da yayi matu’kar yi mata kyau, man le’be ta saka a bakinsa sai faman shinning yake ga d’ankwalin da ta d’aura sai ta fita daban Sabida bata saba yi ba amma duk da hakan ba ‘karamun kyau kayan sukai mata ba , murmushi Abla tayi sabida suprised din da take san yi masa , turarukan ta ta faffesa a jiki sannan ta sakko zuwa hanyar da Big Boss ya biyo da ita , jiya , da ‘kyar ta iya gane hanyar har zuwa part d’insu . Bata zauna cikin falourn ba ta nufi kitchen , sai da ta had’a masa favorite coffee d’insa tukunna ta nufi hanyar d’akinsa  bakinta d’auke da sallama, kanta a ‘kasa har ta shigo falourn , d’aga kan da zatayi ne idanuwanta suka sauka akan Harry da take sanye cikin wata yar iska riga da alama ‘ko’karin cirewa take sanyi , cikin tsananin ‘bacin rai Abla tayi wurgi da coffee d’in hannunta , a Daidai lokacin da Big Boss ya fito daga dressing room d’inta . Idanuwan Abla a rufe ta ‘karasa inda Harry take , da hannayenta biyu ta d’aga ta tsitstsinka mata mari , bata tsaya a hakan ba ta sha’ke mata wuyanta, babu abunda jikin Harry yake sai rawa ga wani irin waro ido da tayi sabida mugun shakar da Abla tayi mata, gefe d’aya ga wani mugun kallo da Big Boss ya jefa mata da taji wani irin gudawa na ‘ko’karin ’kwace mata.

Tunda Abla ta sha’keta take ka’kari kamar wacce ranta zai fita, ran Abla sosai ya ‘baci babu abunda takewa Harry sai maruka da take tsits tsinka mata, Big Boss na tsaye ko uffan bai ce musu ba, gashi kuma babu alamun zai yi maganar, wani Wawan mari da Abla tayi wa Harry sai da tayi ha’bo, jini ya soma fita ga hancin ta, Abla kuma bata da alamar sakin nata, a hankali ya soma nufo inda suke, da hannu d’aya ya saka ya ri’ke nata tare da dawo da ita kusa dashi, Harry na ganin hakan ko Hijab d’in da ta shigo dashi bata d’auka a guje ta zo fita yadda Abla ta zabura zata dam’kota sai da Big Boss ya tallafo ta cikin Sauri.
     Harry kuwa cikin tsananin tashin hankali da rud’u ta fito a guje daga part d’in, a maimakon ta nufi part d’in su sai ta güdü zuwa nasu His Excellency, a tunaninta anan ne Kawai zata iya tsira, ga wani irin tsoro da shakar Abla da yashiga cikin zuciyar ta.

****** A d’an zuciye Abla ta jiyo tana ‘ko’karin ’kwace ri’kon da Big Boss yayi mata, amma ya ‘ki sakin hannun nata , sai bin kyakkyawar face d’inta da ta had’e yake da kallo, a d’an ‘kufule Abla ta furta “ Ni ka sakar mun hannu na”, a maimakon ya sakar mata hannun sai ‘kara janyo ta da yayi jikinsa, cikin rarrashi ya furta “ Sunshine!” ‘Kara tsuke fuska Abla tayi har lokacin tana san ‘kwace hannunta daga ri’kon da yayi mata , “ Hey Sunshine , Rigima , come here “, ya fad’a yana hugging d’inta , cikin muryarta kamar zatayi kuka ta 'kara furta “ Nidai ka sakeni na tafi “, ta fad’a tana ‘kwace jikinta daga hugging d’in da yayi mata , a zuciye ta juya zata bar d’akin ya ri’ko ta , lokaci d’aya Abla kamar me aljanu ta soma kokawar ‘kwacewa amma Big Boss ya ‘ki sakinta , ganin abun nata na ‘ko’karin yin worst ne yasa ya d’auketa gabaki d’aya ya kwantar da ita akan gadon da , sai da ya ri’ke sosai tukunna ta dena motsu mutsun da take , cikin ‘kan’kanin lokaci ta fara masifa , yadda take masifar nan mutum sai yayi mamakinta, hatta Big Boss kallanta kawai yake yana ‘boye murmushin da yake san kwace masa , “ It’s okay , Matar Oumar Farooq , nace fa Sorry huh? Bakin ki zai miki ciwo fa , kinga it’s okay am yours and Only , wannan duka da kikai haka ? Aushe dai matar soja ,soja ce “, turo baki Abla tayi tare da juya masa baya , juyo da face d’inta Big Boss yayi ganin yadda ta shagwa’be ta “ Wannan matar tawa akwai ta da kishi ba” d’an murgud’a bakinta Abla tayi tare da furta “ Ni babu ruwa na da kai , mun kwance “ ta fad’a kamar wata ‘karamar yarinya , eyes d’insa Big Boss ya d’an bud’e kad’an , a hankali cikin zuciyarsa ya furta“ Rigimammiya “, sai kuma ya ‘Kara kallanta ganin yadda ta kulle idanuwanta a dole bazata kulashi ba . Shima shiru yayi mata baice komai ba sai dogon gashin manta me santsin gaske da yake shafawa, kusan tsawan mintuna biyar yana abu d’aya , ajiyar zuciyar da ta soma ne ya dawo dashi daga duniyar tunaninta , mamakinsu fall ya kamasa kwana biyun nan ya Lura bacci baya mata wahala duk lokacin da ta kwanta sai tayi bacci . Bai kawo komai a ransa ba ya gyara mata kwanciyar tata duk da ya fara wası wasin baccin da yake kwana biyu , ‘karamin iska ya fesar a bakinsa tare da lullu’beta da duvet d’insa mai shegen laushin. Lokaci d’aya kuma ya had’e ransa kamar bai ta’ba dariya ba ‘karamun lips d’insa ya taune kad’an tare da shiga dressing room d’insa , bai d’auki wani dogon lokaci ba ya fito tare da barin d’akin bayan ya rage mata hasken d’akin.

Direct part d’in ya bari yana fitowa Victor da Anthony suka ‘karaso Inda yake a tsaye , agogon hannun sa ya kalla kafun ya d’an lumshe eyes d’insa , cikin Husky voice d’insa ya furta “ Bring her here “. Sun gane wa yake nufi sabida akan idanuwansu Harry ta fito daga part d’in a har gitse , cike da tsantsan girmamawar da suke masa suka sara masa tare da nufar hanyar part d’in His Excellency. 

         Harry kuwa tun data shiga part d’in His Excellency ta ra’be a ‘kasa jikinta sai faman karkarwa yake gabaki d’aya hannayenta ta d’ora aka kamar me shirin saka ihu. Shigowar su Victor da ta gani ne yasa ta saki ‘karamun ‘kara a guje ta haura stairs , ko takan elevator bata biba ta ruga a guje, duk uban stairs din nan haka ta dinga tsallake su har ta nufi falourn da tasan zata samesu. Ko sallama batayi ba sai ganin ta sukai a har gitse ta fad’o d’akin babu Wanda bai mi’ke ba sai His Excellency da yake kishingid’e a kan kujera, Uncle ne ya kalleta da mamaki “ Harira Menene haka babu ko sallama me ya same ki?”, a rud’e Harry ta furta “ Uncle please help me ni babu abunda nayi musu Suka biyoni suna duka na,” sai kuma ta juya şaitin Dadyn ta da ya mi’ke shima “Dady please kuce su rabu dani”, ajje cups d’in hannunsa His Excellency yayi kafun ya furta “ Me kikai musu?” Kuka ta fashe dashi ko kunyar ‘karyar da take bataji “ Babu abunda nayi musu Abbu , Wallhi babu abunda nayi musu”, shigowar su Victor ne yasa Abbu kallansu , tun kafin yayi magana cike da girmamawa suka sara masa “ Mai yasa kuka biyo ta ?” Victor ya amsa masa “Umarnin Big Boss ne “,   “ Me tayi masa ? “, a yanxu Anthony ne ya bashi amsa “ Sir we don’t actually know , he just give us an order “, wani kuka Harry ta fashe dashi tana girgiza kai , d’an shiru His Excellency yayi suma su Uncle ba suce komai ba sabida shirin da Abbu yayi , daga sama tayi muryar sa “ Follow them “ ai Harry na jin hakan ta mi’ke tsaye gabaki d’aya sun d’auka binsu zatayi sai kuma ta ‘kara saka wani gudun ta bar wajan suma su Victor suka bi bayanta , Uncle ne ya kalli His Excellency” bari na duba “ yana fad’an hakan ya bi bayansu Dadyn ta kuwa babu abunda yace.

   Harry ta na fitowa part d’in su Mamy ta nufa  güdü lokacin gabaki d’aya suna zaune a falourn har su Fanan da Momyn Harry sai ganin ta kawai sukai, Mamy ce ta furta “ Subhanallahi Me nake gani haka Harira ?” Cikin Sauri Harry ta ‘karaso wajan ta tana furta “ Mamy wallahi babu abunda nayi musu “, kallan ta Baby tayi tana ta’be baki “ Daga ganin ki ruwan munafukai ne dake “, ta fad’a cikin zuciyarta ,ita Eshaal tsoro ma ta bata data ga shigowar ta , Mamy kuwa da Momy Harry sai faman tanbayar ta suke me ya faru amma ta kasa magana sai furta “ Babu abunda nayi musu “ take . 

******** Victor da Anthony kuwa basu bita part d’in ba ganin Big Boss da kanshi ya nufo part d’in sai suka taka masa baya , yana shiga part d’in ba Harry da ta nemo bala’in ba hatta su Fanan sai da suka shiga taitayinsu dan suna bala’in tsoran sa musamman da suka ga baya fara’a kwata kwata , yanzu ma babu fara’ar a fuskar sa , har su Didi
Sai da suka kallesa ganin yau babu M a tattare dashi , cikin Sauri Harry ta ‘boye a bayan Mamy , Daidai lokacin da M.Sarah take shigowa falourn bayanta kuma su Little ne . “ Belt “, ya fad’a da kakkausar murya , Victor ne ya cire belt d’insa na sojoji ya mi’ka masa , bai amsa ba sai ‘kara furta “ Belt “ da yayi , shima Anthony nashi belt d’in ya ciro ya had’e da na Victor , su Little suna ganin haka sukayi reverse a maimakon su shigo sukayi saurin komawar su . “ Sarah “, Big Boss ya fad’a cikin Husky voice d’insa , da Sauri Sarah ta amsa da “ Yes Boss “ tana kar’ban belt din “ beat her off “, ya fad’a har lokacin babu Wanda ya kalla , Su Mamy ne suka zaro ido “ Waza a doka ? Ban fahimta ba ?”, nufo inda Harry take M.Sarah tayi , itama da Sauri ta ja baya cike da tsoro, Babu Wanda Sarah ta kalla ta Julawa Harry belt din nan , cikin tsananin azaba ta gantsare itama tana sakin ihu , tun kafin Mamy suyi magana ma Sarah ta dunga lafta mata belt din nan , babu Wanda baiyi da Sarah ta daka tava amma takı tsayawa , hatta Big Boss tun Mamy na fad’a har ta dawo lallashin amma gabaki d’aya yayi buruş dasu , Uncle bai ce masa komai ba sai Bobo da Sauban da ya kira , suna zuwa ganin abunda yke faruwa suka soma lallashin sa amma gabaki d’aya ya mayar dasu yan iska , ganin yadda Sarah ta soma fasawa Harry jiki ne su His Excellency suka shigo part d’in , da ‘kyar Dadyn su Baby da Uncle suka lallashe sa , izuwa lokacin Harry ko hannunta bata d’aga wa sai kuka da take faman rerawa , cikin muryar sa ta izza yasa Sarah ta kulleta a d’aki me duhu, duk Wanda yayi magana muku yasa a ‘kara mata kwana biyu akan kwana ukun da yace zatayi , gabaki d’aya sai aka rasa mai bakin magana dan tsaf Big Boss zai aikata abunda yace d’in. Bai jira kowa ba yayi ficewarsa zuwa part d’in sa . Lokacin Abla ta farka daga baccin da take jikinta sanye da wani shirt d’insa da ya kusa kawo mata gwiwa , ido d’aya ya kashe mata kamar bashine ya gama tsare gıda ba , ita kuma ta turo ‘karamun bakinta tana furta “ Welcome Sunshine “, ta kowa yayi zuwa inda take kafun ya furta “ Mun shirya aiko ? No more fushi ko?” ‘Dan ya mutsa fuskarta Abla tayi tana girgixa masa kai “- ni ban shirya da kai ba , kuma ai na fad’a maka babu ruwana da kai bari ma na koka can part d’in na dena zuwa nan “, hannun ta Big Boss ya kama “ Babu Inda zaki ‘kara komawa ba , ina da mata ace za’a Mayar dani d’an iska , na gama magana babu Inda zaki koma “, sakin baki Abla tayi jin abunda yace , zatayi magana ya d’auke fuskar sa daga Side d’insa , cikin Sauri ta jiyo ‘bangaran da yake “ please! please ! Haba Sunshine d’in Abla , zan dawo fa “, kansa ya girgiza mata alamar a’ah , cikin marairaice fuska ta furta “ please Sunshine , I promise duk lokacin da kake nema na zanzo kaji please Sunshine , please “. Ta fad’a tana d’an yin d’age hannuwanta kuma ta zagaye wuyansa da shi har saida ya ran kafo da fuskarsa , goshinsa ta soma kısa kafin tayi kissing kumatunsa tana furta “ Please Sunshine “, da ‘kyar ya yadda zata koma shima kuma sai dai ta dunga kwana anan wajan , bata da za’bin da ya wuce ta amince masa , shiyasa kawai ta amince da hakan.  Bata güdü part d’in suba sai da ta tabbatar ya shiga wanka sannan ta güdü ta Inda ya nuna mata jiya , tana shiga d’aki kuwa ko zama batayi ba su Eshaal sukai knocking kofar ta , kallan jikinta tayi ganin shirt d’insa ne a jikinta , hijab din sallar ta tayi saurin zunbulawa ganin an ‘kara knocking, kamar me baccin gaske ta ‘bata fuskarta kafin ta bud’e musu ‘kofar. 

    Tana bud’ewa Baby tayi hugging d’inta tana dariya , d’an zaro ido Abla tayi tana binta da kallo , girgiza kanta Eshaal tayi “ wallahi Baby Allah ya shiryeki duk wani kan mugunta kin fi kyauri a Wajan “ wani dariyar Baby ta kusa sakawa tana kallan Abla da take binta da idanuwa itama “ Ni wallahi abunda yayi ba ‘karamun burgeni yayi ba , kina ganin ta kinga mai Zubin ba’kin hali wallahi “, Abla bata gane kan zan cansu ba har saida suka zauna “ Wai akan wa kuke magana ne ?” Kallanta sukai gabaki d’aya da mamaki ganin bata san abunda ya faru ba , Baby ce ta furta “ Wallahi bikin duka akayi a gidan nan , ni ban ta’ba ganin irin dukan nan ba wallahi , ni Wallhi na jinjina miki da kike tare da mijin ki bai fasa miki kai ba “, ‘karamin tsaki Abla tayi yana kallan su Fanan “ Mai ya faru ?” Gabaki d’aya abunda ya faru Fanan ta zayyane mata har d’akin duhun da ya saka a kulleta , ‘karamun ajiyar zuciya kawai ta saki cikin zuciyar ta kuwa babu abunda ta furta sai “ Weldone my Sunshine “.
    
      “Tunanin me kike ?” Cewar Eshaal , girgiza mata kai Abla tayi “ No babu komai bari na shirya sai mu sauka yau muyi girki ko ?”, kanta Eshaal ta jinjina mata “ Good idea “, ta shi Abla tayi ta d’auki abunda take bu’kata ta bar wajan , bata fi 5 minutes ba ta fito cikin doguwar material ba’ka plain da babu ko a do a jikinta . Gabaki d’aya sai suka sakko ‘kasa gwanin ban sha’awa suna tafiya suna hirar su , Arwa suka tarar a falourn ciki shigarta itama ga baki d’aya tsayawa sukai suna mata magana banda Abla da tayi kamar bata san taba itama tayi wucewar ta , d’an d’ago fuskarta Arwa tayi ta kalli hanyar da Abla tabi da kallo yanayin fuskarta na canzawa , Eshaal ce kawai ta fahimci hakan shiyasa fuskarta cike da murmushi ta furta “ Girki zamuyi ki taso kema muke tare kar ki zauna ke kad’ai anan wajan “, murmushi Arwa tayi mata tana furta “ Toh “, gabaki d’aya sai suka nufi kitchen din har da harwa , sai da kowa ya fad’i ra’ayinsa akan food din da za’ayi kafun su tsayar da magana d’aya , har lokacin kuma Abla bata kalli ko inda Arwa take ba . 
      
      Fanan ce ta kallesu “ I’m coming bari na d’auko wayana “, tana fad’an hakan ta fito daga kitchen zuwa falourn su , zata nufi d’aki taga Little a tsaye da alama yanzu ya shigo dan ko zama bai yi ba , ganin Fanan da yayi ne yasa ya saki murmushi sosai , ita kuma Fanan hararar sa tayi zata wuce yayi saurin ‘karasowa inda take “ Wai har yanzu haushina kike ji ? Nace fa am sorry bansan zakuji haushi ba , kuma matata zaki zama fa , Baby ta bani ke fa” wani irin harara Fanan ta jefa masa kamar idanuwanta zasu fad’o ’kasa “ Allah ya kiyaye ya auri yaro “ kallanta Little yayi kafun ya furta “ Nine yaro ? Ban girme kiba ? PRISON

A lokacin da Nani take wani irin ‘baccin wahala a lokacin ta soma jin kamar ana mata d’an kira a kunne , ‘kara kiran sunanta da akai ne yasa ta farka a firgice amaimakon sunanta ya ambaci tsarkakakke abun tsarkakewa sai bakinta ya buge da anbatan shed’anin bokanta sindilu. Shid’inne ya bayayyana a gabanta , sabida razani Nani sai da ta ja baya gabanta na dukan uku uku, shima Sindilu ita ya soma bi da idanuwansa da suka rine zuwa ja , kamar wanda aka sha’kewa ma’kogaro ya furta “ kinyin şaken da guguwa ta tashi alokacin da ba’a mu’katarta , jinin da nake gudun had’uwa suna dafff da had’uwa kamar yadda nayi hasashen bayyanar jini, cikin rashin sani taurarin da nake san dakushewa süne suka karya duk wani abun jin dad’i na , cikin ‘kan’kanin lokacin an karyamun ko wana ikona a cikin ‘yan da’ki ‘ka zan koma asalin halitta da aka Mayar dani, kamar yadda ‘karshena yazo ba tare da sani ba kema
‘Karshen ki yana kusu ba tare da kin fargaba, lokaci na ya ‘kare , ta bud’e kwad’an da ya kulle jinin su , bud’ewarsu kuma shine rugujewar tamu rayuwar, “ Sindilu ya ‘karasa yana wani irin abu, itama Nani tsumar zaune tayi kamar wacce zuciyarta take ‘ko’karin bugawa , wani irin ba’kin jinine ya soma fitowa Sindilu, kamar wani zautaccen mahaukaci haka ya dunga wasu irin abubuwa mai firgitarwa da buga zuciyar mai imani, gabaki d’aya abun sai ya koma na Al’ajabi, yadda Sindilu yake abu sai ya girgixa zuciyar me imani ya ‘kara sakawa zuciyarsa tsoran Allah, cikin mintuna kad’an Jikin Sindilu ya soma d’ayewa kamar wanda ake watsawa tafashash shen ruwan zafi, kamannunsa suka ji gaba da rikid’a zuwa suffar gizo gizo ,Ba a ‘kara minti biyu ba ya fashe tare da ko mawa wani irin bakin haya’ki , yana komawa kuma wannan ba’kin haya’kin ya shige idanuwan Nani da ya zamo babban nakasu a rayuwarta ta har abada , kifewa Nani tayi a wajan kamar wacce zuciyarta ta buga dan ko nunfashi batayi. 

       Ko wana azzalumi akwai ranar sakayya kamar yadda Sindilu duk ‘karfin tsafin tsafin sa ya koma ‘karamar halitta cikin ‘kudurar ubangiji, irin halittar da yaro ‘karamı xai take ta . Duk zalincin sa da tsafin sa ya kasa ku’butar da kansa daga kalar azababbiyar azabar da yasha , kafun yace wajen mai hisabi. Wanda ko wannan sassa zai fad’i abunda ya aikata bayan ka tafi da littafinka a tafin hannunka.

UNITED STATE

Tunda Big Boss ya saka a mayar dasu ‘kauye suke ganin rayuwa ga tsofaffin mutanan nan da suka saka su a gaba, hatta wanki da guga su sukeyi da kansu, gabaki d’aya sai suka dawo kamar bayi, idan tsohuwar nan zatayi bacci sai ta saka d’ayar ma’kociyarta gadin su bayan ta başu sharar kan titi. FIFTH AVENUE 

    Tana kwance a jikinsa da alama bacci ne ya d’auketa a hakan, bayan babban duvet da ya lullu’be jikinsu dashi, wani d’an ‘karamun sauti ya fito daga cikin wayarta sa kamar zai share sai kuma ya janyo wayar, kallan message d’in yayi tare da mayar da kallansa side d’inta ganin baccinta take hankali kwance , a hankali yayi ‘ko’karin kwantar da ita gefe amma sai ta ‘kara ri’kesan, har lokacin bacci take ga face d’inta data ya mutsa ,” Sleeping Beauty” ya fad’a a hankali tare da kaiwa forehead d’inta kiss , d’an motsawa ta sake yi kamar zata farka amma bata farka d’in ba , a karo na biyu ya sake ‘ko’karin kwantar da ita, yanzu kuma kamar wacce idanuwanta suke a bud’e ta d’aure face d’inta , hakan da tayi ba ‘karamun dariya taso sashi ba , “ Rigiman ki har a bacci ko?let’s me go bazan jima ba zan dawo kinji” ya d’an rad’a mata a kunne , duk da bashi da tabbas tajishin amma a haka ya zame jikinsa a hankali yana ‘kara gyara mata kwanciyarta akan lallausan gadonsa . Bai wani jima sosai da fita ba ita kuma ta farka bakinta d’auke da addua, Side d’insa ta soma kalla taga bayanan, d’an ’bata fuska tayi kamar zatayi kuka , sai kuma ta sakko daga Bed d’inta tana d’aukar wayanta , missed called d’in su Baby ta gani rututu akan wayar ta , murmushi ta saki sai da taje ta kwance face d’inta tukunna ta kira Baby da tagani online , a hakan tana jiyo sautin ihun su Baby, “Maman Unborn yau gabaki d’aya mun jiki shiru ko kin fara labour mu Kawo a gaji? Kinsan idan za kishiga labour tare zamu shiga naga ta inda d’an zai fito, danni mai sau’ki zanyi guda uku zanyi lokaci d’aya”, harararta Abla taki kasancewar vidoe call suke yi “ ke fa dad’i na dake wani lokacin yar iska ce , keçe zaki haihu yan uku ajere ? Kiyashi zaki haifa ko cinnaka?” Ya tsine  fuska Baby tayi “ Ke dai kika sani wallhi dan labour d’innan fa tare zamu shigesa, toh wai Babies d’in mai zaki dunga basu , madarar da muke sha ko kuma ..” kittt Abla ta kashe kiranta jin iskancin Baby ya fara yawa , so take tayi masa abinci da kanta amma kuma ya hanata gashi batasan ‘bacin ransa , kamar yasan tunaninsa take a lokacin sai ga message d’insa ya shigo wayar “ I warn you again , karki shiga kitchen , just tell me what you want , I love you .” Shine message d’in da ya shigo wayar nata tare da wasu flowers red da love da ya tutturo mata , murmushi Abla tayi tun kafun tayi masa reply sai ga kiransa ya shigo wayar ta , a shagwa’be ta amsa kiran, murmushi Big Boss yayi daga cikin wayar “ I will be back soon, me Baby na take san ci?” Tsayawa Abla tayi kamar me tunani sai kuma ta furta “ Fara..” cike da mamaki Big Boss ya furta “ What? Mene ne shi?” ‘Yar ‘karamar dariya Abla tayi dan zata so taga reaction d’in face d’insa “ Fara fa nace maka , grasshopper “, ‘bata face Big Boss yayi “ you’re not okay Babe , grasshopper? My wife ? My Baby? I will be back soon, don’t enter kitchen , anything you want Sunshine ?” Kamar yana ganin ta , ta jinjina kanta sai kuma ta furta “ Yes I need something “ kai tsaye Big Boss ya furta “ Mene ne ?” Shiru Abla tayi masa , sai kuma ta furta “ My husband, My Sunshine nayi missing d’insa “, ko bata fad’a ba tasan murmushi yake a lokacin “ I Love you wifey “ shine abunda ya shigo kunnanta, itama murmushin tayi kafun ta bashi amsa da “I Love You Too My Sunshine , Take care , ni da Babyn mu yana jiran dawowar ka , in kuma ka dad’e zamuyi fushi”,  “ I won’t , Love you “ daga wayar ya d’anyi mata kiss itama Abla ta Mayar masa da martani, basu wani dad’e sosai ba ya kashe wayar , kamar tana gabansa ta kulle fuskarta, soyayyar mijinta na ‘kara shiga ko wana sassa na jikinta . 
****
A ‘bangaran Big Boss kuwa Daidai lokacin da suka zo Prison d’in da su Nani suke , fuskarsa sanye take cikin face mask ‘baki ga facing cap d’aya rufemasa wajan idanuwansa , sai gashin kansa da ya Fito sosai ta baya ba’ki’kin a mummurd’e sai shinning suke , tunda ya shiga Prison d’in mahaikatar ta ‘Kara shiga taitayinta musamman sojojin da da Suka kewaye cikin prison d’in, ga senior d’in Prison d’in da suke binsa a baya har zuwa wani ‘kayataccen office da ya gaji da had’uwa . Akan d’aya daga cikin kujerun ya zauna tare da crossing legs d’inşa , p-cap d’insa kansa kawai ya cire duk da bai cire facemask d’in fuskar saba zaka ga yadda  ya had’e girar sa sosai alamar ba mutumci. Ko mintuna 2 bai yi ba aka shigo da Momy da kwanakin da tayi a cikin prison gabaki d’aya ya canza mata kamammi, sosai jigata da wahala ya bayyana a fuskarta , ga idanuwa da take zarowa kamar wacce taci babu, duk da bata ga fuskar ko wanene ba , lokaci d’aya tsoro da shakkar sa ya shiga zuciyarta, tun kafin a bata umarnin zama ta zauna a ‘kasa tana had’iyar wani abu da ya toshe mata ma’koshi , gabaki d’aya soldiers d’in fita sukai yayi saura daga Big Boss sai ita , sai da ya d’auki good 5 minutes a zaune kafun ya d’ago da rinannun idanuwansa yana zuba mata wani irin kallo da lokaci d’aya taji fitsari na ‘ko’karin kwace mata , a kausashe ya furta “ tanbaya d’aya zan miki, idan kika kuskura kika mun ‘karya, you will regret it for the rest of your life “, sai kuma ya ‘karayin shiru kusan tsawan mintina biyu “ Mai isa kika aikata hakan?” Wani irin zufa da gumuni ya soma tsats tsafo mata , kallan da ya jefa mata yasa wani irin tsoran sa na ‘kara tasiri a jikinta , kukan da yake san ‘kwace mata ta danne “ Ba laifi na bane laifin shed’an ne, wallahi bansan mai ya faru ba ,kira na akai a waya sannan aka bani umarnin na aikata hakan, idan ba haka ba zasu kashe..” wani kallo da ya jefa mata yasa tayi saurin jaaa baya “ wallahi zan fad’a , zan fad’i gaskiyar.Tun bayan aure na da Alhaji Adam da sati biyu na dena jin dad’in gidan Sabida Amata, abu kad’an maganar sa zaice mun tana da kirki da dattako, kusan kullum sai ya yabeta a gabana shiyasa haushi da tsanarta suka dunga ta siri a cikin zuciya ta duk da tun lokacin da nashigo gidan ba santa take ba, a fili a gaban kowa sai na nuna ina santa , amma a zahiri babu wacce na fi tsana sama da ita , a komai ta fiki, a komai Itace a gaba , ana cikin hakan sai ta samu ciki, hakan ba ‘karamun tayar mun da hankali yayi ba , musamman irin kulawar da naga Adam yana bata, kusan gabaki d’aya lokaci na, yana wajan ta yana kula da ita , hakan shiya ‘kara hura hutar ‘kiyayyar da nake mata , babu wacce zan nemi shawarta kamar aminiyata wacce ta had’ani da wani boka , duk aikin da na saka ayi mata baya tasiri, sau da yawa nayi ‘ko’karin kasheta amma bana cin nasara sai ma hakan da nake mata kamar ‘kara wani soyayyar nake a tsakanin su , babu abunda yafi tayar mun da hankali ganin ko ‘batan wata banyi ba ko sau d’aya . Ina cikin tunanin hanyar da zan samu mafita sai ga kiran wani waya da ya shigo wayata , bansan wanene ba , bansan ya akai ya sanni ba , nasan dai namiji ne , akaran farko ya fad’amun gabaki d’aya matsalolina ni kaina nayi mamakin yadda yasan hakan, sannan yace mun zai taimaka mun, amma yana da sharad’in zan sadaukar masa da ran mutum d’aya….” Wani irin muguwar sha’ka Big Boşs yayi mata tare da gefata fege, a rud’e ta saka wani irin ‘kara sabida tsorata , jijiyoyin kansa har sun mi’ke cikin sau sasshiyar murya da ya ‘kara firgita ta ya furta “ Wannan ‘kazamin dalilin ne ya baki damar kashe ta ? A daidai lokacin da burin ki ya cika , dan ki Samu duniya kika raba tsakanin ‘ya da mahaifiyar ta bayan tsanar da kika sa mata ?” Zuciyar Momy ce ta buga da ‘karfi,  cikin tsananin tashin hankali take girgiza masa kai , gashi har lokacin sha’kar da yayi mata bai sake ta ba “ wallahi bansan ko wanene ba , umarni kawai aka bani ,Dan Allah ku barni na koma gida , zan bawa kowa ha’kuri Dan Allah “, hannu Big Boss ya saka yana ‘ko’karin kai mata naushi, yadda ya nayinsa ya canza ba’karamun rikitata yayi, bai kuma cewa komai ba ya mayar da p-cap d’insa tare da barin d’akin dan yasan tabbas idan ya ‘kara minti d’aya a d’akin sai yayi mugun la’anta ta . Gabaki d’aya a prison d’in ya fita , cikin ‘kan’kanin lokaci su Victor Suka ja motar tare da barin wajan . 


******** NIGERIA 

Kamar yadda suka shirya, ‘karfe 6:50pm na dare gabaki d’ayan su suka shirya cikin dogayan abayan da suka matu’kar ‘kawata su , ba ‘karamun kyau abayar tayi musu ba , agogon hannunta Baby ta ‘Kara kalla dan babu wanda suke jira sai little , dan sun tanbayi Mamy fitar su hakan kuma bai basu wahala ba .  7 saura Little ya shigo falourn cikin shigar ‘kananan kaya , yadda ya gyara aşkın kansa sosai ya ‘kara fito da kyawun sa , ajiyar zuciya Baby ta sauke ganin basu da wani time sosai “ let’s go” cewar Little , ba musu gabaki d’aya suka mi’ke sai da yaga sun soma tafiya tukunna ya jera da Fanan suka fito a tare , motocin su Baby suka bi da kallo ganin kusan guda biyar a jere , tana juyowa ya d’aga hannun sa cikin rashin damuwa “ kun manta da mu za’a fita ne ? Idan Yaya Big Boss ya ji labarin fitar mu ba soja gabaki d’aya zai saka a lallasamu, just karku damu dasu kuxo mu tafi, muna ‘kara wasu minutes d’in ba lalle ku fita ba da zaran motocin Yaya Bobo suka shigo “. Jin hakan yasa kuwa da Sauri suka bud’e car d’in kasan tuwar Prince na tsaye a wajan. Baby da Eshaal Suka shiga mota d’aya , Little da Fanan suka shiga d’aya sai Wanda Arwa ta shiga shima Prince ya shiga , a haka motocin na su suka fita daga gidan bayan mota d’aya ta soja ta shiga gabansu, sai wadda take bayan su guda d’aya itama.
      ERIC KAYSER  shine wajan da suka nufa , da mamaki bayan sun fito daga mota suka kalli wajan , a tunaninsu siyayyar kawai zasuyi su dawo, “ Let’s get something first, “ cewar Little, basu bari sojojin sun biyo su ba suka shiga Wajan , duk da wajan bai kai rabin nasu na America ba amma still Wajan yayi musu , kowa abun choice d’insa ya za’ba , gwanin burgewa, basu zauna a wajan ba suka wuce Ikeja City Mall, shima abunda suke  bu’kata Little da prince Suka ce su d’auka ban da kaya , suna gama wa wani malls din su Little suka zagaya dasu , ba ‘karamun siyayya sukai musu ba , duk kusan kayan ciye ciye suka siya duk kayan babyn da zasu d’auka Little sai yace basu da kyau, sun siya a America , ba laifi yau sun wata ya sosai , ga number Little da Bobo yake ta kira shi da Prince amma gabaki d’aya basusan da hakan ba Sabida wayoyin su da suka saka a silent. 10pm suka shigo cikin gidan , tun kafin suyi parking suka tarar da Bobo a tsaye shida Sauban, jikin su duk a sanyaye suka fito daga motar, suna fitowa Bobo yayi wani ‘karamin fito, ba shiri su Bruno suka soma haushi, yadda suka taho kansu a guje ya saka suma su Baby sawa a guje , ga Simba da shima ya sakar musu gabaki d’aya sai sukai ‘ko'karin haukace ga , ga karnuka ga zaki da suka biyo su. Baby tana ganin hakan ‘kar’kashin mota ta shige tana göğe zufar data biyota, Little da prince suka d’ane jikin bishiya, Eshaal shige cikin flowers , ga kuma Fanan da ta shiga cikin boot d’in mota .

PAID BOOK

2 PAGES NA HA’DE KAMAR YADDA NAYI AL’KAWARI , PAGE ‘DIN JIYA DA NA YAU .

BOOK 2 
         S_____ 33

Kallan yadda gabaki d’ayan su suka ‘buya Bobo yayi , girgiza kansa yayi kad’an yana kallan direction d’in su Little “ Get down”, cewar Bobo, duk da Little yasan baya ganin sa sai ya marairaice fuska “ Haba Yaya Bobo we’re sorry , kalli fa su Bruno yadda suke haushi and at the other side kalli fa Simba, we’re sorry , Yaya Sauban , please say something “, kallan Bobo , Sauban yayi kafun ya furta “ ku fito dukan ku bazai sake muku komai ba, Man we’re sorry “, cewar Sauban yana kallan Bobo, “ Kar ku bari na maimaita gana ta , Dont make me count 3. 1,2….”, bai gama kai wa 2 ba Little da prince suka diro daga inda suka hau, Eshaal da Arwa ne suka soma fitowa sai Fanan , da ‘kyar Baby ta fito daga ‘kar’karshin motar da ta ‘buya , hannun Bobo ya mi’kawa Little “ The Black Card” gashin kansa Little ya shafa kafin ya ciro card d’in, a hankali ya nufo wajan Bobo da ya mi’ka masa hannu, tana saka Card yayi saurin guduwa Sabida yasan kamasa Bobo zaiyi, “ You can go now “, ya fad’a yana kallan Eshaal, kamar yadda su Baby suka ‘ki d’ago da kansu haka itama Eshaal ta’ki kallansa har suka shige cikin gidan. Cikin Sauri ko tsayawa basu yi ba duk da yadda Mamy take magana haka suka gudu d’aki, sallamar su Bobo yasa Mamy girgiza kai “ Daman nasan za’a rina tunda naga ko wannan su yayi sum sum da kai, akwai dalili”, dariya Sauban ya saki yana kallan Bobo “ Mamy , ai kina ganin su , Duk rainan mugunta ne , Big Boss ya hora su wallahi kuma duk sun horu, tun daga kan sa dan shi duk Wanda ya shiga hannunsa death person za’a kira sa har kan Little gabaki d’aya rainan rundunar soja ne da kuma namlun daji” hararar sa Bobo yayi yana d’auke idanuwansa , itama Mamy murmushi tayi “ Rabu dashi Son, Indai Sauban ne kasan halinsa , Ai ni kayi mun dai dai da kayi musu haka , gobe baza su ‘kara dad’ewa haka ba “, murmushi Bobo yayi yana kawar da zancan “ Mamy am hungry “, da mamaki Mamy ta kalle su “ yan matan naku su haka suke da rowa ? Da har suka bar ku da yunwa ?” Kallan juna Bobo da Sauban sukai , kamar had’in baki sai suka mi’ke kusan a tare “ Uhm… Mamy sai da safe “, shi Bobo bai jira reply d’inta ba ya juya , shima Sauban cikin Sauri ya bi bayan sa yana ‘kumshe dariyar sa. 

******** Suna shiga d’aki Baby ta fad’a kan gado tana sakin ajiyar zuciya “ wallahi Eshaal kina da aiki a gaban ki keda Fanan , duk mazajan ku mugaye ne wallahi, Aushe na in-law mai sau’ki ne , wannan bala’i har ina , ga karnuka ga Zaki dan masifa ? Allah ya baku ha’kuri zama da su, Allah yasa kar kuyi musu laifi su kulle ku d’akin karnuka “ hararar ta Eshaal tayi “ Koma dai mene ne mu muka janyo ai , ni kinga na gaji wallahi, so nake nayi wanka na kwanta Kawai “, a zabure Baby ta mi’ke daka kan gadon “ tab d’ijan wallahi yadda saurayin ki ya jijjiga rayuwa na kusa hango mutuwa babu abunda zai hana bansha abubuwan siyayyar mu ba , “ a maimakon Fanan tayi magana sai ta ‘kyal’kyale da dariya, gabaki d’ayan su sun fahimci abunda takewa dariya shima suma suka soma yi suna turo reaction d’in kowa lokacin da aka sakar musu Bruno.

       HAJIYA FALMATA
       
 “Harry me  kike ‘ko’karin mayar da kanki ne? Da me kike so naji? Da ba’kin cikin da nake ‘kunsa wajan yan gidan nan ko da ba’kin cikin d’abi’un Ubanki da ya soma yi mun kwana biyu ?”gabaki d’aya kin mayar da kanki dake da mahaukaciya baku da mara ba, kullum cikin shan kayan maye kike kamar wata mara hankali”, banza Harry tayi mata tana d’aukar wani maganin ruwa zata kai bakinta Hajiya Falmata ta ‘barar dashi “ Dan ubanki ba dake nake magana ba?” Cikin Jin haushi da ‘bacin rai Harry ta nuna ta da yatsa , kamar wacce take magana da ‘kanwarta ta soma d’aga murya “ Ya isheki haka Momy , ya isheki, ki barni nayi rayuwa ta yadda na ga dama, tun d’azu kin zo sai cika ni kike da surutu , nasha ‘kwayar Momy , tun farko wane ne ya fara lallata mun tarbiyyar idan bake ba? Wane ne ya fara kawo mun ‘kwayoyin ? Ke Momy kina da bakin magana ma ? Ko ance miki bansan kema kina shan drugs ba har abunda kike yi cikin dare ? Gabaki d’aya Momy bazan ‘kara yadda dake ba , burina kullum sai lallacewa yake , kin mun al’kawarin auran Umar amma babu shi babu alamar auransa gabaki d’aya yanzu babu Wanda zai ce ga inda sukaje shi da waccen shegiyar yarinyar da duk lokabin da na ganta a cikin idanuwa na sai naji kamar na da’ba mata wu’ka ta mutu, gabaki d’aya zuwan ta rayuwata ya fara tar watsewa , da tuntuni kin barni nayi abunda na ga dama da nice tare dashi ba shegiyar can ba , ko d’an iskan Bokan naki babu abunda ya iya sai kwasan kud’i amma babu result mai kyau , yanzu bazan ‘karajin maganar kiba duk abunda naga yayi mun Daidai shi zanyi na fad’a miki “ ta ‘karasa tana ‘ko’karin komawa ta zauna , rigar jikinta Hajiya Falmata , hannunta har rawa yake lokacin da ta tsinkawa Harry mari, itama cikin ba’kin ciki da ‘kuncin da take ji kwana biyu ta d’aga hannu zata rama marin taji kamar an ri’ke mata hannu, duk a tunaninta Momyn nata ne ta d’ago a masifan ce , bata ankara ba taji saukar wani warin, a rud’e Harry ta juyo  saitin da taji saukar marin, itama Momyn bata jikin ta har rawa yake lokacin da ta kalli direction d’in,Harry na ganin Dadynta ta soma zare ido , Hajiya Falmata ita kanta dafe ‘kirjinta tayi sabida mugun kallon da ta ga yana bin su dashi, cikin tsananin ‘bacin rai ya kalli Harry “ wannan shine saka makon tarbiyyar da kullum nake ‘ko’karin yi miki? Harira ? Kin bani kunya ,Ni a cikin gida na ? Da rai na ? Innalillahi wa inna ilaihi raji’un, har kinyi girman da zaki iya d’aga hannu ki mari mahaifiyar ki? Lalacewar taki har ta kai haka sabida san abun duniya ?” Hannun ta dafe da kumatunta ta soma girgiza kai , wasu ‘kwalla duk sun cika mata ido sabida rud’ewa , za tayi magana ya daka mata tsawa , akan tayi masa shiru , ita kanta Hajiya Falmata sai data tsorata da yanayin sa , cikin tsananin ‘bacin rai ya furta “ Na baki nan da d’an lokaci ‘kan’kani ki fito da mijin aure , idan ba haka ba duk Wanda naga damar had’a ki aure ke kika saya ko da kuwa mai bawa flower ruwa ne aura miki zanyi , ke kuma”, ya juya yana kallan Hajiya Falmata “ Duk irin munafurcin da kike had’awa da duk abunda kike ina sane da ke , na zuba miki idanuwane naga ko zakiyi hankali , amma naga kema hankalin naki ba ishash she bane , ni kuma ina da hankali bazan rayu da marasa hankali ba a cikin gida na , duk munanan halayyar da kika koyawa yar ki , ke da Allah kin cuce ni Sabida nayi ‘ko’karina Wajan bata su tarbiyya amme ke kina ‘Kara lalata koma , kamar yadda na bawa ‘yar ki lokaci kema ina farin cikin sanar dake Aure nan da ‘yan kwanaki mamata zata tare idan kinga dama ki had’i zuciya , daga yau kuma ban amince da zuwan ko wacce yar uwarki nan gidan ba ko kema ki fita , idan d’aya daga cikin hakan ya faru kuma abakin auren ki “, bai kuma bi ta kansa ya fice daga d’akin, Hajiya Falmata wani irin hajijiya ne taji yana ‘ko’karin kamata , cikin tsananin tashin hankali da rud’ani ta d’ora kai aka tana sakin wani ihu kamar wata mahaukaciya , itama Harry d’in kukan tashin hankali take dan tasan ‘karamun aikinsa ne kamar yadda yace d’in, dan Ita ba na ‘karin auran da yace zai ‘karawa Momyn ta take ba , ta yadda zata mallaki zuciyar Big Boss Kawai take tunani.

FIFTH AVENUE 

Sanye take cikin wasu ‘kananan kaya, rigar jikinta kamar top haka take Baby pink colour , sai wani blue jeans da ta saka , ba ‘karamin fito da shape d’in jikinta yayi , daga top d’in rigar wasu design zata fi jin dad’in ganin su sosai, da d’ad’d’ai da d’ad’d’ai take bin pictures d’in da kallo, duk da batasan ko su wane ba haka kawai take jin zuciyar ta wasai , duk hotunan sa da ta kalla sai tayi murmushi ko kuma ta kwaikwayi yadda ya ‘bata face d’insa , wani hoto da ta d’auko ne ya tafi da tunaninta, batasan ko wacece ba , amma yadda taga murmushi akan face d’in ta , da yadda shima ya d’an murmushi ya fi komai jan hankalinta, ko ba’a fad’a mata ba tasan mahaifiyar sace “ Amma tana ina ?” Shine tanbayar da tayi wa zuciyar ta , d’an ajiyar zuciya ta sauke kad’an ganin babu me bata amsa tanbayarta, wani hotan ta d’auka , kasantuwar akan kujera suka zauna , yana zaune kamar yadda ya saba , duk da hotan yana yarone yayi crossing legs d’insa a wannan lokacin ma , Matar da tagani a hotan da ta ajje itace anan , tare da wani Wanda shima bata sanshi ba, tana ri’ke da hannun Big Boss shikuma ya shafa gashin kansa yana sakar masa murmushi, kasa d’auke idanuwanta Abla tayi daga kan picture yana ma’kale cikin zuciyarta . A hankali ta soma bin picture d’in da kallo tana ‘kara kallan, wani picture ta gani ta d’auka duk da batasan su sosai ba tana iya shedasu, Mamy Dadyn Eshaal, Abbu, da wasu mata guda uku da batasan ko su wanene ba ajikin hotunan, sai wacce ta gani tare da Big Boss a jikin hotan, da mutumin da ta gani shima a cikin picture d’in, da d’ad’d’ai da d’ad’d’ai ta soma bi tana Kallan fuskokinsu, cikin su kuwa har da Nani da fuskarta take d’auke da wani matsananin murmushi da zai tabbatar da farin cikin da take ciki. 
      ‘Daya daga cikin picture d’in da ta ganine yasa tayi saurin zaro idanunta waje tare da ta’ba ‘kugunta ,mamaki ne fal a cikin zuciyar ta , ganin kamar Big Boss ne a cikin hotan duk da bai tufke gashin kansa ba amma ya tara shi sosai, a shekaru bazai wuce 9 ba amma still kamannin sa bai ‘boye ba , wani black riga ce a jikinsa , mai kamar shape d’in V da ta fito da sarkar dake wuyansa sosai , ‘Kara kallan hotan Abla tayi sosai tana bin sarkar wuyansa da kallo Kamar idanuwanta zasu fad’o ’kasa ,mamaki da al’ajabi ne ya kamata da yana ta ‘kwa’k’kwaran motsi, hannunta har rawa yake lokacin da ta kai hannu zata shafa sar’kar da ta gani akan wuyansa, “ ya ilahi “, cewar Abla cikin Sauri Sauri ta cigaba da bin cinka hotunan har zuwa kan wani picture d’in nasa mai wannan sar’kar ga matar da ya gani cikin hotan family d’in a tare dashi har lokacin da murmushi akan fuskarsu,wani hoto ta gani süsü biyar a ciki, shi da Abbu kawai ta iya ganewa cikin hotan amma gabaki d’aya bata ragowar ba, sai binsu da kallo da take kamar idanuwanta zasu cire. Hotan sa da ta gani mai sar’kar ta ‘kara dauka tana bi da kallo da gabaki d’aya idanuwanta kamar zasu fito waje , yadda take kallan hotan ko ‘kifta idanuwanta batayi, batasan ya akai ba sai gani tayi hotan baya hannunta , cikin Sauri ta d’ago da idanuwanta , bata yi tsammanin ganin sa irin wannan lokacin ba , shiyasa ta d’an tsorata , cikin Sauri tayi ‘ko’karin jan baya dafe da cikin ta , a haka take ‘ko’karin ‘boye pictures d’in da ta d’akko , dan a kallan farko ta fahimci ‘bacin ransa , lumshe idanuwansa yayi yana shafa gashin kansa , a kusa da itan ya zauna yana matso da ita jikinsa, bai ce mata komai ba sai kwantar da kanta da yayi akan kafad’unsa, hannunsa d’aya ya zagayo dashi saitin cikinta , idanuwansa ya lumshe , har lokacin bai ce mata komai ba kuma bashi da alamar yi mata maganar , kallan face d’insa Abla tayi kamar zatayi kuka “ Am sorry please Sunshine , bansan ranka zai ‘baci ba da bazan kalla pictures d’in ba , kuma naga kamar addakai a cikin hotan shiyasa na kalla , please am sorry kaji “, rinannun idanuwansa da ya zuba mata yasa ba shiri ta had’iye maganar ta cikin Sauri, ganin yadda yake ‘ko’karin rufe idanuwansa yasa taji wani irin kuka na zuwar mata, bata ri’ke ba kuma ta soma kukanta tana rufe idanuwanta da duka hannayenta biyu, lumshe idanuwansa Big Boss yayi yana ‘kara bud’ewa, a hankali kamar Wanda aka sa dole yayi magana ya furta “ Mai akai miki? Shiru gabaki d’ayan su sukai na d’an wani lokaci , ita tana jiran jin labarin, a ‘bangaransa kuma yana juya ta yadda zai bata labarin , duk da in short zaiyi mata . But sai kin shirya ni “ ya fad’a yana d’an kashe mata ido, murmushi Abla tayi tana d’an dukar ‘kirjinsa “ Ni dai ka bari please “, cewar Abla , mi’kar da ita yayi a hankali , har lokacin sar’kar na hannun sa , sai wani envolope mai d’an tudu da ya d’auka suka bar part d’in , fuskar Abla kwance da kyakkyawar murmushinta ta taimaka masa ya shirya , cikin ‘kan’kanın lokaci ‘kamshin sa ya cika ko ina na d’akin, peck ya kai mata akan kumatunta, zata rakashi har ‘kasa ya hanata , sai ma janta da yayi zuwa kan sofa ya zaunar da ita , any time za’ayi kiran sallah yanzu, karki wahalar mun da Babies d’ina , akwai phone ko me kike bu’kata , just make a call okay ?” Kanta Abla ta jinjina masa sai kuma ta kama hannunsa ta sun bata “ Safe journey Sunshine “, kansa ya jinjina mata tare da d’ora mata both envelope d’in da ya d’auka da sar’kar hannun sa . Bai bari tayi tanbayar da take san yi ba , ya bar d’akin . 
     Ajiyar zuciya Abla ta sauke yana kallan Sar’kar da ya bata , envelope d’in da ya ajje mata ta kalla, har zata mayar ta ajje sai kuma ta fasa , batayi Tuna’nın komai ba ta bud’e envelope d’in. Wani Black book ne a ciki kamar diary , cikin za’kuwa Abla ta ‘karasa ciro diary d’in , tsaya fara kalla tayi ,bakinta d’auke da bismilla ta bud’e sa .  Cikin wani irin handwriting me shegen kyau  sunan “ MAI DALA”, ya fara fitowa , daga ‘kasan sa kuma small hand writing ne shima da English kalmar “ it’s have being a long journey “, ya fito shima rad’au, gabaki d’aya Abla za’kuwa tayi akan ta soma karantawa, kiran sallar magrib da akai ne yasa ta ajje book d’in. Cikin ‘kan’kanin lokaci tayi sallarta tare da duk abunda ya kamata tayi , ko ta kan abinci Abla bata bi ba , ta d’auki diary d’in tare da kwanciya akan sofa d’in d’akin. Tana bud’e next page d’in ta ‘kara tarar da wani rubutun , cikin manyan ba’ki “FEW YEARS BACK “ abunda aka rubuta a jiki kenan , kafun Abla ta ‘kara gyara kwanciyarta , kasan tuwar a zuciya take karantawa . 

      
       FEW YEARS BACK
       
Labari guda d’aya ne , sannan tarihi guda d’aya ne , the family of MAI DALA wasu family da sukai suna sosai akan fannin kasuwanci, asalin sunan ya fara ne a lokacin Manyan Family d’in a halin guda uku , Alhaji Umar Wanda kowa yake masa ya la’kabi da Lion sabida yadda ya kasance mutum mara dariya , gabaki d’aya baya murmushi akan fuskarsa, Wanda asalinsu larabawa ne , tun daga kan mahaifinsa sheik Usman da ya zamto shugaban Limaman haramın Makkah gabaki d’aya har bayan rasuwarsa da Judge Umar ya kar’ba mu’kamun shima, sai Alhaji Taufeeq Wanda asalinsa bafullatani ne , jajirtaccen mutum da idan yayi magana d’aya ta zauna kenan dan da wuya ya zanca magana idan yayi ta , sai kuma Dr Mansoor , a la’kace babba a tsakanin wa d’annan a halin, Judge Umar yana mata mace d’aya Mai suna Halimatus-Sadiya  da kowa ya fi kiranta da Sitti Sabida irin dattakon ta da sakin fuskarta sosai ba kamar judge Umar ba, ‘ya’yan ta 9 cif, babban d’anta sunansa Ahmad sai Abubakar Saddiq , sai kuma Mohammad , da Khalid , Safreena, Sofiyya , Ummukursum , Al’ameen sai kumq autar ta Maimuna da ake cewa maimoon, duk cikin ‘ya’yan nan da haifa gabaki d’ayan su bayan suna Allah yake amsar abunsa ,mutane biyu ne kawai Allah yayi zata rayu dasu Safreena da Sofiyya amma bayansu gabaki d’aya mutuwa sauran suke cikin su tara mutane biyu ne kawai suka zauna da ransu sai ‘kanwarta mai suna Habiba , Mafi aka sarı kuma kuma ake kiranta da Diidii sabida tun tana yar ‘karamar ta wajan Sitti ta taso kasantuwar su marayu daga ita har yayar tata, shiyasa Judge Umar yake kiran ta da Diidii har sunan ya bita itama ba , ‘Ya’yan Didi 7, Sulaiman, Abdur rahman, Sufyan, Aisha, Zainab da ibrahim, gabaki d’aya suna ‘kasar saudiya, anan sukai makarantar su kuma ko wannan su da ‘ya’yansa kusan gabaki d’aya suna rayuwa ne dasu Sitti musamman mazan da ahalinsu . 

      Na biyun su Alhaji Taufeeq shahararran attajiri ne tundaga ‘kuruciyarsa , mahaifinsa Alyaseer ya kasance mutum mai tsananin zuciyar neman na kansa , hakan yasa cikin ‘kan’kanin lokaci Allah ya d’auka kashi ya sawa abun neman sa Albarka , Alyaseer babban d’an kasuwa ne da yayi suna a harkar siye da sayarwa musamman a fannin Dola, hakan yasa mutane da yawa suke kiran sa da Sunan Mai Dala , tun abun na wasa sai hakan ya zama sunan sa gabaki d’aya , duk inda ka ratsa idan kaji an anbaci sunan Mai Dala to shid’inne mai sunan , ya so ya kice sunan amma aminansa Judge Umar da Dr Mansoor suka fara kiran sa da wannan kalmar ta Mai Dala , wannan ne babban dalilin da yasa sunan yake rayuwa har izuwa wannan lokacin. Al-Yasser matan sa Biyu Aneesa da kuma kaltooum, Hajiya Aneesa da kowa yake kiranta da Mama wasu kuma suna kiranta da Hajiyar America , macece mai matsanancin kirki da sanyin hali amma duk da haka wani lokaci itama tana da fad’a idan aka ta’bota, yadda take da sanyin hali yasa kowa da kowa nata ne ‘ya’yanta 7 , Adam, Abbas , Anas,Munir , ‘Kasım , nusaiba , sai kuma autar ta Aina’u da ake kira da Nani. Matar sa ta biyu kuma Hajiya kaltooum, kamilalliyar mata , kusan kullum fuskarta kwance yake da murmushi, ‘ya’yanta Biyu a duniya daga Mohammed sai isma’il Wanda a lokacin haihuwarsa ne Allah ya amshi a bunsa , shayarwarsa ya koma Wajan Mama , yadda take kula da su gabaki d’aya da wahala mutum ya iya banbance wanne ne asalin ‘ya’yanta , musamman isma’il da duk Wanda yake san ganin ‘bacin ranta to ya ta’ba isma’il, shiyasa kusan kowa yake tsoran ‘bata masa rai dan duk Wanda ya ‘bata ransa kamar ya ‘bata na Mama ne duk yadda kuke shiri da ita kuma zata ‘bata maka . 
      
         Na ukun su kuma shine Dr Mansoor , mutum mai sanin ya kamata , fuskarsa kusan kullum d’auke yake da murmushi, Wanda ya kasance d’abi’arsa ce murmushi, shiyasa yawan ci duk Wanda yayi laifi sai ya güdü gidan Dr Mansoor Sabida bazai ta’ba bari a ta’ba su ba, shima matan sa biyu , Hajar da Ummi, ‘ya’yan Hajar uku, Adam , Mohammad ,da kuma Amina da ta rasu tun tana ‘yar ‘karamarta sai Ummi da ita kuma Allah bai ta’ba bata haihuwa ba shiyasa kusan yawanci a halin gidan a can wajan Dr Mansoor suke Hutu, a cikin wannan lokacin ne kuma Al- Yasser ya dawo da wani yaro cikin tafiyar da yayi, bayan rasuwar Hajiya kaltoom, babu Wanda yasan ainahin dalilin dawowar yaron sai da Al-Yasser ya basu labarin gidan Marayun da sukaje har Allah ya had’ashi da Kabeer shima ya shiga cikin sawun ‘ya’yansa , yadda yake nuna rashin banbancin acikin su babu Wanda zaiyi tunanin Kabeer ba d’an su bane, haka rayuwar a halin ta cigaba da tafiya , duk ‘karshen shekara gabaki d’aya family Ukun suna had’uwa su sada zumunci, a cikin lokacin ne kuma gabaki d’aya yaran sukai Aure ko wa ya Auri wacce yake so, Mohammed da Isma’il suka Auri Safreena da Sofiyya , Adam umma ya auri Amatullah , sai Mohammad kuma ya auri wacce ya dad’e yana so mai suna Hauwa’u ( Mamy)su Uncle Adam ma gabaki d’aya suka aura matan da suke so Sabida a tsarin su babu Wanda za a yiwa auran dole.

     ******Bayan wasu tsawan shekaru abubuwa da yawa sun faru , ciki kuma har da rasuwar Alhaji Alyasser , da Kuma Dr Mansoor, duk da hakan kuwa babu kaso d’aya na cikin ala’karsu da ta ragu sai ma wani soyayya da ta ‘kara shiga sukatan a halin musamman yadda Judge Umar ya tsaya tsayin taka wajan kula da ahalin, kafun rasuwar su kuwa ba ‘karamun arzi’ki Allah ya bun’kasa musu ba , a wannan lokacin ne kuma Mohammed ya gaji kasuwancin mahaifinsu, da shima ya d’ora akan business kamar yadda yaga mahaifinsa nayi. 
     
         Wannan shine babban Tarihin asalin a halin Mai Dala. 
          ( The Leaders of the Family) 

Ajiyar zuciya Abla ta sauke bayan ta gama karanta last page d’in da take, abubuwa da yawa suna mata yawo a cikin zuciyarta, da gangar jikinta . Kallan Time tayi ganin har yanzu akwai ragowar time kafin ayi kiran sallar isha’i, da d’inta d’aya tayi wanka tuntuni, sai takejin wani irin dad’i a karo na farko da ya hanata yin girki, ‘kasa ta sakko gabaki d’aya anshirya Wajan Dinning ko takan wajan bata bi ba ta d’auko Youghurt d’inta da take bala’in so har kwali biyu sabida batasan shan na sama sunyi mata sanyi, hankalinta a kwance ta koma d’aki, a wannan karan kan gado ta kowa yadda zata fi jin dad’in karatunta , dan sosai ta matsu da jin Sauran labarin. 

        “THE BOND” shine farkon heading d’in wajan. Ajiyar zuciya Abla ta sauke mai ‘karfi kafin ta soma karatun kamar haka . 
       
        10 YEARS LATER 
        
   wasu kyawawan samari ne su uku da ashekaru bazasu wuce shekara 8 zuwa 9 ba , kyawawa ne su sosai , musamman na tsakiyar su da fuskarsa take a d’auke babu ko d’igon fara’a a tattare dashi, yana da yalwar gashi sosai akansa ba’ki’kin ga skin d’insa da Hutu da kwanciyar hankali ya gama bayyana a jikinsa , na kusa dashi ma fari ne sosai duk da hasken sa ko rabin na tsakiyar nasu bai kai ba , 
   ma ba , kyawawane sosai na , fuskarsa d’auke take da yalwataccen murmushi, amma duk da hakan bai kai na d’ayan side d’insa ba da ya kasance chololate colour , kanshi kuma da gashi shima amma ba irin nasu ba , yadda gashinsa yake kamar irin yadda Black American suke tara gashin su. Fuskar sa da matsanancin farin ciki ya furta “ Dude wannan had’e face da kake ya isa haka mana , Haba my besty , dan kawai taron family yayi? Sai kace wani aljanu bakasan magana kuma bakasan hayaniya ? ‘Dago da fuskarsa na tsakiyar yayi yana bun wanda yayi maganar da wani iriin kallo da yasa lokaci guda ya ‘kara sakin dariya “ Am sorry Besty , mai da wu’kar mana , wannan kallon da kayi mun sai kasa Amimi ta hukunta ni” d’auke kansa yayi kawai ba tare da yace komai ba , a haka suka shiga wani part mai shegen kyau da had’uwa , gabaki d’aya falourn ‘kamshin turare ne yake tashi da ‘kamshin Ac mai matu’kar sanyaya zuciya , mutane ne zazzaune a cikin falourn , kowa cikin alfarma da sakin fuska yake , daga ‘bangaran hagu su Sitti ne a Wajan gabaki d’ayansu, sitti, Diidii, Hajiyar America, Hajiya Aneesa sai kuma Hajiya Kaltoom, cikin dattako suke hirar su gwanin sha’awa sai su Abbu da suma suke zaune cikin set d’in kujera daga tsakiyar kujerar farin balarabe mai cike da dattaho Judge Umar kenan, duk da manyanta ta kamasa har lokacin fuskarsa bai cika sakin taba sai wajan mutum d’aya Wanda yaji sunansa “ Farooq “, a d’aya ‘bangaran kuma su Mamy ne zazzaune akan carfet suna hira kwanin burgewa babu Wanda zaiyi tunanin ba iyaye d’aya ne suka haifesu yadda suke dariya da murmushin nan , shigowar matasan nan ne yasa gabaki d’aya kowa ya ‘kara mayar da hankalinsa kansu, na tsa’kiyar sune ya ‘kara had’e fuskarsa zai juya yaji muryar mutumin da yake matu’kar so a rayuwar sa “ Mai suna “ yaji an ‘kara kirawo sa , wai gowa yayi zuwa inda yaji muryar mutumin, duk da baiyi murmushi ba amma ya saki fuskarsa sosai , a hankali cike da wata irin izza ya ‘karaso wajan, yana zuwa kuwa akan kujerar da babu mahalu’kin da yake zama a katta sai Judge , sai kuma shi Farooq da yaci sunansa sabida kusan halayyar su d’aya , ga wani irin izza da suke da ita . Yana zama akan kujerar ya jingina da jikin tsohon ba tare da yace komai ba , gabaki d’aya falourn kowa yasan halinsa shiyasa babu Wanda ya tanka musamman da Judge yake wajan shi da Didi , ga kuma Ammimi da Uncle isma’il da duk Wanda yayi ‘ko’karin ta’bashi sai inda ‘karfin su ya ‘kare dan sosai suke wa mutum wankin babban bargo. Girgiza kansa Abbu da yake gefe yayi kafun ya kalli Farooq “ Son sai ka ‘balla mana ubane?” Kallan su judge yayi lokaci d’aya Abbu ya saki murmushi ganin yadda shima ya ‘bata ransa ,  Uncle Isma’il ne ya murmusa sosai yana kallan Farooq “ My Lion yau baka kulani ba?” ‘Dan d’ago da fuskarsa yayi tare da kallon saitin mutumin, a hankali ya mi’ke tare da nufarsa, ba tare da ya zauna akan kujeran ba ya zauna daga ‘kafafunsa hakanne ya bawa Uncle isma’il damar saka hannunsa cikin lallausan gashin kansa , daman kowa yasan irin soyayyar da ke tsakanin su . A ‘bangaran matan ma Aunty Sofiyya da kowa yake kira da Ammimi ce ta murmusa , yadda take murmusawar yasa gabaki d’aya suka kalleta , musamman Mamy “ wannan soyayyar da kuke wa yaran nan sai Allah , abu d’aya zakuyi ku haifa masa yarinya dan nasan itace zata zama matar sa “, gabaki d’aya suka soma dariya jin abinda Mamy tace , kiran sallahr da akai na azahar yasa gabaki d’aya mazan suka mi’ke da nufin zuwa masallaci, hannun judge ri’ke da Farooq suka nufi masallaci, Abdul-Maleek da Sauban suna gefen su suma . 
   
     A Haka ahalin suke rayuwa cikin kanwar junansu musamman da ya kasance babu yara a lokaci sai Farooq , Abdul-Maleek da Sauban sai kuma Abdus-samad da bazai go shekara 6 zuwa biyar ba ,a Daidai lokacin da Ameer ( prince) yake shekara d’aya da kusan rabi. Wani irin soyayyace a tsakanin mutane ukun nan  Farooq da kowa yake kira da Big Boss sai Sauban da Abdul Maleek yake kira da Bibi, Big Boss kuma ya ke kiran Abdulmaleek da Bobo. Kullum suna tare tun suna ‘kananan su, kasan cewar makaranta d’aya sukai kuma kusan ambition d’aya ne dasu na zama soja. A cikin uncles d’insu kowa da favorisi d’insa idan ka cire kaka judge. Uncle ismail da Ammimi gabaki d’aya babu Wanda bai san soyayyar da ke tsakanin su da Big Boss, duk da baya magana da ita su biyun nan kawai yake doguwar maganarsa sai Didi da sitti suma. Sauban kuwa d’an gatan Hajiyar America ne da Abbu sai kuma Ammu (Safreena), Bobo kuwa kusan kowa nashine sabida yadda take da faran faran sa’banin Big Boss da idan yaga kana ‘ko’karin sashi magana zaka nemesa ka rasa gabaki d’aya, kowa sai yayi tunanin baya magan amma idan shida Abbu ne kamar wasu friends haka suke ga Uncle Ismail shima da yafi kowa sanin halinsa. 
     Haka rayuwar ahalin take tafiya cikin tsananin farin ciki da ‘kwanar juna . 

Ajiyar zuciya Abla ta saki mai d’an ’karfi sabida kiran sallar da taji an soma , dole ta ajje Diary d’in taje tayi sallah. Tana idar da sallahr wanka tayi ta shirya cikin red d’in rigar bacci da tayi matu’kar yi mata kyau, sosai kayan suka ‘kawatata tare da fito da ainahin kalar skin d’in ta , hannu ta d’ora aşaman cikin ta dan ba lefi yanzu ta soma jin yunwa amma duk da hakan bata ha’kura da karatun Diary d’in ba ta ‘kara shan Youghurt d’inta , har Sauri take ta cigaba da karatun ta shiyasa bata tsaya shan Youghurt d’in sosai ba , ta d’akko Diary d’in, tun kafun ta bud’e page d’in zuciyarta ta soma bugawa a hankali sabida d’an d’igon jini da ta gani a wajan , 
   “ Hatefull time” shine farkon heading d’in Wajan , tana ‘ko’karin karantawa kenan taji an fusge book d’in, cikin Sauri ta d’ago kanta ganin sa a tsaye tsuke da face d’insa , wani irin kallo ya jefa mata da tayi saurin sunkuyar da kanta ‘kasa , a hankali ta furta “ Welcome back Sunshine “, bai amsa mata ba shiyasa Abla tayi saurin d’ago da fuskarta, hannun sa d’aya ya mi’ka mata , ba musu ta saka nata ganin face d’insa a had’e , bai tanka mata ba ya fita daga d’akın tare da ita , tasan rashin cin abincin da batayi bane ya ‘bata masa rai shiyasa tun kafin ta su sauka Wajan dinning d’in tayi fiki fiki da ido , har suka ‘karasa Wajan bai ce mata komai ba , da kanshi yayi serving d’inta kuma ya bata a baki, suna gamawa sai da ya tabbatar cikin nata ya d’an lafa tukunna ya d’auke ta zuwa bedroom d’insu, Abla kamar zatayi kuka ganin ya ‘karashareta, ta gumi tayi tana jiran fitowar sa kusan mintuna goma ta soma jin ‘kamshin daddad’an turaransa , tana d’ago da idanuwanta ta tarar da shi d’inne sanye cikin navy blue pjamas masu santsi da d’aukar ido, a maimakon ya zauna kan sofa inda take zai ya zauna kan bedside tare da d’akko system d’insa . Zuciyar Abla ce ta buga da ‘karfi dan tun da taga hakan tasan ta ‘bata masa rai , jiki a sanyaye ya nufo inda yake cikin wani irin taku mai matu’kar d’aukar hankali, sarai Big Boss ya ganta ta ‘kasan ido amma ya d’auke idanuwansa dukda ba ‘karamin ya’ki yayi da zuciyar saba kafun ya iya d’auke idanuwansa daga kanta . Abla tana zuwa System d’in ta d’auke tare da zama a inda ta d’auketa , ‘ko’karin kawar da kansa yayi tayi saurin ri’ke face d’in nasa “ am sorry Sunshine , please don’t be angry with us kaji? We’re sorry “, yan zumma ‘ko’karin kawar da kansa yayi tayi saurin had’e bakinsu shiyasa ya tsaya yana kallansa , a hankali ta zare bakin nata tare da furta “ we’re sorry please “, tana fad’in hakan ta ‘kara had’e bakinsu waje d’aya , shi kansa Big Boss ‘ko’karin zautar dashi take gabaki d’aya ya birkice lokaci d’aya , bai gama mutuwa da mamakinta ba sai da yaga tana  ‘ballesa button d’in riga bayan ta zame gabaki d’aya rigar jikinta….
   
   IBTISSAM
      ( A heart touching story of love and destiny)

‘Kara bud’e idanuwansa yayi sosai akanta , cikin tsantsan mamakin da ya kamasa ya ke kallan fuskarta , so yake kawai su had’a idanuwa amma ta ‘ki basa wannan damar har ta gama ‘balle masa button d’in rigarsa , “ Baby Boo” Abla ta rad’a masa a cikin kunne , cikin wani irin siga da gabaki ya saka tsigar jikinsa tashi ya janyo ta jikinsa , “ Should I?huh?” Cewar Big Boss yana ‘kara zuba masa narkakkun idanuwansa akanta , wani irin kallo Abla tayi masa tare da sakar masa lallausan murmushin da ya hanasa motsawa, hannunta d’aya ta saka akan face d’insa tana d’an zaga yawa da ita har zuwa kan lips d’insa , cikin wani irin salo da kashe murya ta furta “ I’m yours ! You’re mine “, yadda ta soma yawo da hannayenta akan faffad’an ‘kirjinsa ya saka ba shiri ya juyar da ita ya koma samanta, itama duka hannayenta Abla ta saka ta rungumo face d’insa , bata jira cewar sa ba ta ‘kara had’e bakin su waje d’aya . A wannan karan wani irin passionate kiss Abla take masa da shi kansa saida mamaki ya kamasa , yadda take komai cikin ‘kwarewa yasa gabaki d’aya ya ‘kara zauce mata , sosai Abla ta sakar masa jikinta tana masa abunda yake so, har saida ta ‘kara jin sautin hawayensa cikin dodon kunnuwanta.  
         After An Hour 
 After an hour , kwance Abla take a kan faffad’an ‘kirjinsa, dukda duvet ya lullu’besu hakan baya ‘boye doguwar singlet d’insa da ta saka duk da ya mata yawa , kanta Big Boss ya ke shafawa a hankali fuskarsa d’auke da murmushin da ya kasa ‘boyuwa akan fuskar sa , tun d’azu yakesan su had’a ido amma takı yadda, “ Sunshine ?” Cewar Big Boss ganin yadda ta lafe sosai a jikinsa kamar me bacci “ Uhm” cewar Abla tana ‘kara shigewa jikinsa “ Na wahalar dake da Babyn mu ko?”, d’an girgiza kanta Abla tayi da ‘kyar ta iya bod’e bakinta “ uhm uhm yana so dai kace ka dena fushin da kake damu”, ta fad’a tana d’an turo bakinta , murmushi sosai Big Boss yayi mata “ Am not Angry with you, am not just happy da kika ‘ki cin abinci all the day, if not zan gwashe youghurt d’in nan dan bazaki haifar min Baby mai kwad’ayi ba”, turo ‘baki Abla tayi “ Ni ai bani ce mai kwad’ayi ba, haka kawai ya ta kura mun sai bacci yake sakanni kullum kullum , sannan ya dunga sakani cin abinci da yawa duk ya ramar dani, kuma…” dariyar da taji yana mata ne ta d’an doki ‘kirjinsa “ Ni kadai na mun dariya “ wani murmushin ya sake yi mai sauti , “ it’s okay Yar lukuta, ai ba laifin sa bane , ki bari idan kika haifa mana Baby zai ki rage amma zaki yi ‘kiba fa , dan kina haihuwa zan ‘kara baki wani Babyn nawa ,ko?” Cikin Sauri Abla ta kallesa shi kuma ya d’age mata gira d’aya , wani irin kunya ne ya kamata ganin yadda idanuwansu suka had’u waje d’aya , cikin Sauri ta shige cikin duvet d’in da suke a lullu’be , d’aya duvet d’in yayi ganin yadda take ‘boye fuskarta sai shima ya shige ciki. A hankali sautin dariyar ta yake tashi cin duvet d’in.

  NIGERIA

Hannunta d’auke da empty bottlew water ta fito daga d’akin su , Sabida yadda ta mayar da hankalinta kan wayarta yasa gabaki d’aya batasan da mutum a falourn ba , sai fuske wayar da akai . A d’an tsorace Eshaal ta d’ago da idanuwanta , Wanda ta gani a tsaye a gabanta ne yasa tayi saurin kawar da kanta gefe “ Ina kwana ?” Cewar Eshaal ba tare da ta kallesa ba , shiru Bobo yayi mata batare da ya amsa matan ba shiyasa ta ‘kara d’ago fuskarta , ganin ita yake kallo yasa ba shiri tayi gefe zata wuce ya saka hannun sa a side d’in, d’ayan side ta juya zata wuce ya ‘kara saka hannunsa , fasa zuwa inda tayi niyar zuwa tayi , shiyasa tayi saurin juyawa zata koma ya ri’ko hannunta tare da janta zuwa corridor d’in gefensu “ Mai yasa nayi miki message babu reply ? And I called you baki d’aga ba , why?” Shiru Eshaal tayi “ Uhm baka san ma me kayi ba kenan ?” Ta fad’a cikin zuciyarta, a fili kuwa “ Babu komai “ shine reply d’in da tayi masa zata juya ya ri’ko hannunta “ karmu fara irin haka , tell me , nayi laifi ? Uhm?” Girgiza masa kai Eshaal tayi , d’an shiru Bobo yayi yana kallanta kafun ya saki ajiyar zuciya “ it’s okay am sorry , please ko kina fushi dani ki dena ignoring message d’ina , tell me nayi miki laifi , I will apologize amma please banda shariya , i don’t like it , i can’t even sleep well, bansan gabaki d’ayan ku kuka fita sai da na saki Simba , you would have told me ,please “, d’an kallansa Eshaal tayi ganin duk mood d’insa ya canza sai taji wani iri cikin ranta “ Ni ba fushi nake da kai, am sorry da bakayi bacci ba” ta fad’a fuskarta a sake duk da babu wannan lallausan murmushin nata , dafe goshinsa Bobo yayi “ Ya Allah” ya fad’a cikin zuciyarsa , Jin sa yake wani irin gabaki d’aya bashi da peace of mind, “ Am Sorry Love, please don’t punish me like this , do something else amma banda wannan”. Ganin yadda gabaki d’aya yake ‘ko’karin diririce wane yasa Eshaal ta sakar masa murmushin ta da cikin Sauri ya saki a jiyar zuciya “ Dagaske am not angry Love amma bai ka mata kayi punishing d’in mu haka ba , musamman Baby tana da tsoro sosai thank god babu Wanda ya tsorata sosai”, kansa ya jinjina mata yana sakar mata murmushi “ Duk yadda Mrs Bobo ta fad’a hakan za’ayi, hannu na bisa wuya Love tayi hakuri” murmushi Eshaal ta saki tana ‘ko’karin ’boye fuskarta “ Uhmm ki dena wannan ‘boye fuskar , I can’t take it, gwanda tun yanzu ki cire ta”, wani kunyar ya bata gabaki d’aya sai ta rasa ya zatayi , sunanta da taji kamar Fanan na kiranta tayi saurin kallansa “ Bari na tafi ana ne mana” shima yaga alamar ta kasa sakewa shiyasa ya jinjina mata kansa , ta juya zata tafi ya mi’ka mata wayar “ we will talk later , okay ?” A maimakon ta amsa masan sai ta ‘kara sakar masa yalwataccen murmushin ta , tana jinjina masa kai . ABUJA 
    Rayuwa ba ‘karamin dukan su Husna yayi ba , sai a yanzu ta ‘kara shiga taitayin , bayan ‘batan su Uwar Karuwai, bata ajje makamanta ba , sai da wasu ‘yan iskan maza suka Yashe komai nata , sannan sukai mata mugun fyad’en da sai da tayi kwanaki kafun ta farfad’o daha hayyacin ta , ga wasu irin ‘kuraje da suka fito mata a jiki, kusan kullum cikin susar su take, duniya gabaki d’aya ta juya mata baya da wanda take abun dan su , hatta abuncin da zataci gagararta yake sai tayi bara tukunna . Yanzu duk Wanda yaga husna ba lalle ne ya gane taba, sai a lokacin ta fahimci Motar kwad’ayi babu Inda yake kai mutum sai tashar wula’kanci.

Mamakin ganin bata ci kine ya kamasu , motsin da suka ji a toilet ne yasa suka zauna gabaki d’aya sukai jugum jugum suna jiran fitowar ta , itama sarai ta san da shigowar ta su shiyasa ta’ki fitowa . Ajiyar zuciya Eshaal ta sauke kafun ta kalli Fanan “ she need to be alone tunda kika ga ta’ki fitowa , let’s leave her zuwa anjima idan ta sakko daga fushin sai mu dawo, ko?” Itama kallanta Fanan tayi “ Eshaal ba dan wani abu Yaya Sauban ya mareta ba , bayasan a ware irin volume haka , that’s what am trying to tell her amma bata saurare ni ba. Ina tunanin hakan ne ya ‘bata masa rai”, shiru Eshaal tayi tana Tunani “ kema kinsan Baby , kunna kid’a a ganinta ba komai bane tunda tun muna gida muke hakan, ko da ace yayi mata wani abun bazataji haushin saba , nasan Baby da kayi mata fad’a kwanda ka doke ka , and yadda naga reaction d’inta d’azu nasan kamar yayi mata fad’a ko ?” Ta ‘karasa tana mata alamar tanbaya . Kanta Kawai Fanan ta jijjiga mata dan ita kanta batasan kare kowa a cikinsu, basu zauna a d’akin ba sai da suka ‘kara jiran ta na kusan 2 minutes , ganin bata da alamar fitowa ne yasa Eshaal jan hannun Fanan suka bar d’akin. 
      Sai da ta tabbatar da fitar su tukunna ta fito daga toilet d’in, kayan jikinta ta cire sannan ta watsa ruwa abunta , tana gamawa wayarta ta d’auka tare da hayewa kan gado abunta . “ Allah sai ya saka mun”, ya fad’a a fili tana tsuke fuskarta.
