HAJIYA SA’ADATU

“ Momy yanzu ya zanyi kenan? Har yanzu bansan inda masoyi na yake ba, abun takaicin ma har waccen banzar bansan inda ya tafi da Ita ba. Wallahi Momy ina sansa, kullum sai nayi mafarkin na auresa, dön Allah Momy ko mene ne kiyi ko zan samesa, kinji Momy?” Cewar Yasmeen da take gaban Momyn nata. Nurfarfashi Hajiya Sa’adatu ta sauke “ Yasmeen a yanzu ‘kwa’kwalwata ji nake kamar zata fashe gida biyu. Abubuwa na ‘ko’karin har gitsemun, komai sai mun ajje sa a yanzu dan na lura mahaifin ki ya saka mana ido yanzu, kuskure kad’an idan mukayi asirin mu zai iya tonuwa , dole mu d’anyi ha’kuri zuwa wani lokacin, ga Yaya itama da tunda ta bar gidan nan ban kuma jin taba , balantana ta samo wata mafitar “, Yasmeen kamar zatayi kuka ta furta “ Kina nufin wai yanzu Momy babu abunda zakiyi kenan? Idan waccen shegiyar ta shanye shifa?shikenan fa Momy bazan dunga samun damar ganin saba , dan Allah koma menene Momy kiyi gaskiya bazan iya ha’kuri dashi ba”, tsaki Hajiya Sa’adatu ta d’an ja “ Duk ba wannan ba , ya akai kwanakin baya na ganki yashe a falour?” Zaro mata idanuwa Yasmeen tayi , kamar wacce aka fad’awa wani mugun abu har ta tsure “ uhm nidai Momy mu bar wannan maganar yanzu, da fatalwar da na gani ko sunan ta aka ambata sai na ganta acikin idanuwa na, kinga Momy karma ki fara na tafi d’aki na”. Cikin sauri Yasmeen ta bar d’akin ko jiran jin amsar Momyn nata ba tayi ba . Tun lokacin da ta ga Aljanar Baby gabaki d’aya ta soma daburcewa. 

*********
A ‘bangaran su Harry kuwa gabaki d’aya jiya kasa runtsawa sukai , ba abunda Harry take tunanin kamar mijin da Dad d’inta yasa ta fito dashi,hankalinta ba ‘karamun tashi yayi ba dan gabaki d’aya bata tunanin auran da yace zai ‘kara , ita matsalar ta yadda zata nemo Big Boss kawai shine a gabanta, shiyasa ta kira wata ‘kawarta da duk wasu shawarwari Itace take bata , shawarar da ta bata a yanzu ma da ita tayi anfani, kamar wata mutuniyar arzi’ki ta shirya cikin abaya tare da rolling d’in mayafin ta , d’akin Momy da ta buga uban ta gumi ta nufa , d’an ta’be bakinta Harry tayi dan gani take ita ta samo maganin matsalar ta , babu sallama babu komai ta furta “ Momy zanje school akwai wani text da zamuyi “, da mamaki Hajiya Falmata ta kalleta “ Text kuma ? Yaushe kika soma damuwa da wani text yanzu?” ‘Bata fuska Harry tayi “ Momy kinsan dai yanzu bani da time tunda na makara kuma du du du bazan wuce 1 hour ba zan dawo kin san idan Dady ya shiga ya tarar da Ina latti bazai barni na fita ba kinga zan fad’i a makaranta ga ran Dady da shima zai ‘baci kuma duk sai ta shafemu “, wani gwauron numfashi ta sauke dan gabaki d’aya bata fahimtar abunda Harry d’in take cewa sosai , shiyasa kawai ta d’auke kanta “ A dawo lapiya amma karki dad’e kınsan yadda ya hau , kuskure d’aya idan mukai akan mu zai wuce “ Momy sai dai ya wuce a kanki wallahi amma bani ba “, ta fad’a ’kasan zuciyarta a fili kuma itama d’an yatsına face tayi kamar wacce take cikin damuwa “ shikenan Momy bari nayi sauri na dawo “, tana fad’in haka bata jira answer Momyn ba tayi wucewarta hankali kwance . 

    Tana fitowa Driver da wasu security’s guda biyu suka ‘karaso Inda take daman hakan ne ke faruwa yawanci duk Wanda zai fita sai da Driver ko security , dan da ‘kyar suke samun fita su kad’ai shima sai sun tabbatar dasu Abbu basa cikin gidan . Yanzu ma ‘bata rai tayi ganin suna ‘ko’karin ’bata mata shirin ta , cikin sauri ta dakatar dasu “ Ba wani dad’ewa zanyi ba, result kawai zan kar’ba a cikin school , Driver Kawai ya Isah mu tafi”, Isah driver zai soma tafiya d’aya daga cikin securities d’in yayi ‘ko’karin magana tayi saurin dakatar dashi ganin yana ‘bata mata lokaci “ shikenan kuyi Sauri please kuna ‘batan lokaci. Kasantuwar ta ce result kawai zata amsa yasa daga Isah driver sai security guda d’aya da suka tafi tare , hakan da yayın kuma ba ‘karamin dad’a d’a mata yayi ba , sai kallan lokaci take batasan yin latti ko kuma abunda zai ‘bata mata shirin ta gabaki d’aya . 
    
    A wajan fita daga gidan basu Samu matsala ba sabida security d’in da aka gani a ciki ga kuma driver , suna fita ta saki ajiyar zuciya , cikin tsa’kuwa da ‘bacin rai ta furta “ Ya kake tu’ki kamar kana shafa mai ? Bani da lokaci idan ba so kake na makara ba, idan zakayi abu da sauri kayi, idan kuma baza kayi ba ka bani mukullin mota ni sai na tu’ka. Duk da a shekaru Isha driver zai iya jiki da ita bai ce mata komai ba sai ha’kuri da ya bata dan sosai yasan halinta ba ‘karamun aikinta bane ta tsinka masa mari kamar yadda ta ta’bayi a kwanakin baya , shiyasa ba shiri ya ‘kara gudun motar . 
    
     Direct Babcock University suka nufa, gabaki d’aya Harry tunanin yadda zata tsere musu take , wani idea ne ya fad’o mata shiyasa ta saki murmushin mugunta tare da d’aukan wayar ta tura text ta wani number . Sai da suka shiga ciki tukunna Harry tayi saurin dakatar da su dan ko makarantar bata san a san da zuwan ta . “ Bari naje na dawo”, ta fad’a zata bud’e ’kofa , da Sauri security ya bud’e mata ‘kofa , zata soma tafiya ya bi bayanta , a yatsine ya furta “ Har cikin ajin zaka bini ne ? Yau bana bu’kata tunda ba wani abu zanyi ba , ina gama abunda zanyi zan fito mu tafi.” Babu musu suka dakata , Harry tana shiga cikin wani department tayi dialing wata number , cikin za’kuwa take furta “ wai kina ina ? Ya kamata kiyi sauri tun kafin shirina ya lallace , bani da isashshen lokaci ya kamata kiyi sauri “, banji me aka ce mata ba wai ‘karamun dariya da tayi “ shikenan kiyi Sauri ina wajan da kika da mukayi zamu had’u , tana gama wayar ta kashe ta gabaki d’aya tare da saka ta cikin jaka.
    Ba’a d’auki dogon lokaci ba wata siririn budurwa ta ‘karaso wajan sai faman tauna take tana ya mutsa fuska yadda take abu mutum zai fahimci ba ‘karamar yar duniya bace , suna ganin suna sukai hugging d’in juna , ganin babu kowa a ciki gashi bai fi d’ad’d’ai kun mutane ba a ciki, budurwar kiss tayi mata a kumatu, tana binta da wani irin kallo, Harry ko damuwa da hakan batayi ba ta furta “ Bamu da lokaci fa “ daga inda suke budurwar ta nuna mata wata ba’kar mota sa’banin side d’in da su isha driver suke , kuma babu ta yadda zasu iya hango su, cikin sauri ta nufi motar ‘kawarta na bunta a baya, batare da damuwa ba ta fad’a cikin motar , tana shiga taga maza guda biyu a ciki, ganin babu space sosai kawai ta haye cinyar d’aya daga cikinsu, gabaki d’aya sai suka fashe da dariya , a guje d’aya daga cikinsu ya tayar da motar suka bar wajan, already sunyi planning yadda zasu bar school d’in gashi kuma private university basu samu matsala ba suka fita daga makarantar ba tare da sanin security d’in da suka zo tare ba .
    Isah driver da security sunfi hour d’aya suna jiran fitowarta, amma still haka suka ‘kara jiranta, sai da suka d’auki good 4 hours suna jiran fitowarta, ganin zaman nasu yayi yawa yasa suka nufi inda ta nufa , suna shiga suka tarar da ba kowa a wajan ma , tanbayar wasu daga cikin student d’in sukai ko sun ganta amma yawanci kowa fad’a musu yake bai ganta bq , da’kar suka sami wadda ta ganta , cikin rashin sa’a ta sanar dasu barin ta school d’in tun awannin baya. Ba ‘karamun mamaki da tashin hankali suka shiga ba ganin ta dad’e da barin makarantar, still basu tafi ba sai da suka ‘kara duddubawa ko zata dawo , tun sunayi har suka ha’kura suka koma gida . Suna shiga security d’in ya nufi side d’in Harry, sai faman had’a gumin tashin hankali yake.

      A cikin gidan kuwa Momy taje d’aukowa Dady wani fruits salad da tayi masa sai ta bar wayarta a gefensa, shaf ta manta da ita a Wajan. Tana barin wajan kuwa message yashigo wayarta , kallan wayar yayi sai kuma ya d’auke kansa, wani message d’in da ya kuma jine yasa ba d’auki wayar “ My daughter “ shine abunda ya fito , haka kawai Dady ya bud’e message d’in, karanta sa’kon ciki ya somayi yana na nata innalillahi wa inna ilaihi raji’un cikin zuciyarta , Momy tana fitowa gabanta ya fad’i ganin wayarta a hannunsa ga yanayin fuskar sa ya canza , da ‘kyar ta iya furta “ Alhaji lafiya kuwa ?” Wayar ya mi’ko mata ba tare da ya kalleta ba ya furta “ karanta sa’kon ciki yanzu ki karanta mun”, gabanta ne ya fad’i cikin sauri ta ajje fruit salad d’in, hannunta har rawa yake lokacin da take karanta message d’in kamar haka “ Momy na fad’a miki bazan iya rayuwa babu mijin da nake so ba , Dady na ‘ko’karin la’kabamun wannan shirmen nasa, kinsan halinsa ko tausayin mutane ba yayi , taya kamata zai ce zai sani dole na fito da muji? Kamar ni? Bazan yadda da wannan abun ba shiyasa ta bar gidan, Momy da nace miki zanje school muna da text babu wani text da zani kawai sabida na güdü ne , karki sha wahalar nema na dan bazaki same ni ba , kisan yadda zakiyi wa Dady magana dan bazan dawo ba har sai ya janye maganarsa BYE”, dafe ‘kirjinta Momy tayi sabida wani irin kallo da yake jefa mata , hannu ya bata alamar ta bashi wayar, cikin rawar hannu ta mi’ka masa wayar , rai  a’bace ya furta “ idan kika kuskura kikayi wa wani maganar abakin Auran ki , ita kuma taje duk inda taga damar zuwa , waya kuma daga yau na kar’ba zan baki wacce zaki dunga anfani da ita amma ba wannan ba , dafe ‘kirji Momy tayi zata soma ro’kan sa ya daka mata tsawa ganin yadda ranshi ya ‘baci sama da jiya , hatta abincin fasa ci yayi yana fita ta d’ora hannu aka “ kin kashe ni wallahi, Harira kin kashe yi , ya kike so nayi yanzu ? Shegiya tsinanniya , yanzu bansan ya zanyi ba “ shine abunda take maimaita wa ji tayi kamar juwa na ‘ko’karin kayar da ita shi yasa tayi saurin zubewa a ‘kasa ba tare da ta damu da hawa kan kujera ba .Dady yana fitowa yana securityn , cikin Sauri ya nufo Dady , lokaci d’aya Dady ya fahimce , bai tsaya sauraran jin bayanin sa ba ya furta “ Nasan da hakan zaka iya komawa bakin aikin ka “, ajiyar zuciya ya sauke mai ‘karfi jin abunda Dady yace , a hakan ya koma bakin aikinsa shi kuma Dady ya wuce part d’in His Excellency.

   PRISON 
      Daga Nani har Momy rayuwa tayi musu mugun zafi sabida rayuwar prison d’in gabaki d’aya babu dad’i duk da babu duka ko zagi da ake musu amma yadda zasu kwana su tashi babu Wanda ya kula su yafi komai tsaya musu arai musamman Momy da take ita kad’ai kullum kamar mayya . Nani kuwa abun ya had’e mata waje d’aya ga rashin idanuwa ga ciwan da ta janyo wa kanta , gabaki d’aya duk Wanda yaga Nani yanzu ba lalle ne ya gane taba, dan gabaki d’aya ta fice daga hayyacin ta kullum tana kwance hatta ban d’akı yanxu sai ta dogara sanda tukunna take iya gane hanyar , tunani gabaki d’aya yayi mata yawa babu abunda take iya cewa sai “ ku kaini gıda “ ko kuma “ Sindilu kamar mun da idanuwana”. Suka d’aine maganganun da take iyawa .

FIFTH AVENUE

Gabaki d’aya wunin ranar Big Boss bai fita ba ya tare da Babyn sa , yadda suke kula da junan sune yafi kowa burgewa . Yanzu ma Abla tsaye take a gaban mirror sai faman fesa turare take tunda yace mata ta shirya , bakinta sosai yaji lipgloss sai shinning yake , ba ‘karamun Abla tayi ba dan sosai shigar tayi mata kyau ba kad’an ba , ‘kamshin turaren sa  da tajine yasa ta juyo da sauri tana kallansa , fingers d’inta d’aya ta girgiza tana kashe masa kyau “ Kayi kyau sosai “ binta da kallo Big Boss yayi har ya ‘karaso Inda take , bai ce mata komai ba sai lips d’insu da ya had’e , bai cika mata suba sai da ya tabbatar babu lipgloss d’innan gabaki d’aya , ‘bata face tayi ka ‘bata mun kwalliya na fa,” tana ‘ko’karin saka wani ya kar’ba “ it’s only for me , a part from me ban yadda kowa yaga anything makamancin sa, okay?” Kanta Abla ta jinjina masa , hannunta ya kama suka fito daga d’akin bayan face mask da suka saka daga shi har itan , basu d’auki wani dogon lokaci ba suka bar gidan gabaki d’aya. 
       Sai da sukayi tafiyar kusan mintuna 15 tukunna suka zo wani gida da ya gaji da had’uwa, ga securities ta ko ina da suke shawagi a cikin gidan. Wani irin iska ne taji yana kad’a ta, ta ko ina na jikinta , cikin ‘kan’kanin lokaci taji jikinta yayi sanyi gabaki d’aya , hannunta da ya kama ne yasa tayi saurin kallansa, shima ya fahimci hakan shiyasa ya ‘kara ri’ke mata hannun nata, a hankali kuma ya na matsa mata su har suka shiga cikin gidan. Saurin zame hannunta Abla tayi ganin wata kyakkyawar mace akan Kujera , jikinta sanye da material da ya haskaka fatar jikinta , fuskarta kwance yake da yalwataccen murmushi, tana had’a ido da Abla tayi saurin mi’kewa tsaye tana kallanta , a d’aya ’bangaran kuma tana kallan Big Boss hannunta har rawa yake , itama Abla wani irin abu ta soma ji cikin zuciyarta, cikin sauri Big Boss ya ‘karasa wajan matar tare da ri’ke mata hannunta , kamar dama jiran hakan take , a sukwane ta rirri’kesa , wasu irin hawaye masu zafi na ‘ko’karin sakko mata , cikin Sauri ya hana hakan ta hanyar girgiza mata kanta “ AMMIMI …please “, sunan da ya kira ne yasa Abla tayi saurin kallan matar da ya ambata da Ammimi, tabbas idan bata manta ba taji sunan a diary d’insa , kasa motsi Abla tayi balantana ta motsa lips d’in bakinta . Murya a karye matar ta furta “ My son ka fad’amun abunda nake hasashe gaskiya ne , dan Allah ka fad’a mun karka sakani a cikin duhu,” murmushi ya sakar mata sosai yana ri’ke hannunta , da fillanci  furta “ Dagaske ne Ammimi,ba mafarki bane, itace, kamar yadda nayi miki al’kawarin nemota, itace Ammimi”, bai ‘karasa ba Ammimi tayi hugging d’insa a cikinta “ you’re the best son ever, tabbas ka cika al’kawarin ka “, ganin tana ‘ko’karin magana ya ‘kara fad’in “ let’s leave it a secret  for now Ammimi , am going to be a father soon Amimimi”, murmushi sosai Ammimi d’in ta saki tana Kallan Abla, a hankali ta soma a jiyar zuciya kafun ta kalli Abla da gabaki d’aya ta tsargu jin yadda suka canza harshe, hannu Ammimi ta mi’ka mata, ba musu kuwa ta ‘kara wajan Ammimi ta rungumeta sosai a jikin ta “ Kiyi hakuri da kalar rayuwar da kika tsinci kanki a ciki my daughter, dole ce ta sakani hakan , am so sorry “, ta fad’a ’kasan zuciyarta a zahiri kuwa murmushi take ta saki tana ‘boye ‘kwallar da take ‘ko’karin sakko mata , wani irin relief Abla taji a ranta kamar wacce aka kwashewa wani abu mai ‘karfi daga ‘kasan zuciyarta , farin ciki da annashuwa ne ya kamata lokaci d’aya shiyasa ta ‘kara lafewa a jikin matar tana sakin ajiyar zuciya , murmushi kawai Big Boss ya saki lokacin da Ammimi take tapping bayanta , gabaki d’aya sun kasa rabuwa da juna , wani murmushi ya ‘kara saki ba tare da ya furta komai ba ya fice daga falourn, hatta Abla dake rungume da Ammimi batasan lokacin da ya fita ba.
    Sun jima rungume da juna babu Wanda kuma yayi magana a cikin su , shigowar Big Boss yasa Ammimi ta kallesa tare da murmushin ta mai shegen kyau da ya ‘kara fito da kyawunta, da ‘kyar Abla ta iya d’agata dan ji take da za’a barta a hakan da ya fi mata dad’i, bata san ya akai ba , batasan dalili ba , wani irin soyayyar matar ne yake shiga cikin zuciya da bargon jikinta ta ko ina , wani irin so mai kama da na ‘yar da take wa iyayenta ne taji yana shiga ko wana lungu da sa’ko na cikin zuciyarta . A ‘bangaran Ammimin ma haka ne , har lokacin hannunta yana ri’ke da na Abla , farin cikin ta ya kasa ‘boyuwa irin na mahaifiyar da ta d’auko dogon shekaru tana beğen ‘yarta , a d’aya ‘bangaran kuma hannun Big Boss ne , batasan lokacin da ta had’e hannun su waje d’aya ta sun bata ba, Abla batasan ya akai ba gabaki d’aya ruhi da gangar jikinta ya fad’a jikin Ammimi, akaro na biyu ta ‘kara hugging d’inta , bakinta har rawa yake lokacin da take furta “ Ammi na” cikin ‘kan’kanin lokaci kuka ya ‘kwace mata , itama Ammin kukanta take dannewa sai murmushin da take ‘ko’karin yi, kamar yadda Abla tayi hugging d’inta itama hakan tayi ana ta ‘bangaran. 
    Big Boss da ke kallansu jiyai wani irin abu mai kama da mashi yana ta’ba cikin zuciyarsa , wani irin zafi da tafarfasa zuciyarsa ta soma , yana ‘ko’karin tashi Ammimi tayi saurin ri’ke hannun sa , dan babu Wanda ya san sa aduniya kamar yadda ta şansa . Kanta Kawai ta girgiza masa har lokacin bata sakar masa hannun saba kuma. 
      Cikin Sauri Abla ta d’agata kanta a sunkuye ta furta “ kiyi hakuri” shafa gefen fuskarta Ammimi tayi tana kallan kamannin Wanda bazata ta’ba mantawa ba , cikin sanyayyiyar muryarta mai sanyaya zuciyar mutum ta furta “ Nima Mom d’inki ce , daga yanzu ma Ammi zaki dunga cemun, dan babu ruwana da wannan mijin naki”, Abla batasan lokacin da murmushi ya ‘kwace mata ba , cikin Sauri ta jinjina mata kai “ Kina jin yunwa ko?” Cikin sauri Abla tayi knodding kanta, hannunsu gabaki d’aya Ammimi ta kama zuwa dinning , da kanta tayi serving cikin plate d’aya bayan ta zauna a tsakiyar su, ita da kanta ta soma feeding d’insu da hannayenta , cikin sauri Abla take göğe hawayen da suke ‘ko’karin sakko mata , wani irin so mai kama da na rashin mahaifiya ne ya ke mata yawo cikin zuciya , jinta take kamar ba ita ba , jinta take kamar a cikin wata sabuwar duniyar daban , Ammimi ma da ‘kyar ta iya danne hawenta, hannunta Big Boss ya ri’ke kafin ya kalli Abla “ ki bata a baki” kamar jira Abla take ta soma bawa Ammimi abincin abaki kamar yadda tayi musu , shima Big Boss hannu ya saka yana bata abinci, hakan ba ‘karamun farin ciki ya sakata ba , sai da ya tabbatar ya ‘koshi tukunna ya barta. Da suka dawo falourn ma a ‘kasa Ammimi ta zauna tare da nuna musu Laps d’inta , Abla tayi Tuna’nın tausa za’a yi mata , tana ‘ko’karin yin hakan Ammimi tayi mata alamar ta kwantar da kanta , d’ayan Side d’in kuma ta kalli Big Boss , gabaki d’aya suka kwanta , farin cikin ta kasa ‘boyuwa yayi yadda suka kwanta ba ‘karamun dad’i taji ba shiyasa ta saka hannayenta biyu tana shafa kansu gabaki d’aya . A haka bacci ya d’auke su gabaki d’aya daga Abla har Big Boss d’in, Ammimi babu abunda take sai murmushi da shafa kansu, ita kad’ai sai ajiyar zuciya take saukewa akai akai.

NIGERIA

  ‘Karfe 9pm na dare gabaki d’aya familyn gidan suna had’u banda Baby da ta’ki zuwa, sai kuma Sauban da shima baizo wajan ba dan hatta Bobo ya shigo falour, Harry kuwa babu Wanda yasan Inda take , lokacin da Abbu ya tanbayi Hajiya Falmata ‘ko’karin da burcewa tayi , ganin irin kallan da Uncle Adam ya jefa mata , cikin Sauri ta furta “ taje gidan Aunty ne ,” ita kanta bata san lokacin da hakan ya fito daga cikin bakinta ba . Babu Wanda ya kawo komai cikin ransa , bayan itama an tanbayi Baby da Sauban kusan a lokaci d’aya Eshaal da Bobo Suka furta “ Headache”, kallansu Abbu yayi bai ce komai ba sai murmushi kawai . Gabaki d’aya kowa ya hallara a falourn shiyasa aka ‘kara bud’e taro da addua , Dadyn Eshaal ba baya wajan shiyasa Abbu yayi shiru baiyi maganar su Bobon da yace za’ayi ba gashi Sauban d’in ma baya nan shiyasa Abbu ya bar maganar zuwa gobe .


****** Baby ganin tsitt alamar sun tafi meeting d’in da Suke mata magiyar taje amma ta’ki zuwa , mi’kewa tayi ta fito falourn daga ita sai wata doguwar riga da ta wuce kwiwarta da kad’an, headphone ne a kunnanta tana jin wa’ka sai kanta da take d’an girgiza zawa kad’an kad’an, bata sani ba mistakenly ‘kafarta ta zame lokacin da zata hau stairs d’in dinning, gadan gadan ta taho zata zame ta gaba, ga zafin da taji a ‘kafarta, a tsorace Baby ta saki ‘kara lokacin da kanta yake ‘ko’karin bugar stairs d’in……

Tazo muku da ingantattu ko sahihan magungunan mata masu inganci, ba’anan kad’ai ta tsaya ba har da na cututtuka da Turarukan wuta , Humra masu shegen ‘kaushi . Abun Alfaharin kuma tana bada sarı cikin sau’ki, sannan kuma suna aikawa duk inda mutum yake afad’in duniyar nan. 

Duk wacce ta siya magungunan Hajiya Nusaiba Dr B zuru, taga be yi mata aiki ba tazo za’a dawo miki da kudin ki .

Shigowar sa kenan falourn , bai san lokacin da ya ‘karasa wajan ta ba , cikin azama ya ri’ke hannunta ganin tana ‘ko’karin fad’uwa ’kasa . Ajiyar zuciya Baby ta sauke mai ‘karfi ganin bata fad’i ba , a hankali ta d’ago kanta dan ganin wane ne ya taimaka mata, Sauban da ta gani tsaye a wajan yasa tayi saurin janye jikinta , fuskarta a had’e kamar ba Baby ba ta furta “ Thanks “, bata jira ya amsa ba ko bai amsa ba tayi shigewarta kitchen . Haka kawai ya soma binta da kallo har ta shige kitchen “ Thanks ?” Ya ‘kara nanatawa cikin zuciyarsa , sai kuma ya ta’be baki kad’an , tare da juyawa ya bar Wajan, a maimakon ya zauna a falourn sai ya fice gabaki d’aya daga ciki. Itama Baby bata fito ba sai da ta tabbatar ya bar falourn , tana fitowa ta bankawa hanyar shigowa hararar kamar yana tsaye a wajan, “ Mugu” ta fad’a tana ya tsina fuskarta kafun tayi wucewarta d’akı abunta .

Su Eshaal basu dawo d’akin ba sai da kowa ta gama zancanta, suna shigowa suka tarar da Ita a zaune ga wayarta da take chart da ‘ita , “ Baby baki da mutunci wallahi, babu yadda bamu ro’ke kiba akan kizo muje meeting amma kika mayar damu ‘yan iska ko? Toh gobe Abbu yace zaiyi magana da kowa da kowa , kice bazaki je ba , kamar wani had’in baki daga ke har Yaya Sauban kuka ‘ki zuwa , anya kuwa ?” Kallanta Baby tayi rai a ‘bace , harara ta banka mata zatayi magana sai kuma ta fasa ta cigaba da danna wayarta , “ wai ba dake nake magana ba ?” Cewar Fanan ganin yadda ta shareta, ‘karamun tsaki Baby ta ja kad’an “ Ke dai kika sani, komai zaki fad’a ki fad’a karki cika ni da sürü…” bata ‘karasa ba sabida wayanta da ta soma ringing , murmushi ta saki sosai akan face d’in ta ganin mai kiran, sakin baki Fanan da Eshaal sukai suna binta da kallo kamar bata san sunayi ba tayi picking kiran tare da karawa a kunnanta “ Aslm My Man”,  Eshaal har da zaro ido jin abunda Baby tace gashi gabaki d’aya ta mayar dasu ‘yan iska dan kashe murya tayi tana soyayyar ta kamar bata san da zaman su , gabaki d’ayan su kuma basu motsa ba sai binta da kallo da suke har ta gama wayar “ Mene ne wai kuke kallo na haka ?” A maimakon su amsa mata sai tanbayar da Eshaal ta yi mata itama “ Naji kina My Man ? Yaushe kika soma soyayya bamu sani ba?” Dariya Baby tayi sosai tana kashe musu ido d’aya “ ina malamar soyayya kuma na’kiyin soyayya? Don’t worry sunan sa Anwar and shi zan aura sooner or later insha Allah “, ta’be baki Fanan tayi dan haka kawai taji bataji dad’in saurayin da Baby tayi ba , ta so ace kamar yadda suke soyayya da su Little itama ta fara soyayya da Yaya Sauban, dan gabaki d’aya Anwar da ta fad’a yasa mood d’in ta canzawa kad’an.”itama Eshaal kusan hakan ne a nata ‘bangaran, taso ace da Yaya Sauban d’in suke soyayya amma duk da batasan ko wanene Anwar ba , in dai Dagaske yana san ta , she will be happy “, ajiyar zuciya ta sauke tare da mi’kewa ganin Baby ta koma ta kwanta , bata kuma cewa ‘kala ba ta nufi hanyar toilet. Fanan kuma gabaki d’aya tunanin yadda zata had’a yayanta soyayya da Baby take , dan ta ko wana fanni tasan halinsu . Message d’in Little ne ya kawar da tunanin da take yi, murmushi ta sakar masa sosai lokacin da take masa reply d’in message d’in sa .

BLACK SPIDER 

     Wani irin meeting d’in gaggawa suka had’a  tsakar dare   bayan kowa ya gama hallara sukai abun tsafikansu da su ka saba kamar ko da yaushe . ‘Daya daga cikin su da ko kusa mutum bazai fuskan ci yanayin sa ko wani alamar ta jikinsa ba ya mi’ke tsaye , dan hatta idanuwansu ba’a gani, mutumin jikinsa har rawa yake cikin Tashin hankali . Da wani irin yare da ba’a gane kansa , cikin muryarsa mai ‘karfi ya furta “ abubuwa suna neman dagule mana cikin ‘kan’kanin lokaci, mai yasa sai da buri na ya kusa cika komai yake neman lalacewa ? Nayi sadaukarwa, na zubar da jini, nayi kisa duk sabida cikar burina, komai na sadaukarwa nayi , an ina kuskuren yake ? Mai yasa sai bayan na gama had’a masarautata ina ‘ko’karin gına tanbari wani yayi ‘ko’karin ruguzawa ? Mai yasa ? Shekaru da yawa na d’auka inq san cika buri na amma cikin ‘kan’kanin lokaci kuma a samu wani yana ruguzamun? Dan me ?” Ya fad’a da d’an ‘karfi. Wani irin dariya d’aya daga cikin su ya somayi kamar wani mahaukaci haka yake dariyar cike da ‘keta , sai da yayi don kansa tukunna ya kalli mutumin “ Na fad’a maka kashe gabaki d’aya ahalin shine na sarar ka amma sa’banin hakan dole wani jinin ya mamaye maka idanuwa kadunga ganin duhu a tattare da kai , sadaukarwa, ka sadaukar da jinin mutane dan samun biyan bu’katar ka ,” huci mutumin ya soma fitarwa, yana ‘ko’karin magana wajan ya ‘kaure da ba’kin haya’ki mai kama da guguwa , kusan tsawan mintuna d’aya guguwar na tashi kafun ta dakata, wani irin sauti mara dad’in ji ne ya cika wajan kafun ya tsagaita . Gabaki d’ayan su sujjana sukayi tare da mi’kar da hannayen su sama suna wani irin yare mara dad’in ji. Kusan tsawan mintina 2 suna abu d’aya wani irin halitta ya bayyana a kan kujera mai tanbarin gizo gizo , gabaki d’aya mutum bazai iya banbance mace bane ko na miji Sabida yadda halittar mai shi ta sauka , ga wasu zanen gizo gizo dake jikinsa ta ko ina hatta sandar tsafinsa abun gizo gizon ne a jiki , finger d’insa d’aya ya motsa gabaki d’aya suka mi’ke tsaye tare da komawa kan kujerun su, cikin wani irin murya mutumin ya soma magana “ Kana da damar ‘karshe kawai , kuskuren aikin da zakayi shine zai zama silar rugujewar ayyukanta da ka d’au shekaru kana aikata su, dole a wannan karan kayi sadaukarwa mai girman gaske, kammaluwar sadaukarwa shine ciko makan burinka, rugujewar hakan kuma kamar ya da’bawa kanka wu’kane dan bazaka ta’ba cin nasara ba . A tafe suke , idanuwansu a bud’e yake yanzu , kyakkyawan jini ya gama zagaya ko ina , waje d’aya ne basu san da zubar saba , rashin kammalashi ne kawai zai baka tarin mafarkin ka .” Yana gama magana sai ga wata wu’ka ta fad’o a gaban mutumin “ da wannan wu’kar kawai zakayi sadaukarwa, dole kaje ka kashe mutumin da kake dakin ajiya tsawan shekaru, dole jininsa ya zama na sadaukarwa, rashin kashesa da zakayi shine babban kuskuranka. Kada kayi gangancin jinin wani ya ta’ba wu’kar nan ba tasa ba.” Diffft wayan ya d’au shiru bayan ‘bacewa shugaban nasu , wu’kar mutumin ya dam’ka a hannunsa yana shafawa a saman goshinsa , lokaci d’aya ya soma wani irin surutai mata dad’in ji . Bai bayyana a ko ina ba sai a gaban Ammun su Big Boss . A hankali ta soma d’ago kanta tana ‘ko’karin bud’e idanuwanta , kasa bud’esu tayi sai lullumshe su da take sake yi Sabida yadda Wajan ya kunbura. Wani irin shegen dariya ne ya ‘kaurace wajan, sosai mutumin yake dariya kafun ya kalleta ya kum kalli wu’kar hannunsa. “Kinga wannan wu’kar? Ina so kiganta kafin naje nayi sadaukar wata ta ‘karshe “, duk da bata da ‘karfi a jikinta hakan bai sa ta d’ago da Sauri ba , jikinta har karkarwa yake tana san yin magana “ Wa… wa.. zaka kashe ?” Ta fad’a cikin rarrabewar kalma , dariya mutumin yayi mata ba tare da cewa komai ba ya ‘kara ‘bacewa . Jijjiga kanta ta soma yi a hankali “ Ah’ah , karka kashe.. shi , karka kashe…. , karka kashe shi” kalmar da bakinta yake iya ambata kenan cikin tsananin rud’ewa da tashin hankali. 
     Mutumin kuwa tun da ya ‘bace siddabarun sa ya cigaba da yi , har sai da ya bayyana cikin wani d’akin me duhu gaske , sai d’an hasken window da yake shigowa cikin d’akin . Hasken fitula ya kunna , lokaci d’aya ko ina ya gaure da haske, ga mutumin da ya ‘kulle a tsaye jikinsa duk jini fuskarsa a rufe da wani mayafi, yadda yake a tsaye kamar zai fad’i ‘kasa , igiyar da aka ‘kulle sa dashi ne ya te maka masa . Kallan wu’kar mutumin yayi kafin ya ‘karaso wajan , batare da ya cire masa abun fuskar ba ya soma magana “ Naso na barka da rai Sabida san da nake maka , amma kuma barin ka araye kamar toh nuwar asiri na ne da ruguza duk wani buri nawa , dole na za’bi d’aya a ciki, bazan ta’ba yadda buri na ya salwanta ba , tsawan shekaru na d’auka Ina gina masautata, lokaci d’aya bazan d’auki a sara ba, zan kai ka inda zakayi bacci, kai tayin baccin ka hankali a kwance kafun sauran suma su biyo ka ,” yana kai ‘karshen maganar sa ya saka masa wu’ka. Shure shure ya somayi cikin tsananin azaba yana san ‘kwatar kansa , amma hakan ya gagara , mutumin kuwa sai faman zaro wu’kar yake yana ‘kara caccaka masa cikin rashin imani, cikin wani irin gurnani kamar Wanda zanshi zai fita mutumin ya soma jijjiga, tun yanayi da iya ‘karfinsa har jikinsa ya sage sai jini da yake matu’kar zuba daga jikinsa . Sai da ya tabbatar ya mutu tukunna ya zare abun fuskar mutumin, cikin tsantsan rud’u da tashin hankali ya ja baya, sabida tsananin firgita ga jini da gabaki d’aya ya ‘bata jikin wu’kar…..

USA
   A gidan Ammimi suka kwana gabaki d’ayan su , da ‘kyar Big Boss ya barta suka kwana d’aki d’aya dan gabaki d’aya kasa runtsawa yayi ganin Babyn shi bata kusa dashi. 

NEXT DAY 

    Tun kafun Abla ta farka daga bacci Big Boss ya bar gidan sabida aikin da zaiyi na gaggawa shiyasa ya barta a cikin. 
    Itama Abla da ta farka kunyar tanbayar inda yake tayi shiyasa tayi shurun ta , dan Ita kanta tasan bazata iya ba . Ammimi da kanta tayi wa Abla Breakfast d’in da zataci, duk yadda taso no’kewa Ammimi ta share ta , da kanta tayi feeding d’inta kamar jiya , cikin ‘kan’kanin lokaci Abla ta sake da ita sosai. Yanzu kwance take akan wani carfet mai shegen laushi, kanta na kan Ammimi da ta kwantar mata dashi, a hankali Ammimi take shafa kan nata, fuskarta cike da murmushi mai ‘kayatarwa . Ganin shirun Ablan yayi ya wane yasa Ammimi furta “ My daughter kinyi bacci?” Girgiza kanta Abla tayi kafun ta furta “ A’ah Ammi , ido na biyu “ ajiyar zuciya Ammimi ta sauke mai ‘karfi , wani irin dad’i na ratsa ga’b’ban jikinta , jin kalmar “ Ammi” da Abla ta ambata . Har lokacin kuma bata dena shafa kan nafa ba “ Daughter kina da bu’katar wani abune ?” Yanzu ma kanta Abla ta girgiza mata tana mi’kewa zaune “ No Ammi, kinga na dad’e a kwance kar na saki ciwan ‘kafa bari na matsa miki,” murmushi Ammimi ta sakar mata tana bin face d’inta da kallo, a haka Abla ta soma matsawa Ammin ‘kafa. Tana yin d’an kad’an Ammimi ta dakatar da Ita “ ya isah haka, bake kad’ai bace yanzu karki jima kanki ciwo”, wani irin kunya ne ya kama Abla jin abunda Ammimi tace , sarai kuma ta fahimci hakan shiyasa ta murmusa abunta . 
    ‘Kamshin turaran da suka ji ne yasa gabaki d’aya suka d’ago da kansu. Cikin Sauri kuma Abla ta mayar da nata ‘kasa . Cikin takun sa da yasa ya ‘karaso cikin falourn , a sid’e d’in Ammimi ya zauna yana bata side hug “ Missed you Ammimi “ murmushi Ammi ta sakar masa tana ‘kara hugging d’insa “ Nima nayi missing Lion d’ina . Kana jin yunwa?”lumshe mata ido yayi ba tare da yace komai ba . Hakan da yayi ne ya bata amsar tanbayar da tayi masa . Ta ‘kasan ido kuma Abla da ta sunkuyar da kai yake kalla, sosai yayi missing d’inta , kallan time yayi , kafun ya kalli Ammimi “ First Love we have to go now”, ya fad’a yana d’an matsa hannunta, murmushi ta saki sosai duk da ta fahimce sa , amma bata nuna masa ba sai kallansa da ta kuma yi cike da tsokana “ Ba zakabar mun ita tayi mun 2 month”, baisan lokacin da ya furta “ First Love please “, dariya ya bata shiyasa ta d’an dara , mai da kallanta tayi kan Abla “My daughter kinji mijinki yana san tafiya da ke, ni kuma ina so ya barmun ke kiyi kwana ki, ai zaki zauna ko?” Abla rasa amsar fad’a tayi shiyasa ta jinjina kanta alamar “ Eh”. Yadda take sunkuye da kanta tana jin alamar idanuwansa akanta , maganar Ammimi ce ta dawo da ita daga tunanin da take ‘ko’karin fad’awa “ it’s okay, amma Yaushe za’a dawo mun da Ita ?” Shiru Big Boss yayi kafun ya furta “ Anytime you want” kansa Ammi ta shafa “ Allah yayi maka albarka my son,” yanzu ma lumshe mata ido yayi . Kama hannun Abla , Ammimi tayi tana kallan Big Boss “ yanzu zan dawo maka da Matar ka “, tana fad’in haka ta soma tafiya hannunta cikin na Abla . Ajiyar zuciya Big Boss ya saki jin abunda tace , kusan tsawan 5 minutes yana zaune a Wajan , sai ga Abla ta fito daga d’akin, Ammimi na binta a baya. “ mun barka kana jiran mu ko?” Girgiza mata kansa yayi alamar ah’ah, da kanta Ammimi ta rakasu wajan motar su , kamar karsu rabu da juna haka suke jin su, musamman Abla da ta dunga kallan Ammimi.  
      Suna barin gidan Abla ta ‘kara satar kallansa ganin ya shareta , kamar zatayi kuka ta furta “ Sunshine nayi laifi ne ?” Kallan yadda take ‘ko’karin yin kuka yayi “ Maine ne abun kuka kuma ? Bakin ce a wajan Ammimi zaki zauna ba ?” Sai a lokacin Abla ta fahimce sa , hannunsa d’aya ta kama tana dariya ‘kasa ‘kasa “ Finally Sunshine is jealous “, guntun murmushi ya sakar mata, yana ‘kara janyota jikinsa sosai “ So you’re trying me ko?” Cikin Sauri Abla ta girgiza masa kai tana dariya ‘kasa ‘kasa , a haka suka ‘karasa gida .
      Suna shiga saida suka sake wanka tukunna Abla ta zauna zaman sha Youghurt d’inta . Sai da ta shanye guda d’aya tasss , tana ‘ko’karin bud’ewa wani Big Boss ya kar’ba “ kina san mayar mun da Baby d’an madara ne ?” Fili fili Abla tayi masa da ido , da yi masa alamar ya bata Youghurt d’inta amma ya hanata sha gabaki d’aya . Kamar zatayi kuka ta furta “ Ni yunwa nake ji fa “ bai ce mata komai ya mi’ke tsaye tare da mi’kar da ita zai nufi dinning da ita , cikin Sauri Abla ta furta “ Ni ba wannan abincin nake so ba” Kallanta yayi sarai yasan rigima ce irin ta ta “ Fine mai kike sancı?”shiru Abla tayi kamar mai tunani sai kuma tayi saurin furta “ Tuwo da Miyan kuka “, kallan da yayi mata yasa tayi saurin had’iye dariyar da take sanyi “ Shi zakici a cikin ki? And My Baby inside ?” ‘Bata fuska Abla tayi “ Ni shi Zanci ko kuna Youghurt d’ina “, hancinta ya d’an ja , sai da ta furta “ Ouch “ tukunna ya saki , bai bata duka Youghurt d’in ba ya sa mata a cup , tana shanyewa ta ‘kara mi’ko masa cup “ You’re not okay “, ya fad’a yana d’aukanta gabaki d’aya zuwa part d’in swimming pool d’insa , da Sauri Abla ta zo zata saka ‘kafafuwanta a cikin ya hanata “ Kinasan yin mura ? Ina zaki shiga? Okay let’s go back” marairaice masa fuska Abla tayi “ Please Sunshine “, kallanta Big Boss yayi kamar bazaiyi magana ba sai kuma ya furta “ No ! Bazaki shiga ruwa ba , and nima kinga I just want to check something okay?” ‘Bata fuska Abla tayi tana knodding kanta , “ Gud girl”. Ya fad’a yana zaunar da ita, “ just seat here , bari na d’akko abu na dawo kinji?” Kanta Abla ta jinjina masa tana sanı murmushi , yana barin Wajan ta matso wajan ruwan, yadda colour din yafito sosai a wajan shi yafi komai d’aukar hankali ta , tsayawa kallan ruwan tayi sai kuma ta d’an saka hannunta tana ‘ko’karin ta’ba ruwan . Cikin Sauri ta Janye sabida hanata da yayi , mi’kewar da zatayi Aushe abun pool d’in ya ri’ke mata rigar jikinta taku biyu tayi taji kamar abu ya ri’keta , amaimakon ta juya taga ko menene sai ta ‘kara taku tana san wucewa , takun da tayi ne yasa rigar ta jata a ‘kasa gabaki d’aya ta kife a ‘kasan cikin ta ya bugu. Wani irin razananniyar ‘kara Abla ta saki tana dafe cikinta. Kuka ta saki tana ruf da cikin da tayi tana dafe cikin nata cikin tsananin azaba, bata san lokacin da ta fad’a pool d’in ba , cikin ‘kan’kanin lokaci ruwan ya soma canza kala.

Yana ‘ko’karin shigowa wajan yaji ihunta. Shi kansa bai san lokacin da ya jefar da abun hannunsa ba , cikin wani irin yanayi ya ‘karaso wajan , yadda yaga tana san cetan kanta a cikin ruwan baisan lokacin da ya fad’a ciki ba . Cikin ‘kwarewa ya soma iwo cikin ruwan, yana zuwa inda take gabaki d’ayanta ya d’auketa ya fito daga cikin ruwan, bata sha wari ruwa sosai ba shiyasa bai sha wahalar fito mata da ruwan ba . Yadda take kuka hannunta dafe da cikinta ya ‘kara har gıtsa masa tunani. Gabaki d’ayanta ya d’auka ya fito daga wajan. Doguwar abayar da ta cire d’azu ya d’auka ya yafa mata dukda yadda cikinsa yake a ji’ke bai tsaya cire wa ba ya fito waje da ita cikin sauri Victor ya bud’e masa mota, yana shiga da wani irin mugun speed Victor yaja motar kamar Wanda yake shirin tashi sama , yanda ya tafi a guje yasa wasu daga cikin soldiers  suka biyo bayansu suma a guje , kamar masu shirin tashi sama haka suke gudun.

     Idanuwansa a kulle suke sai ita da ya rungume a jikinsa , ga kukanta da take yi ‘kasa ‘kasa cikin kunnuwansa, “ Am sorry please “ shine abunda yake iya fitowa daga bakinta duk da yadda take ri’ke cikinta . Sauban na fitowa waje ko side d’in da Bobo yake nufo sa bai kalla ba sai mota da ya shiga , ciki wani irin speed ya tayar da motar a guje ya bar gidan , Bobo na ganin hakan ya bi bayansa a cikin mota a guje kamar Wanda suke shirin yin tseran mota . Yadda Sauban yake tu’ki zaka tabbatar ba’a cikin hankalin sa yake ba , driving kawai yake ko kallan gabansa ba yayi, Bobo na bayansa shima a guje yana kiransa a waya amma ya ‘ki d’aga wa , duk yadda sojojin da suka biyo su sukayi su kamo Sauban abun ya faskara sabida yadda ya bawa motar wuta sosai , a daidai kwanar da ya zo sha a guje wata babbar trailer tayi gaba da motar sa . Gabaki d’aya motar sama tayi tare da kifewa ‘kasa…..

NIGERIA 
   
Lokacin da su Mamy suka nufi hospital d’in har lokacin ba’a fito da Sauban ba , Bobo kawai suka samu a wajan, gashi gabaki d’aya babu wanda yasan da accident d’in sai Mamy dasu Fanan, bayan su ko su His Excellency basu san da hatsarin ba.

Kallansa Dr yayi fuskarsa d’auke da murmushi “ Alhamdulillah, operation yayi kyau , Allah ya tsare ba serous injury bane sosai , I need you in my office please “. Da sauri Mamy ta furta “ Akwai matsala ko?” Girgiza mata kai Dr d’in yayi “ No ba wani issue bane akwai file da zan basa ne , yanzu ma zaku iya dubasa , Allah ya tsare sai ciwan ‘kafa Kawai and shima idan yana shan magani komai zai zo da sau’ki, zaku iya dubasa amma banda hayaniya ”, Bobo bai bi takan Dr d’in ba ya bud’e ’kofar d’akin ya shiga , ragowar Dr d’in suna ‘ko’karin tura Sauban zuwa wani d’aki daban, bandage ne kawai a goshinsa , sai ‘kafarsa guda d’aya da itama akwai wajan da aka sawa bandage d’in , bayanshi babu abunda ya same sa , lokaci d’aya fuskarsa tayi fiyau kamar ba shiba , Mutum me fara’a da murmushi amma yanzu fuskarsa harta fad’a . ‘Kura masa ido Bobo yayi sosai ganin yana bacci , babu wanda ya fad’o masa a rai kamar Big Boss , ko mai zai faru bazai bari ya sanı ba for now, dan komai zai iya faruwa a irin wannan lokacin . Babu Wanda yayi magana sai a cikin su har aka ‘Karasa d’akin da aka kwantar dashi , har lokacin kuma bai tashi ba baccin yake . 
         Fita Bobo yayi daga cikin d’akin ya nufi office d’in Dr. Yana shigowa Dr ya mi’ka masa hannu sukai musabaha kafun ya nuna masa wajan zama . Wani file Dr ya mi’ka masa , wannan form d’in sa ne , ya d’an samu ciwo a ‘kafarsa , sai buguwar da yayi a kansa , apart from that Allah ya tsare babu wani ciwan sai dai the most worst part “. Ya fad’a yana yin shiru , kallansa Bobo yayi sosai “ Worst part as in how ?” Ganin ran Bobo na ‘ko’karin ’baci Drn ya furta “ Calm down please, “ cikin karaji Bobo ya furta “ then tell me in full bansan ‘boye ‘boye “, kansa Dr ya jinjina kafun ya furta “ d’an uwan ka yana daf da kamuwa da ciwan zuciya sabida damuwa da yasaka wa kansa , akwai abunda yake so sosai acikin zuciyarsa , rashin samun abun nan zai iya zama silar rasa shi gabaki d’aya “. With shock Bobo ya kallesa , bai ce masa komai ba sai hannu da ya mi’ka masa zai bar office d’in, wani paper daban Doctor ya mi’ka masa “ For his medicine “. Ya fad’a yana kallan Bobo, kar’ba Bobo yayi tare da envelope d’in ya bar office d’in. 
         *
   Yana fitowa ya had’u da Mamy a tsaye da alama shi take jira “ Akwai matsala ko?” Ta tanbaye sa tana zuba masa idanuwa, murmushin ya d’an saka a fuskarsa dan shi kansa baisan ta yadda zai iya fad’a mata ba , a sanyaye ya furta “ Babu komai Mamy , ya samu buguwa ne akansa , sai ciwo da yaji a ‘kafa, now magungunansa za’a karbo ,” sai a lokacin Mamy ta saki a jiyar zuciya tare da jinjina masa kai . 
 “Amma ya kamata na koma gida , su Fanan na nasan duk suna can hankalin su a tashe “,   
      “ Mamy sun san da accident d’in?” Kanta Kawai ta jinjina masa “ Okay Mamy ki zauna a wajan Sauban ni zan d’auko miki su and everything you need okay ?” Sosai kuwa Mamy ta saki ajiyar zuciya a wannan karan har saida Bobo ya jita . Har d’aki ya rakata kafin ya fito waje , da kanshi ya kar’bo medicine d’insa ya kaiwa Mamy sannan  ya bar asibitin.

Baby tunda ta bar d’akin bata tsaya a ko ina ba sai wani corridor da ta shiga . Kuka take sosai kamar ranta zai fita daga gangar jikinta, batasan me ke damunta ba , batasan me take jiba , ji tayi komai baya mata dad’i , komai ya fita a ranta , cikin sha’kewar murya ta furta “ Ni mene ne laifi na ? Laifin me nayi wa iyaye na da basa sona? Wacce nake so duk duniya a matsayin mahaifiyata ba sona take ba all this while , wacce na tashi da tsananin tsanar ta a cikin zuciyata turn out to be my mother ? My mother ? Then who is my father ?” Ta fad’a tana fashewa da wani kukan. Yadda take kuka sai ta baka tausayi, babu abunda yake yawo cikin ko wana şaşsana jikinta kamar maganganun Fanan. **** Eshaal duk inda tasan zata nemi Baby a part d’in bata same taba, ga Fanan itama da ta kulle kanta a d’aki gabaki d’aya sai suka tayar mata da hankali itama.

Munzo zamu bi so Mamy but sun tafi “, cike da mamaki Little ya furta “ Asibiti ? Wane ne bashi da lapiya ?”,

Suna fitowa motar Bobo na shigowa cikin gidan .

Muma san duba Yaya Sauban ne please, Dan Allah.” Yadda suka tsura masa idanuwana suna jiran amsar sa yasa ya d’an girgiza musu kai “ Captain ya kaiku “, daga haka ya wuce cikin part d’in  tunda ya kula babu Baby a cikinsu.  Yana shiga falourn ya tarar da ko ina shiru alamun kowa yana d’akin su , hatta su Didi basusan da maganar accident d’in ba , daga ita har Mama babu Wanda ya sani dan ba isash shiyar lapiya ce dasu ba . Didi tana fama da ciwan ‘kafa sai Mama da take da hawan jini sau da yawa shiyasa aka fi kula dasu a cikin d’akunan su kar su yawaita jirga jirga.

Maganar sa da taji ne yasa ba shiru ta jiyo a d’an tsorace “ Ina zaki?” Ya ‘kara maimaita maganar da yayi mata, hannunta har rawa yake lokacin da ta ke nuna hanyar d’akin su “ ‘Daki za..ni”, ta fad’a murya a dusashe. Kan d’aya daga cikin kujerun wajan ya nuna mata “ Let’s talk” , bai jira amsarta ba ya samu waje ya zauna , a d’arare itama ta zauna tana takure waje d’aya . Sarai ya kula da yanayinta shiyasa ya saki face d’insa sosai bakamar lokacin da ya shigo gidan ba . Hawayen da yaga ya sakko mata a ‘kuncinta ne yasa ya d’an murmusa kad’an kafun ya furta “ Mai akai miki kike kuka ?”cikin sauri ta girgiza masa kanta wani kukan nasan ‘kwace mata , envelope d’in hannun sa ya ajje a table d’in gaban su , “ Bansan me ya faru ba a tsakanin ku, but kiyi tunani if what you did is wrong or bad. I won’t say much to you, 30 minutes na baki za mu koma asibitin “ daga haka ya mi’ke ya barta, kukan da take dannewa ya ‘kwace mata . Idanuwanta ta kulle tana rera kukanta. Jin kamar za’a shigo falourn tayi saurin mi’kewa tare da barin wajan bayn ta d’auki envelope d’in da ya ajje mata . Tana shiga d’akı fuskarta ta wanke sosai duk da har lokacin kun burin idanuwanta bai tafi ba . A maimakon ta bud’e envelope d’in sai ta saka cikin wardrobe d’inta . Komai a sanyaye take yinsa fuskarta gabaki d’aya babu fara’a kamar ba ita ba . Tana fitowa wajen shima yana fitowa daga part d’in nasu ri’ke da meduim trolley .

HARRY 
Zaune take cikin wata black tinted car me shegen kyau . Cikin shigar wasu matsartsun kaya kamar ba yar musulma ba . A gefen ta wani guy ne Chocolate colour da yake sanye cikin wasu kaya da akallan farko zaka fahimci ba mutumin ‘kwarai bane Sabida uban kıtsan da ke kansa , ga wasu sar’ka manya manya guda biyu a wuyansa sai kunnansa guda d’aya da yake sanye cikin d’an kunne , Harry na kusa dashi hannunsa sar’ke da juna , kwana biyu kenan da suka had’u , cikin a wannin da basu kai d’aya ba suka ‘kulla soyayya sabida ma’kudan kud’in da ya soma narka mata tun a ranar farko . Yanzu ma cikin wani irin mayataccen kallo yake binta kamar zai had’iyeta “ Babe ya kamata ki kwana yau a waje na sabida missing d’inki da nake ba ‘karamun wahalar mun da zuciya yake ba “, washe baki Harry tayi sabida jin dad’in maganganun sa , itama sai faman fari take masa “ Haba mana Babe jiya fa a Wajan ka na kwana ,” matsowa yayi sosai kusa da ita kamar zai shige jikinta , sai faman matseta yake “ Haba mana ni ne fa Babe , ki turo mun account d’inki zan miki transfer 1M nasan hakan zai ishe ki ko?”. Harry najin kud’i ta soma gyad’a masa kai kamar wata ‘kadangaruwa , a yangance ta furta “babu matsala ai Babe yanzu ma zamu iya tafiya “. Wata irin shegen dariya guy d’in ya sani , daman yasan za’a rina, tun a ran farko yasan lashe money ce ita bata damu ba Indai zaka bata kud’i , driver ba ya bawa umarni ya tada mota zuwa guest house d’insa , babu musu kuwa driver ya soma tu’ki, tun a cikin motar guy d’in ya soma tatta’beta har da zuge zip, bai da mu da driver ba ya cigaba da abunda yake . Yana shigowa cikin gida haka suka nufi  ciki shi da ita . Murmushi ya saki sosai lokacin da ya tarar da friends d’insa guda uku a cikin gidan, gabaki d’ayansu hugging d’in juna sukai suna kallan Harry , d’aya daga cikin süne yayi hugging d’inta itama , cikin sauri ta kalli saurayinta ganin ko a jikinsa bai damu ba shiyasa ta d’an saki a jiyar zuciya . 

    “ Man ! Wannan sabuwar kamu ce ?” ‘Daga daga cikin guy d’in ya tanbaya , kashe masa ido Kawai abokin yayi , mai da kallansa yayi kan Harry “ kinyi kyau gashi mun barki a tsaye samu waje mana ki zauna “ a d’arare Harry ta samu waje ta zauna ganin saurayinta ya zauna a cinyar d’aya daga cikin friends d’insa , shi kuma friend d’insa ya wani rungume sa shima . Wasu irin kaji guy din ya kawo mata da drinks kala kala , sai da ta gama ya tsinenan ta wai ala dole zata ja musu a ji tukunna ta soma ci , ko damuwa da ta yadda aka same su ba tayi , ko rabi bata ci ba sabida leman da ta sha ta soma lumshe idanuwanta ,kafun ta tafi luuui kan kujera tana faman lumshe idanuwa, gabaki d’aya sai suka kwashe da dariya . “ Baba baka da kyau fa , da alama gwayar da ka sa mata babba ce ba ‘kara ba tun ta ya bugar da ita atake ,” guy d’in da ya zuba mata ‘kwayar ne ya nufe ta , ‘ko’karin cire mata kaya ya soma yi kafin ya basu amsa “ na ku wasa ne , dole ita naji ya take kafin na dawo kanku, da haka ya cirewa Harry kaya gabaki d’aya , saurayin da yazo da ita ko a jikinsa dan har lokacin hankalinsa na kan friend d’insa da yke ta’ba masa wuya . 

Cikin tsantsan rashin tsoran Allah suka cire kayansu, irin abubuwan da suke lokaci d’aya zaka tabbatar da ‘yan luwad’i ne su. Gasu duk a waje d’aya , acikin falourn suka soma cin duniyarsu, Wanda ya faman tatta’be Harry kuwa amaimakon ya shigeta ta gaba sai ya shigeta ta dubura, duk da a biye take sai da tayi ‘karar a zaba amma haka guy d’in nan ya dunga sarrafata ta baya tana ihu tana komai amma ya’ki sauka daga kanta sai da ya gama dan kansa sannan ya koma wajan friends d’insa , sai a lokacin saurayinta ya dawo wajanta , bai damu da yadda take kuka ba shima ya afkamata kamar abokinsa , shima ta baya ya shigeta , a haka sauran abokan ma duk sai da suka shish shigeta ta baya sannan sabida tsabar mugunta suka dawo suna anfani da ita mutum bibbiyu , wani ya shigeta ta baya wani ya shigeta ta gaba , tsabar a zaba sume musu tayi amma su ko a jikinsu , sai da suka gama abunsu sannan suka bar gidan bayan sun mayar da kayan jikinsu , ko tunanin tsarkake jikinsu basayi. Sai a lokacin Saurayinta ya d’akko ruwa ya zuba mata ta farka cikin kuka , tsabar iya bariki nasan kamar wani mutumin arzi’ki ya soma lallashinta yana mata dad’in baki , tare da mata transfer 10M a lokacin . Ku d’ad’en da taji ya tura mata shiya göğe gabaki d’aya laifin sa sukaci gaba da iskancin su , Harry bata koma gida ba tayi kwananta a wajansa .   

Samun uban kud’ad’en nan da taga tayi cikin ‘kan’kanin lokaci shiya ‘kara hura wutar kwad’ayin rayuwar jin dad’i da cikar burinta cikin zuciyarta . Ko sau d’aya batayi tunanin iyayenta ba ko tunanin halin da mahaifiyarta zata shiga a rashinta .

NEW YORK

 Tun d’azu yake operating system d’in gabansa, gabaki d’aya yadda ya mayar da hankali kan abunda yake zai tabbatar maka da abune mai mahimmanci yakeyi . A wannan karan ma ya d’an d’au dogon lokaci kafun ya ajje system d’in , time ya kalla yana d’an fesar da iskar bakinsa kad’an mai sanyayyan ‘kamshin mint. 
 
     Mi’kewa yayi tare da nufar hanyar d’akinta,zuwa yanzu yaci ace ta farka daga baccin da take sabida ta dad’e tanayinsa . Yana shiga cikin d’akin ya sameta a kwance hannunta d’auke da phone d’inta tana game , hannayensa gabaki d’aya suna cikin aljihunsa , gabaki d’aya idanuwansa na kanta , ‘kamshin turaransa da taji ne ta d’an ’bata rai sabida fushi take dashi. Kamar bata san da shigowar saba ta cigaba da game d’inta . Murmushi ya saki kad’an tare da nufo inda take . Yana zuwa wayar ya amsa tare da ajje ta a gefe , yana kar’bar wayar ita kuma ta d’auki duvet zata rufe fuskarta ya ri’ke duvet d’in tare da matsowa kusa da ita sosai har saida ta saki ajiyar zuciya a hankali “ Rigimar bata isa haka ba?” Ya fad’a kamar mai rad’a , ‘bata face Abla tayi tana turo bakinta , tun d’azu take fushi dashi har tayi bacci sabida hanata shan yaji da yayi ,kamar mai koyan magana ta  furta ni ba rigima nake ba “, 
     
     “ Then mene ne ?” Shi ma ya tanbaya yana ‘kara kallanta , kamar zatayi kuka ta furta “ Nidai kazo muje a cire wannan d’an kullum sai ya dunga sakani bacci, idan zanci abinci sai ya hanani, kawai ya sa jikina ya kukkun bura , Nidai bazan yadda , ko kuma muje a mayar dashi jikin ka , kai ma ka dunga baccin da nake “, tsayawa kallanta yayi yadda take magana da iya gaskiyar ta , dan sosai cikin ke takura mata ya lura da hakan, hannunta d’aya ya kama a hankali ya ke matsawa shima “ Fine tunda bakyasan Babyn nawa, shikenan zamuje a cire miki,” yana fad’in haka yayi ‘ko’karin tashi cikin sauri Abla ta ri’ke hannun sa “ Ni bance ba fa “, kamar gaske shima ya d’an ’bata fuskarsa “ No zamuje a cire sa fa bari na shirya “. Zai kuma tashi Abla ta furta “ Allah ni dai ban fad’a ba kuma baza’a cire mun ba na fasa , kai ne fa idan nace zanci abu sai ka hanani kuma kaima kana ci fa “, ta ‘karasa a shagwa’be, sosai ya murmusa a wannan karan tare da d’aura hannunsa asaman cikinta da ya soma fitowa “ it’s not my fault, Babyn mune ko? Ba soyayya muke da shi ba , kinga baya ‘kaunata, kullum cikin d’aure mun fuska yake , dan nayi soyayya zai ya zama laifi? Shi lokacin da yake soyayyar shi an hanashi? “, yadda taga tana hawaye ne ya ‘kara mata tausayinta da take ji, sai yanzu ta gane dalilin dawowar su , wato sabida accident d’in Yaya Sauban. Hannu Abla ta saka tare da share mata hawayenta “  kukan ya isa haka please, na tabbata ba yau kika fara shiba , gashi kina ‘ko’karin sakawa kanki damuwa . Yanzu ya jikin Yaya Sauban d’in?” ‘Bata fuska Baby tayi kafun ta furta “ Nima bansani ba “ da mamaki Abla ta furta “ ba kije kin duba saba Kenan?”, yadda Baby taga mamaki ya fito a kan fuskar Abla ya sanya ta d’an had’e ranta “ ina ruwana dashi”, saura kad’an dariya ta ‘kwacewa Abla amma tayi saurin dannewa karta ‘bata wa Baby rai “ amma ya kamata ki je ki duba sa , ko babu komai a tsakanin ku kinga kema yayan ki ne , and ko saboda Mamy ya cancanci fiye da hakan ma, tunda nazo kuka tayar mun da hankali , aushe zazza’bin soyayya ne ya kamaki, tunda na dawo kuma zamu samo miki magani”, a ‘kufule Baby ta mi’ke zata bar d’akin, cikin sauri ta ri’kota “ fine am sorry , amma please ki bar saka wannan damuwar a cikin ranki kinji? Kin manta kina dani? Bana san ganin ku haka , gabaki d’aya banji dad’i ba , ko zaki ha’kura sabida niba , sai ki ha’kura for your Son?” Ta ‘Karasa tana kashe mata ido d’aya. Murmushin da ta jima ba tayi ba ta saki sabida yadda taji wani sanyi a cikin ranta lokaci d’aya “ Ni dai ba yar iska bace “, ta fad’a tana sakin wani murmushin kafun ta bar d’akın. Itama Abla murmushi kawai take saki sabida a wani ‘bangarena na zuciyarta taji dad’i , dan ba tun yau take wa Baby fatan hakan ba . 
      * wanka ta somayi sannan ta rama salolin da suke kanta , abuncin da su Fanan suka kawo mata ma kad’an taci sabida yadda take jin cikinta a tunkushe kwana biyu, gwandama fruit salad da ta sha da yawa , tana gama sha ko minti goma batayi ba ta kwanta , sai bacci. 
      
    *Da daddare ma basu samu sunyi magana , sai abuncin da suka kawo mata , itama kuma bata ce musu komai ba ta bar komai a cikin ranta zuwa gobe , ga baccin da take faman yi bazai bata damar maganar da su ba . Dan kusan sau biyu Baby na shigowa d’akin, itama Fanan haka, ganin yadda take bacci ne yasa Mamy tace abarta ta huta.
*. *. *. *. 
Kamar yadda ta saba mafarkin wata tana naiman taimako yanzun ma kusan hakance ta faru,sabida d’a da take ganin matar cikin neman taimako duk da bata ga fuskarta ba amma a wannan karan cikin wani irin shiga mai d’aukan hankali ta hango ta , cikin wani babban falour mai matu’kar ‘kayatarwa tana mi’ko hata hannu alamar ta zo, Abla kuwa sai faman kare hasken da yake haske mata ido tayi sabida yadda take san ganin ko wacece matar , cikin sauri ta dam’ke idanuwanta da haske suke kashe mata su kafin ta ‘kara bud’ewa , har yanzu tana hangi yadda matar take mi’ko mata hannu , cikin wani irin murya kamar tasan mai shi ta ‘kafa furta “ taho waje na mana, taho.” Runtse idanuwanta Abla tayi na ‘yan sakanni kafun ta bud’esu gabaki d’aya akan matar, cikin tsantsan mamaki Abla taja baya ganin Ammi a zaune kan kujera fuskarta d’auke da murmushi, ga wata budurwa da bata san ko wacece ba a gefenta . ‘Kara mi’ka mata hannu Ammi tayi tana mata murmushi akan ta matso kusa da ita . Cikin sauri Abla ta nufi Ammin ganin yadda take mi’ka mata hannu, guguwar da ta karad’e wajan ne ya dakatar da ita daga nufar Ammin da take , kusan tsawan mintuna biyu kafun guguwar ta d’auke . Bud’e idanuwanta da zatayi kenan taga babu Ammi babu budurwar data gani a gefenta. Da sauri Abla ta ‘karasa kan kujerar da Ammi take a zaune , wani ‘karamun picture ta gani a ciki tare da wani zobe kamar na gwal. Cikin sauri ta d’auki photon tana kalla , wasu ‘yan matane farare tasss a cikin hotuwan, ko wanne fuskarsa d’auke murmushi, ba sosai take ganin fuskokinsu kamar yadda take ganin kayan jikin su iri d’aya , fad’uwa hotan yayi a ‘kasa tsugunnawar da tayi bayan ta d’auki picture d’innan ne taga sar’karta, zata d’auka kenan taji kamar a na ta’ba ta .” 

    Bakinta d’auke da addu’a ta farka tana ‘ko’karin yun’kurawa , yadda taji ta kasa motsine ya bata damar bud’e idanuwan ta cikinsu sauri. Da fuskarsa ta soma cin karo , a hankali ta saki ajiyar zuciya ganin kamar tafiya suke , cikin cool voice d’inta ta furta “ Sunshine .” A maimakon ya amsa mata sai idanuwansa da lumshe mata kawai, bata kuma cewa komai ba ta lafe a jikinsa har zuwa kan gadon da bata san ko na ina bane, ga laushi da yake da shi na musamman “ sorry na tashe ki daga bacci ko?” Kanta Abla ta girgiza masa a hankali. Wuyanta ya d’an ta’ba jin zafi, kusan kwana biyu kenan tana fama da wannan zazza’bun daren “ Sleep tight “, ya fad’a lokacin da yake kissing goshinta . Kamar wata Baby haka ya dunga tapping d’inta a hankali har ta koma baccin da take . Sai da ya tabbata baccin ta yayi nisa sosai tukunna ya d’auko system d’in sa yana operating d’insa, yadda ya mayar da hankali sosai kan system d’in zai tabbatar mqka ba ‘karamun abu mai muhimmanci yake yi ba.

THE NEXT DAY
*******
Kiran sallar asuba da ake ne ya shiga cikin kunnuwanta, a hankali ta soma mutsuts tsuka idanuwanta tana san bud’e wa , tun tanayi kad’an kad’an har ta ‘karasa bud’esu. Bata sauke idanuwanta a ko ina ba sai akan ceiling d’akin , mamaki ne ya kamata sosai ganin yadda wajan canza mata kamar ba shiba , shiyasa ta saka hannunta d’aya tana mutsutsuka idanuwanta , lokaci d’aya ta fuskanci ba a cikin d’akinta take ba. Cikin sauri ta yun’kura zata tashi taji an ri’kota, da sauri ta waiga dan ganin ko wanene,d’an zaro idanuwanta Abla tayi ganinsa akwance, shima bud’e idanuwansa yayi lokacin da ya mi’ke zaune “ be careful, ki dena wannan saurin haka” cikin tsananin mamaki ta furta “ Sunshine ina ne nan? “ bai amsa mata ba, sai maida kallansa da yayi zuwan kan watched d’in d’akin daidai lokacin da ake sake wani kiran sallar “ Let’s pray “ ya fad’a a hankali lokacin da yake mi’kewa, ‘bata fuska Abla tayi da ta fahimci d’auko ta yayi lokacin da take bacci, tsoran ta d’aya ma kar su Fanan su shiga cikin d’akin ko Mamy su tarar da bata ciki. Hannun da ya mi’ka mata ne yasa a sanyaye ta kama har yanzu bata dena turo bakin da take ba , direct wata ‘kofa suka shiga su biyu.

      Bayan wasu ‘yan mintuna tare suka sake fitowa cikin saban shiga ,sanye yake cikin wasu ‘kananan kaya masu laushin gaske, sai ita da take sanye cikin wani koriyar riga mara nauyi, sai hijab da ta yake hannunta . Sai da ya kaita har kan daddumar tukunna ya mata kıss a hannunta , kafin ya fita daga d’akin. A jiyar zuciya ta sauke bayan futarsa , kusan a tare sukai sallar sabida jam’i da tabi, ba ita ta bar kan daddumar nan ba sai da tayi karatun al’qurani mai girma da kuma azkar d’inta kafun ta mi’ke tsaye . Time ta kalla ganin shida ta wuce , tasan a ko wana irin lokaci zai iya dawowa d’akin, gashi zuciyar ta na tsoran Mamy ta shiga ta tarar da bata cikin d’akin shiyasa ta fito daga d’akin tana dube , lokaci d’aya ta fahimci part d’insu ne amma gabaki d’aya ancanza komai da komai na cikin wajan. Ta cikin elevator ta sauka zuwa ‘kasa , har zata nufi ta ‘kofa sai ta tuna da hanyar da ya ta’ba bi da ita ta cikin bedroom d’insa . Yanzun ma can ta shiga kamar yadda tayi hasashe, a canza komai da komai na cikin d’akin, bata tsaya kallan gyaran ba ta nufi hanyar, cikin d’an sauri take tafiyarta , saura kad’an ta ‘karasa part d’insu Mamy ta hangi ‘kofa a bud’e , tsabar karanbani irin nata amaimakon tayi wucewarta sai ta ‘karasa ‘kofar da ta gani a bud’e , bakinta d’auke da Bismillah ta tura ‘kofar . ‘Dan ‘karamin corridor a wajan da baifi taku goma ba sai wata ‘kofa daga Side d’in hagu , itama kamar abud’e ajiyar zuciya ta sauke zata juya kamar ance ta kai idanuwanta bakin ‘kofar sai ta wu’ka a ‘kasa jikinta da wani kiran abu da baza’a iya kiran sa da jini ba . Gudun kar yazo ya sameta anan tayi saurin tanjo ‘kofar tare da saka d’an kunnanta ta karci wajan ‘kofar kad’an yadda zata ganeta. A haka ta ‘karasa cikin part d’in su Mamyn ba tare da kowa ya ganta ba har ta shige d’aki.

‘Karfe 8:30 akai knocking d’in d’akin lokacin harta soma barci ma sama sama , mi’kewa tayi tare da bud’e ’kofar , su Eshaal ne a tsaye a wajan hannun su d’auke da tray , matsa musu hanya tayi suka shigo cikin d’akin “ Maman unborn ga abinci da d’umi d’umin sa “, kallan ‘kofa Abla tayi ganin Fanan da Eshaal kawai banda Baby, d’an girgiza kanta kawai tayi tare da komawa cikin d’akin .” Sai yanzu kuka ga damar dawowa kenan, Madam mai kawo jaka har kin kawo jakar kin dawo ko?” ‘Karamun dariya Fanan ta saki batare da ta furta komai ba sai ma Eshaal da ta furta “ You’re breakfast is ready ,karki zauna da yunwa mijinki ya saka mu punishment kamar yanda naga soldiers d’in jiya suna wani irin tranining kamar babu jini a jikin su , d’an hararar ta Abla tayi “ kema ai soldier d’in zaki aura , kije ki tanbayesa ya suke punishment, dan kunga ku ba’ai muku komai ba ko? Ni da aka mayar mai kuna da Simba ba ? “ ya ‘karasa tana sakin dariya sabida tuno dramer ta . Suma su Eshaal dariya ce ta ‘kwace musu , cikin d’ariya Fanan ta furta “ karki damu Indai wannan ne dan sojan nata har cikin flower yasaka ta shiga Baby kuma ta shige ‘kar’kashin mota “, sai kuma jikinta ya d’anyi sanyi da tayi maganar Baby, dafa kafad’ar ta Abla tayi “ it’s okay, ki zamuyi magana anjima , kar Yaya Little ya sa a d’aure ni, dan wannan mijin naki yafi kotu d’aure mutum wallahi , ah to nidai babu ruwana”. Murmushi sosai Fanan ta saki sabida anbatan Little da tayi, amaimakon ta bata amsa sai ta furta “ ga abincin kınan Mamy na jiran mu”, zata juya kenan İran Baby ta shigo d’akin, ko kallanta batayi ba sai ma d’aure face d’inta da tayi kad’an lokacin da ta shigo cikin d’akin ,d’an ajiyar zuciya Fanan ta saki , kwata kwata bata jin dad’in yadda suke yanzu da Baby , tasan Baby kuma da zuciya musamman yadda maganganun da ta fad’a mata sukai mata ciwo har suka saka ta zazza’bi, dafatan da Eshaal tayi ne ta sauke nunfashi tare da fita daga d’akin .

    “ Haba mana Baby , bansan ki da fushi haka ba , please komai ya wuce mana , bana san ganin ku haka , bana jin dad’in gaskiya “, d’an ta’be baki Baby tayi “ Nifa ba wajan ki nazo ba ,na zo duba lapiyar kine da Unborn d’in mu, kawai kici abinci ki kwanta kiyi bacci , kinga tafiya ta Mamy na jira na “. Duk yadda Abla take mata maganar ta dawo itama bata dawon ba , dan ta sani Indai ta tsaya sai Abla ta tilasta ta yin abunda batayi niya ba . Tana fita Abla ta girgiza kanta “ Duk ku gama guje gujen ku , zaku dawo hannu ai , fitinannu kawai “, yanxun ma bata ci wani abun kirki ba , gwanda pepper soup da ta sha kad’an , dan idanuwanta har wani lumshewa suke sabida baccin da take ji.

Koda aka idar da sallah bai koma part d’in saba dan yasan bata ciki yanzu, har lokacin kuma bayan ya saka an duba ‘kafar Sauban mai ce musu komai ba da gashi har Bobon.

     Zai bar wajan masallacin yaji muryar Little “ Yaya..”, jiyowa Big Boss yayi ganin Little tsaye a wajan, hannu Big Boss ya bud’e masa ba musu kuwa yayi sauri yayi hugging d’insa “ please Yaya ka dunga tafiya dani, nayi kewar ka sosai “, tausayinsa ne ya kamashi duk da bai fito fili ya nuna masa hakan ba , gashin kansa ya shafa “ it’s okay Little , waya ta’ba mun kai lokacin da bananan “, cikin sauri ya girgiza kansa “ No one Yaya kawai nayi kewar ka sosai “, zai yi magana sai yaga Prince shima a tsaye yana kallansu, da hannu yayi masa alamar ya matso kusa , cikin sauri kuwa Prince yayi hugging d’insu “ I missed you a lot Yaya , munyi kewarka “, hannu Big Boss ya saka ya kama kunnan su gabaki d’aya , cikin sauri suka soma “ Ouch Yaya da zafi , we’re sorry”. ‘Dan sakin kunnan su yayi kafun ya furta “ when last kuka motsa jiki?” Bai koya musu yadda zasu yi ‘karya ba shiyasa sukai fiki fiki da ido alamar rashin gaskiya . “ Mu kuma da aka manta da mu fa ?” Cewar Sauban lokacin da yake ‘karasowa wajan cikin d’in gishe ‘kafa , ‘kara had’e face d’insa yayi kad’an bayan yayi wa su Little alamar su shiga cikin gida. Shima Bobo wajan ya ‘karaso shiyasa Big Boss ya kalle su su biyun. “ Follow me “, yana fad’ar hakan ya juya ya soma tafiya , sai da yayi kusan taku bakwai kafun Sauban ya kalli Bobon “ Please Dude karka fad’a masa dalilin accident d’in nan please “, Bobo zai yi magana Sauban ya rigasa “ Dan Allah .” Kansa Bobo ya jinjina masa kafun su soma bin bayansa ganin ya wuce su sosai. Abunda basu sani ba kuma gabaki d’aya yaji maganganun su , dan wani irin kunne Allah ya basa kamar maciji, yana da saurin jin magana a kunnan sa , suma kuma sun san da hakan amma a wannan karan gabaki d’aya sun manta da wane ne Big Boss “. 


Lokacin da Abla taje gaishe da su Didi suma ba ‘karamun mamakin zuwan ta sukai ba , amma farin cikin ganin ta da sukai ya ‘boye gabaki d’aya mamakin nasu , dan yadda suke farin ciki ita da Hajiyar America sai sun baka mamaki ga wani irin tarairaya da suke mata , motsi kad’an sai an tanbayi lafiyar ta ko kuma in akwai abunda take bu’kata, duk da suma ba isash shiyar lapiyar ce dasu ba. 
************
‘Karfe 12:45pm Bobo ne zaune a part d’insu shi da Sauban bayan Doctor ya gama duba sa “ we have to tell me the truth, ‘boyewar bashi da anfani,ka sani , nima na sani idan ya sani cikin ‘kan ‘kanın lokacin zai yi solving matsalar nan . Kasan wane ne shi basai na fad’a maka ba , do you think excuse d’in da ka fad’a masa d’azu sai sa ya yadda da maganar ka ?” Cewar Bobo yana kallan Sauban , d’an iskar baki Sauban ya fesar kad’an “ Nasan da hakan Dude , but I really can’t force her , I can’t bazai iya d’aukar yadda zata cutu ba , just for my happiness? I can’t , da wani Idon zan ce masa a get this accident sabida ita ? Kasan halin sa sai, he can really make her cry idan ya gane I got this accident because of her…”, bai ‘karasa fad’a ba sabida wanda ya gani tsaye yayi folding hannunsa, ga face d’insa da take d’auke ba fara’a “ Oh My God “, cewar Sauban ganin Big Boss ya juya , cikin sauri ya mi’ke tsaye yana kallan Bobo da shima ya mi’ke sabida ganin Big Boşs da yayi “ we have to follow him please,” bai jira jin mai Bobo zai ce ba ya soma tafiya a d’in gishe da sandar da yake using kwana biyu, basu nufi ko ina ba sai part d’in su Mamy.

*********** Su Abla suna zaune a falourn su 5 d’insu duk da har yanzu ba wani magana take da Arwa ba , ga su Baby suma da take san shirya su ita da Fanan, ‘kamshin turaran sa da taji a hancinta ne yasa tayi saurin d’ago da fuskarta dan gasgata hakan, shid’in ne kuwa ya ke shigowa falourn , bata san lokacin da ta furta “ Sunshine ?” Cikin sauri Baby ta d’ago idanuwanta , ganin sa a falourn ba ‘karamun  bugawar zuciya ya sakata ba gashi face d’insa da ta gani a d’aure , cikin sauri ta mi’ke tsaye jikinta har wani rawa yake sabida tsoro duk da bata san dalilin shigowar ta saba amma yadda ta ga ya jefa mata wani mugun kallo da ya sanya saura kad’an fitsari ya ‘kwace mata a wando. Itama Abla, Baby ta kallan da taga yayi wa Babyn, kanta ta soma girgiza masa kad’an amma ko kusa bai kalleta ba , su kansu su Eshaal babu wanda jikinsa bai d’au rawa ba ganin fuskar sa a d’aure babu d’igon fara’a. Basu gama tunanin dalilin shigowar saba sabida gigitacciyar tsawar da ya daka wa Baby, ita kanta Abla da ba ita akai wa tsawar ba saida ta dafe cikinta, su  Eshaal ma cikin sauri suka mi’ke tsaye ga Baby da tun kafin yayi magana har ta soma yin kuka . Bobo da Sauban ne suka shigo falourn suma , hankalin Sauban gabaki d’aya yana kan Baby , wannan ne dalilin da yasa bayaso Big Boss ya sani , Baby kuwa jikinta har rawa yake , cikin sauri Sauban ya ‘karasa side d’insa , ba tare da wani tsammani ba yaji ta a bayansa ta ri’ke rigar jikinsa tana kuka a hankali……..

“ Let’s talk please “, cewar Sauban lokacin da yake kallan Big Boss , a maimakon Big Boss ya bashi amsa sai bayan sa da ya kalla sau d’aya , a fusge ya furta “ am miki wani abu?” Cikin sauri Baby ta girgiza kanta sai kuma ta bud’e bakinta “ a’ah “, Big Boss zai ‘kara one step Sauban shima ya matso kusa dashi “ Why all this Dude , she’s not at fault ( bata da laifi )zan maka bayanin komai ,just let her be ( ka barta ).” Abla tana ganin Sauban ya d’an matsa daga bayan Baby tayi saurin nufarta ganin tana kuka , hannunta d’aya ta kama zata bar wajan  , kallan da Big Boss ya mata ne yasa ba shiri ta saki hannun nata itama ‘kwalla na shirin tarar mata a cikin idanuwa.   “ Fine tunda abun haka ne , zan tsugunna amma please ka barsu su tafi” cewar Sauban, yana ‘ko’karin du’kawa Big Boss ya jefa masa wani irin kallo “ Don’t you dare , if not she will regret it”, yana gama fad’a ya juya ya bar wajan.Baby ji tayi wani kukan na san ‘kwace mata amma ta kasa fito dashi sabida Big Boss da yake wajan. Dafe kansa Sauban yayi yana d’an sakin ajiyar zuciya , ba tare da ya kalli inda take ba ya yiwa su Abla alamar su bar wajan kafun suma su bar falourn shi da Bobo. Abla tanayin wankan har zata kwanta sai ta turo da wu’kar da ta gani d’azu da safe . Bata wani ‘bata lokaci ba a wajan shiryawa , simple riga ta saka purple colour sai d’an kwali da ta saka white colour a kanta ,wayarta ta d’auka taga alamar shigowar sa’ko , murmushi ta saki bayan ta gama karanta message d’in da yayi mata amma duk da hakan ba tayi masa reply ba, sai ma saka ta a silent da ta d’anyi. Sai da ta fara dubawa ta tabbatar da babu mai taho wa tukunna ta bi hanyar da take kamar under ground.

Wu’kar d’azu ta kalla , har lokacin tana yashe a ‘kasa kamar yadda ta barta . Tsugunnawa ‘kasa tayi tana cigaba da bin wu’kar da kallo, babu abunda ya bi bata mamaki kamar yadda taga wu’kar da wani koran abu, da a ce ja ne da zata iya kiransa da jini dan launin kalar ne kawai ya banbanta. Bakinta d’auke da addua ta kutsa ‘kai cikin d’akin , duhu ne a d’akin duk da ba sosai ba sabida hasken window ya fa shigo cikin d’akin. ‘Karasa shigowa tayi tana tura ‘kofar kafun ta laluba wajan bango ta kunna light. Wani irin bugawa ‘kirjinta yayi da sauri sabida abubuwan da tacı karo da su. Hotuna ne kamar a jikin board ( Allo) na katako ga hotunan da yawa a jiki daga saman cikin babban harufa aka saka “ MAI DALA”, a jiki sai kuma wasu hotunan da akayi kansile da maker wasu kuka aka yage rabi aka bar rabi. Mai da kallanta tayi kan wani d’an dogon abu da ta gani a jingine sai igiya da ta gaji d’aure a wajan da irin koran abun da ta gani a jikin wu’kar d’azu, bin abun ta somayi da kallo ganin har a ‘kasa koran abun kwarara, duk iya tunanin da zatayi zuciyar ta ta kasa hasasho mata jini sabida koran da ta gani. Cikin sauri ta nufi wajan hotunan tana gaggani , duk wanda akayi cancel d’insu duk bata san su ba, zata d’auke fuskarta kamar ance ta kalli ‘kasan hotan, “ Shine ?” Ta fad’a a fili tana ‘kara nuna hotan , cikin sauri ba tare da tunanin komai ba ta ciro hotan tana binsa da kallo,sak hotan da tayi mafarki jiya na wasu mata guda biyu sai yanzu hotan ya fito sosai dan ta kayan jikin su ta gane su. Sosai ta ‘kurawa hotunan ido tana bin su da kallo, lokaci d’aya kuma ta d’an saki murmushi ganin kamar d’aya daga cikin matar Ammimi ce a ciki, d’ayar ce bata gane ko wacece ba , kamar da wasa sai ta d’an juya bayan picture d’in , da manyan ba’ki ta ga sunan “ Safreena and Sofiyya “, sai a lokacin ta fahimci d’ayar matar maman su Little ce amma ita ba’a ganin fuskarta sosai sabida yadda  wajan fuskarta ta d’anyi dishi dishi.

Abla tana idar da sallah wanka tayi cikin wani blue silk d’in kayan bacci yar guntuwa da bata bi zuwa gwiwar ta ba sai dogon gashin kanta da ya gyara sosai ta tufkeshi, yadda rigar take shara shara yasa ta saka wata doguwar ba’kar riga a kanta, bata yi kwalliya ba amma sosai tayi kyau musamman lipgloss d’in da ta saka akan lips d’inta sai shinning yake sosai.

Ajje abun hannunta tayi ta soma kwashe papers d’in. Sai data gama kwashewa duka zata mayar idanuwanta suka kai kan ‘karamun picture da yake jikin file d’in hannunta . Sakin baki tayi sosai tana kallan hotan kai ganin hotanta wanda ita kanta bata san yaushe akayi saba sabida dad’ewar hotan. “ Ibtissam Isma’il “, shine sunan da ta gani ‘baro ‘baro a jikin file d’in. ‘Kirjinta ne ya buga da ‘karfi ganin hakan shiyasa ta soma bin file d’in da kallo tana san fahimtar wani abu daga cikin file d’in amma ta kasa fahimtar komai . Shiyasa ta samu waje ta zauna a gaban dressing mirror d’in d’akin tana fito da papers d’in ciki d’aya bayan d’aya tana kallan papers d’in jiki. Wani farar paper da take a ninke ta bud’e har zata yar ganin kamar diagram ne a jiki sai kuma wata zuciyar ta sa ta fara karanta abunda yake jikin paper . Tsananin mamaki ne ya hanata magana sai ‘kurawa paper ido da tayi ko ‘kiftasu batayi, gabaki d’aya abunda yake jiki sunan wajan da ta zauna ne tundaga gidan uwar karuwai , matar data tsinceta, fitar da ita daga nigeria da akai har ‘kasar da aka kaita kafin zuwan su America . Abla bata san dalili ba sai taji kamar hawaye na san sakko mata a cikin idanuwa na. Shafa wajan idan tayi jin hawaye a wajan da batasan yadda akai suka sakko ba , tana ‘ko’karin gogewa wani hawayen ya sake sakko mata sabida tuna irin rayuwar da tayi a baya ne suka soma yi mata yawo cikin kwanyarta. A jiyar zuciya ta sauke kad’an  tana ajje paper d’in kafun ta bud’e na ‘kasan ta , ita gabaki d’aya kanta ya soma kulle wa ne sabida kasa fahimtar papers d’in menene . “ Sofiyya”
Shine sunan data gani a cikin babbar paper d’in ciki daga ‘kasan ta aka saka Mother , sai d’ayan side da aka saka isma’il shima daga ‘kasan sa aka saka father , hannun Abla har rawa yake sabida yadda taji zuciyarta tana mata bugu da sauri sauri , bata san gasgata zuciyarta akan abun da take raya mata shiyasa ta ‘kara bin paper da kallo ganin tsakiyar ta anja layi sai sunan “Ibtissam “ da ya fito sosai a wajan ‘kasanta an rubuta daughter. A zabure Abla ta mi’ke tsaye ragowar papers din suna zubewa ‘kasa . Hawayen idanuwanta ta goge cikin sauri ta fito daga dressing room d’insa bata tsaya ‘bata lokacin ba ta nufi ‘kofa zata fita, tana saka hannu akan handle d’in shima yana bud’e ‘kofar, saura kad’an ta fad’i ’kasa yayi saurin ta ro ta , da mamaki yake kallan face d’inta ganin hawaye “ Crying?” Ya fad’a yana ‘kara kallanta , fisge hannunta Abla tayi daga ri’kon da yayi mata , tsayawa kallanta yayi cike da mamaki , paper d’in hannun ta Abla ta mi’ka masa cikin rawar murya ta furta “ Mene ne wannan?” Ta fad’a cikin kuka lokacin da ta ke nuna masa paper hannunta , kallan paper yayi tare da kallanta , zai ri’ke hannunta tayi saurin jan baya “ Tun Yaushe kake ‘boyemun gaskiya ?Mai yasa ? Kasan Itace ta bar ni tun ina ‘karama amma kasa na sha’ku da ita ? Wacece ni? Su wane ne Iyaye na “, dafe goshinsa Big Boss yayi yana ‘kara step d’aya itama tayi bata kad’an “ Let’s talk please, stop crying zan miki bayani”. Cikin kuka Abla ta furta “ Bana so “. Tana fad’an hakan tayi gefensa zata wuce ya ri’kota, a zuciye ta zo zata fusge jikinta ya ‘kara ri’kota, cikin kuka Abla ta soma ko kawar ‘kwace jikinta , ganin tana san zame masa ya ri’keta sosai yadda ko ‘kwa’k’kwaran motsi bazata iya ba amma şai ya sassauta mata yadda zataji zafi ba . Cikin kuka take furta “ Ni ka sake ni na tafi, ka barni “. Hugging d’inta yayi a jikinsa yana tapping bayanta “ baki da lapiya kar mu soma haka yanzu please, ki manta komai”, a zuciye yanzu ma ta fusge zata wuce ya ‘kara ri’kota yanzu kam da gasken kokawar ta soma yi dashi tana san ‘kwace jikinta amma ya ‘ki bata damar hakan. Cikin kuka ta daddage ta gantsara masa cizo a hannu , duk da yaji zafin ciwan bai saketa ba haka ya zaunar da ita kan d’aya daga cikin kujerun wajan. Gabaki d’aya ta ‘ki tsayawa ta saurare sa balantana yayi mata bayanın. Ganin yadda ta kesan fita daga hayyacinta ne yasa ya d’an daka mata tsawa kad’an da ya tsoratar da ita . Lokaci d’aya ta nutsu, zai yi magana ta dafe jikinta da take ji kamar yana san murd’a mata. Ba zato ba tsammani ya tsugunna a wajan ‘kafafuwanta tare da d’ora kansa akan laps d’inta.
