Kusan a lokaci d’aya Big Boss da Bobo suka tare Little dake ‘ko’karin fad’uwa , yana ‘ko’karin rufe idanuwansa Big Boss ya furta “ Open your eye now”, bai ‘karasa abunda yake dan cewa ba idanuwan Little suka soma lumshe wa , cikin sauri Big Boss ya sa’bi Little , zasu bar falourn , Abbu dake gefe shima ya fad’i a gefe , abun gashi d’aya ya haushinar dasu , cikin sauri Bobo da Sauban suka d’aga Abbu suka bi bayan Big Boss da bai kula da yanayin Abbun ba . Prince kamar zaiyi kuka , shiyasa Uncle ya ri’ke hannun sa , daman kuma wannan yanayın yake shiga duk lokacin da Little yake cikin wannan halin . Uncle Isma’il da Uncle Adam tuni suka bi bayan su , ganin Ammi na ‘ko’karin juyawa Uncle ya dakatar da ita “ Ha’kuri zakiyi Sofiyya karki dashi hankalin yaran. Mu zamuje asibitin yanzu shiyasa baza mu tafi duka ba. Karmu d’aga hankalin Didi da Mama, ko wannan su ba cikakken lapiya ne dashi ba, yadda suke farin cikin dawowar nan taku kar a ‘kara samu damuwa please “, d’an ajiyar zuciya Ammi tayi dan gabaki d’aya jikinta yayi sanyi bata d’auka tsanar da sukai yayarta har ya kai haka ba. Wani ajiyar zuciyar ta sake yi kafun ta jinjina masa da kai , a haka Uncle ya kama hannun Prince suka futa , dan yasan zuwa dashi ne kawai zai kwantar da hankalinsa. Gudun kar a fuskanci abunda yake faruwa suma su Uncle suka zauna a gida, Ammi kuma ta wuce part d’inta.
   Lokacin da su Uncle suka fito sai ragowar ‘kurar mota da suka gani, dan tuni motocin su Big Boss suka fice da ga gidan. Cikin sauri suma suka shiga mota Captain ya ja su , jikin Prince har rawa yake , ga fuskarsa da ta soma ja kamar wani mara lapiya . Hannayensa biyu kawai ya dam’ke yana addua cikin zuciyar sa.
   
     ***** Su Big Boss suna shiga asibitin direct Emergency aka nufa da su , sai sojojin da gabaki d’aya suka tsare floor d’in da suke. Hakan ne yasa gabaki d’aya mutanan asibitin suka shiga taitayin su , gashi ko hayaniya sun kasa yi, kowa mamakin da yake wanene ya shigo cikin asibitin.
     Big Boss kasa shiga d’akin theatre yayi duk da shine likitan Little. Tunda ya sunkuyar da kansa ko ‘kwa’k’kwaran motsi baya sanyi. Bobo da Sauban duk kasa zama sukai suma . Shigowar Little ne yasa su Bobo suka kallesa, harta Big Boss sai a lokacin ya d’ago da idanuwansa ganin yadda Prince yake tafiya kamar mara lapiya. Da hannu Big Boss yayi masa alamar yazo inda yake, cikin sauri Prince ya nufesa jikinsa har rawa yake wajan furta “ Ya..ya , Little fa..? Abbu fa ?” ‘Dan rungumarsa Big Boss yayi shima Prince ya saki ajiyar zuciya , sai a lokacin hawayen da yake sanyi suka fito masa. A hankali ya furta “ Yaya babu abunda zai same suko?.” Shafa kansa Big Boss yayi , a fusge ya furta “ they will be fine , okay ?” Kansa Prince ya jinjina masa , mai matsa daga inda yake ba sai hannun Big Boss da ya ri’ke cikin nasa. Yadda Big Boss yaji jikin Prince na rawa shiyasa yayi masa side hug. Duk wannan abun da suke su Uncle suna kallan su , dan sosai Uncle ya zuba musu ido. “ He’s truly a father to them ,” ya fad’a yana d’an murmusa wa kad’an , ya yarda a yanzu ko da basu da rai Big Boss bazai bari ‘yan uwansa suyi kuka ba.
    
         ***Mintunan su 37 a wajan kafun a bud’e d’akin theatre d’in , gabaki d’aya kallan Dr d’in sukai suna jin feed back . Ganin yadda sojoji suke ta ko ina ya furta “ Alhamdulillah duk suna lapiya. But I really need to talk to you please , let’s go to the office” kallan sa Bobo yayi “ zamu iya ganin su why not “ Bobo bai jira amsar da zai basa ba ya shige suma su Uncle suka bisa cikin sauri. Kallan Prince da ya tsaya yayi “ Go on i will be back “ ya fad’a yana bin Dr zuwa office d’insa. 
         
          Big Boss na shigowa Dr yayi saurin nuna masa wajan zama, babu musu kuwa ya zauna yana bin Dr da lumshash shun idanuwansa. 
          
       Gyara murya Dr yayi yana shiga nutsuwarsa dan kallan da Big Boss yake masa shi kansa ‘ko’karin rud’ewa yake . “ Alhamdulillah shi saurayin da kuka kawo da alama akwai ‘kwararran Dr da yake kula dashi , hakan kuma ya temaka masa sosai . Ko yanzu bawai ciwan zuciyar sa ne ya tashi ba , abune ya tsorata shi kuma yake tsoran ya faru , hakan ne ya tayar masa da hankali sosai shiyasa har ya soma aman jini , amma idan aka nesan tashi da abunda yake bashi tsoran jikinsa zai cigaba da dawowa normal musamman idan yana cikin farin ciki sai dai kuma His Ex..” katse shi Big Boss yayi ,kai Dr d’insa ne “ straight to the point”, d’an ajiyar zuciya Dr ya sauke da kusan Indai His Excellency yana Nigeria shine yake dubawa time to time, babu wanda yasan kuma shi likitan sane , shiyasa yayi mamaki sosai da Big Boss ya fad’i hakan , ga kamar da ya gani a fuskar su sosai. ‘Kara kallan Big Boss yayi kafin ya furta “ Tabbas His Excellency yana da ciwan zuciya amma bayan hakan akwai wanda yake ‘kara tunzura ciwan nasa, har yanzu mun kasa ganin ainahin abun amma kamar yana shane cikin abun shansa musamman abu me zafi ko kuma cups da yake anfani . ‘Kirjinsa yayi masa nauyi sosai , akwai abunda ya saka wa ransa wanda idan ba’a samo solution d’in abun da yake so ba zai iya zama ajalin sa . Akwai abunda yake bu’kata kuma yake d’aga masa hankali har hakan yana ‘ko’karin…” sai kuma yayi shiru ya rasa ta yadda zai ‘karasa , tsuke fuska Big Boss yayi kafun ya furta “ ka kurmance ne ?” Girgiza kansa Dr yayi kafun ya furta “ Hakan yana ‘ko’karin kunbuyar masa da zuciya zuciya , sabida zuciyarsa tana daf da zuwa last stage wanda da wuya mutum yayi rai”, wani kallo da Big Boss yayi masa bai ‘karasa abunda zai ce d’in ba . Mi’kewa tsaye Big Boss yayi , cikin sauri Dr ya mi’ka masa hannu dan suyi musabaha, kamar zai share sai kuma ya bashi nasan da ko second hud’u baiyi ba ya zare hannunsa tare da ficewa daga office d’in , hannunsa Dr ya kalla yana murmushi , mamakin sa yadda hannun Big Boşs yake da taushi kamar baya komai sai gyara skin d’insa .

Lokacin da su Bobo suka shiga d’akin Abbu da Little ko wannan su yana kan gado , idanuwan Abbu a lumshe da alama bacci yake sai abun oxygen da aka saka masa na ‘karin nunfashi . Daga d’ayan side d’in Little ne a kwance shima , a hankali idanuwan sa suke bud’uwa duk da ba sosai ba . Yana ganin shigowar Bobo yayi ‘ko’karin tashi zaune . Cikin sauri Bobo ya mayar da shi “ Don’t get up” cewar Bobo , d’an hanyar shigowa ya kalla a hankali ya furta “ Ya..ya”, jinjina masa kai Bobo yayi “ yana wajan Dr amma yanzu zai dawo okay ? Akwai inda yake maka ciwo?” Kansa Little ya motsa a hankali, kallan Prince yayi a hankali ya furta “ Yaya Prince lapiya ta ‘kalau fa , kamanta zan warke”, shima Prince kansa ya jinjina masa yana ‘kara matsowa kusa dashi “ Zaka samu sau’ki Little”, su Uncle Isma’il duk kasa magana sukai sai kallan su Bobon da suke. “ Yaya” cewar Little yana ‘kara kallan Bobo , hannunsa Bobo ya ta’ba ba tare da yace komai ba “ please…” shigowar Big Boss d’akin ne yayi saurin furta “ Yaya…” kallansa Big Boss yayi tare da ‘karasowa inda yake bayan ya kalli side d’in Abbu . Akan wani kujera ya zauna da yake gefen Bobo , a karo na biyu Little ya ‘kara furta “ Yaya” yana kallan Big Boss . Lumshe masa ido Big Boss yayi kafun ya furta “ ya jikinka ?” Murmushi sosai akan fuskar Little ya furta “ Am ok now. Yaya please ku…”sai kuma yayi shiru yana kallan Big Boss d’in, hannunsa da ya ri’ke Big Boss ya kalla kafun ya sake kallansa “ it’s okay. Mun dena tunda Little baya so okay ?” Wani murmushi sosai Little yayi kafun ya furta “ kun dena fad’a ko?” Gashin kansa da yake ‘ko’karin rufe masa fuska Big Boss ya gara masa “ ai bamayi, Yayanka ne ba yajin magana ko?” Kansa Little ya jinjina yana kallan Bobo “ Yaya Bobo kayi wa Yaya laifi fa , kuma baka bashi ha’kuri ba”, sosai su Uncle suka murmusa suna ‘kara kallan su , dan hakan ba ‘karamun sanyaya musu zuciya yayi ba . Kunnansa Bobo ya kama yana kallan Big Boss , Yaya Big Boss kayi ha’kuri “. Sai kuma ya kalli Little da yake dariya ‘kasa ‘kasa , ganin kallan da Big Boss yayi masa “ Allah Yaya da zuciya d’aya zaka bashi ha’kuri ba basai ka ri’ke kunnan ka ba”, d’an hancinsa Bobo yaja kad’an mun dena don’t worry , zan bashi ha’kuri , okay ? Yanzu ka kwanta kaga Prince saura kad’ai yayi kuka, kuma Yaya zai saka Simba ya rama masa fa”. Cikin sauri Little ya kalli Big Boss “ Yaya banasan zama anan mu koma gida please “, tun kafun Big Boss yayi magana Little ya ‘kara furta “ Dan Allah Yaya don’t say no kaji?”,kallan time Big Boss yayi kafun ya furta “ zamu koma idan Abbu ya tashi ko?” Cikin sauri Little ya nanata “Abbu” sai a lokacin ya kula da Abbu da kuma su Uncle suke d’akin . “ Don’t worry Autan Abbu , shima zai ji sau’ki kaji”, kansa Little ya jinjina musu yana kallan side d’in da Abbu yake a kwance . 

*****
      A cikin gida kuwa Ammi bata bari sunsan halin da ake ciki ba duk da Abla ta so fahimtar wani abun , musamman yadda taga Big Boss bai kira taba , gashi kusan kamar hakan ne a ‘bangaran su Baby . Lokaci zuwa lokaci suna kallan wayar su sai kuma su ajje . Bata kawo tunanin komai a ranta ba, ganin yadda Fanan tayi shiru ne Abla ta furta “ Tuna’nın mai kike haka ?” ‘Dan shiru Fanan tayi dan ta kasa amsa mata ma “ Yaya Little ko?” Kallanta Fanan tayi sai kuma ta d’an jinjina masa kai “ Kawai wani iri nake ji , like something is wrong” gira d’aya Abla ta d’age mata duk da itama zuciyarta ta kusan ta kasa nutsuwa har yanzu “ kinga masoyiyar Yaya na , karki damu ina tunanin fita sukai , both idan sun dawo ai nasan zai neme ki ko?” Kanta Fanan ta jinjina tana sakin ajiyar zuciya . Sai a lokacin ta samu relief.
      
       A ‘bangaran Harry abun babu dad’i sabida hankalinta yadda yake a matu’kar tashe sabida maganar tarewarta da Dadyn ta yace zatayi yau , sosai hankalinta yake a tashe , ta je part d’in su Abbu dan ta saka su hanashi taga basanan shiyasa tayi saurin guduwa d’akin Mama. Lokacin tana zaune a gefen gadon akan tattausan carfet , ga carbin hannunta da take ja , bacci har ya soma kamata .
       Yadda Harry ta shigo cikin d’akin kamar wacce aka jefota yasa Mama farka wa har tana mi’kewa zaune sabida yadda aka shigo d’akin ya d’an tsorata ta . Kallan Harry tayi da ta shigo d’akin babu ko sallama . “ Yaushe xaki koyi hankali Harira ? Babu sallama zaki fad’o wa mutane d’aki eh?” Turo baki Harry tayi sabida Hariran da Mama ta furta “ Haba Mama wai me yasa kuke san ‘bata mun suna ne ? Harry fa kawai zaki ce amma kina wani Harira sai kace a zamani…” kallanta Mama tayi kafun ta had’e ranta “ tunda rashin kunya kuka zo yi mun fice mun daga d’aki kafun na sassa’ba miki yanzu nan”. Harry sai alokavin ta tuno dalilin zuwan ta . Fuskarta ta marairaice kamar zatayi kuka “ kiyi ha’kuri dan Allah Mama ,ba rashin kunya zan miki ba Allah”, Harry harda share guntun hawayen data ‘ka’kalo “ Mai ya kawo ki?” Cewar Mama dan wannan shine karo na farko da Harry ta shigo mata d’akı a ra’ayin kanta , sai lokacin da ta gabaki d’aya suka shigo dubata da bata da lafiya . “ Dama … Dama..” sai ta kasa ‘karasa abunda take san cewa “ idan baki da abun fad’a ki fad’amun, kin tsaya sai wani dama dama kike cemun . Daman me ? Ko kin kurmance yanzu ?” Kanta Harry ta ‘kara girgiza mata tana fashewa da kuka “ Mama dan Allah ki yiwa Dady magana a raba auran nan ni wallahi bana san shi , baki ganshi bane wani ba’ki dashi kamar tukunyar ‘kasa da ‘katan çıkı da yake dashi ,nasan idan kika wa Dady magana zaiji maganar ki”, girgiza kanta Mama tayi “ har yanzu bakiyi hankali ba kenan ? Kin zauna sai faman kushe halittar mutum kike a gabana ? Sannan mene ne aibun harunan? Tun wuri ki shiga taitayin ki wallahi , da kıke maganar a raba aure daga ni har uban naki wane ne zai raba auren? Ko mune kuma aure ki ? Kinga Harira ki shiga taitayin ki , ba kyajin magana kema wasa wasa . Idan baki shiga hankalin ki ba wallahi yau zan saka a kai ki gidan naki sai naga ta tsiya .” Cike da jin haushi Harry ta furta “ Daman nasan ai ba sona kike ba , idan ba haka ba taya zaki saka ya aura mun talaka bayan ke ba talakan kika aura b…” tsawar da Dady ya mata bata san lokacin da ta gaye kan gadon Mama ba , shigowar Dady kenan sabida kiran sa da Mam tayi d’azu akan batun auran da yayi wa Harry , sai kuma ya shigo ya işke yadda take wa mahaifiyarsa rashin kunya . Hakan kuma ba ‘karamun tunzura shi yayi ba .
       Ganin yadda yake nufo gadan Mama ta dakatar dashi “ ya isa haka , karkayi mata komai , ka zauna muyi magana kamar yadda na kira ka . Ke kuma ki tashi ki koma d’aki za muyi magana anjima.” A guje Harry ta fice daga cikin d’akin , harda hawayenta dan a wannan lokacin batasan wana hukunci zai yi mata ba .
        Kallansa Mama tayi sai kuma ta d’an murmusa “  karka d’auki abun da zafi kuma ban amince kace zakayi mata wani hukunci ba. Auran da kayi mata ma ya isa haka.” Ajiyar zuciya Dady ya sauke yana gyara zaman sa sosai “ Daman Mama akan maganar ce . Zuwa yanzu yaci ace ta tare a gidan mujinta tunda har an d’aura auren , kuma mujin ya bu’kaci Matarsa zuwa yanzu yaci ace ta tare , dan ni Mama in zaki amince mun yau d’innan zata tare” murmushin manya Mama tayi “ ba’ayi haka ba Adam, itama ‘yace ai kamar yadda ake wa amare itama hakan ya kamata ayi mata . Yayi ha’kuri shi mijinta nan da kwana biyar sai akai ta “, basu saba yi mata jayayya ba shima bai musa ba ya amince mata . A haka yayi mata sallama ya fita daga d’akin. Itama kuma ta bu’kaci a kwana biyar d’inne sabida kada ta shiga ha’k’kin mijin . A cikin ‘yan kwanaki biyar d’innan da ta fad’a ya isa ayi mata gyaran jiki kamar ko wacce amarya”. 

********* 
   Su Uncle suna nan a d’akin lokacin da Abbu ya soma motsi da idanuwansa har ya bud’e su gabaki d’aya . Little ne ya soma kallan sa lokacin hira yake da Uncle Isma’il . Cikin sauri ya furta “ Abbu” kallan sa sukai gabaki d’aya dan a lokacin Big Boss , Bobo da Sauban basa cikin d’akin . A hankali ya zare oxygen d’in jikinsa . Sakkowa daga gadonsa Little yayi ya koma na Abbu, Prince da yake gefe ma ya jiyo “ Abbu ka tashi ?” Cewar Little yana ‘kara kallan Abbun . Kansa Abbu ya jinjina masa kafun ya furta “ Auta ya jikin ka ?” Mi’kewa tsaye Little yayi sabida Abbu ya kallesa sosai “ Abbu kalla fa lapiya ta ‘kalau kai muka kawo asibiti,” ta fad’a yana dariya ‘kasa ‘kasa , hararar sa Prince yayi “ zaka fara ko ?” ‘Dan gwalo Little yayi masa yana ‘buya a bayan Uncle da ya ‘kara so wajan . “ Yaya ya jikin nata ?” Cewar Uncle Isma’il , kallan sa Abbu yayi lokacin da ya zauna sosai “ Babu abunda yake damuna daman jiri ne da d’an ciwan kai suka haifar mun hakan. Amma yanzu naji sau’ki, banasan zaman asibitin nan “, cikin sauri Little ya furta “ Abbu kaima baka san zaman asibiti ko? Amma sai su Yaya sun dawo tukunna sai mutafi yanzu zasu shigo kaji”, gashin kansa Abbu ya shafa “ Duk yadda Auta yace “ ‘bata fuska Prince yayi “ Abbu ta Little kawai kake amma ki ka manta dani fa “, hannunsa Abbu shima ya kamata “ waya isa ya manta mun kai ? Prince guda ? Ko kana so Yaya Bobo ya kaimu kurkuku?” Gabaki d’ayan sai sukayi dariyar maganar Abbun. A haka Likita yazo ya sake duba su bayan ya tabbatar da lafıyan jikin su . Wanda ‘yan mintuna ake so Abbu ya ‘kara samu kafun ya mi’ke tsaye .
     
      Bud’e ’kofar da akai ne yasa gabaki d’aya suka kalli hanyar . Sauban ne ya fara shigowa sai Bobo, a bayan su kuma Big Boss ne, idanuwa Abbu ya zuba musu tun shigowar su . A sofa d’in wajan suka zauna kafin Bobo da Sauban suyi masa ya jiki , dan gogan ko motsawa bai yi ba amma gabaki d’aya hankalinsa yana kan Abbun nasu.  Murmushi kad’an Abbu ya saki “ ‘Yan mülkin suna kusa kenan ?” Ya fad’a cikin zuciyarsa , dan wani lokacin idan Big Boss yayi abu sak Judge Omar da kuma mahaifiyarsa , dan kusan halayen su ya kwaso tundaga izzar , har taurin kan nasa .
      
      “ Mudai mun gaji da zaman nan a temaka a mayar damu gida” cewar Abbu. Shima Little da Sauri ya furta “ Yes please Yaya mu tafi gida Abbu da ya farka “, yadda yayi maganar a shagwa’be , Uncle da yake bayansa ne ya ta’ba sa “ Ni tunda ba’a nemi temako na ba , bari na taimaka , gana gani ai Yayan sun ‘ki tashi yanzu ko?”. Bobo ne ya soma tashi “ Uncle bari na kar’bi medicine d’in su sai mu tafi” da haka ya fice daga d’akin .
         Bai fi 5 minutes ba ya dawo d’auke da wata leda white colour . Basu ‘kara mintuna goma ba bayan Dr ya sake duba su . Lokacin Sojijin Big Boss har lokacin suna nan , basu d’auki dogon lokaci ba suka kama hanyar gida .

     Suna komawa gida , kallan su Little Big Boss yayi “ Yaya zasu raka ka sai ka huta , ni zan raka Abbu , okay ?”, a hankali ya furta “ Okay Yaya”, Bobo , Sauban da Little suka wuce side d’in su bayan Sauban ya ri’ke hannun Little . Shi kuma Big Boss ya taimaka wa Abbu da hannun su yake cikin na juna .  Sosai su Uncle hakan yayi musu dad’i shiyasa basu bisu ba gabaki d’ayan su.

Shekara 22 da biyu Kenan , she’s alive ? Ko bata raye?” Yadda ya fad’a ko bata rayen har saida yaja wani dogon nunfashi . 
        
        “ Sitti ta shiga wani hali sosai na rashin ku , lokacin da kuka tafi tayi fishi da kowa musamman Ammun ku , she’s so angry , irin fushin da bata ta’ba yin sa ba , kusan kullum sai ta kira waya ko kun dawo amma bamu same ku ba . Kasan yadda Mama da Sitti suka ‘bata dan kowa ? Dan ko gaisuwar mu dena amsawa sukai . If you can really do favor for me , na ro’keka ka rage wannan fushin haka “. Kallansa Big Boss yayi sosai. A hankali ya furta “ You Love her that much shiyasa kake ‘ko’karin sa kanka a cikin wani condition Abbu? Kasan a wana condition kake amma me yasa kake saka damuwa haka ? Ya kake so nayi wa Little bayani ? Baka damu da yadda zamu ji ba ? Abunda ka damu shine your wife ? Baka damu da yadda mu muka sha wahala ba sabida ita? Why Abbu? Mai yasa kake santa har haka ?”, gashin kansa Abbu yasha kafun ya furta “ ina san matata kamar yadda kake san taka matar. You will soon be a father now, inasan farin cikin da ya ‘bata tsawan shekaru ya dawo , ina so naga my real family, ina so komai ya wuce . Please…” Shiru Big Boss yayi hannunsa har rawa yake amma zuciyarsa bata masa dad’i, har yanzu ya kasa manta lokacin da ya d’auki Little cikin jiki baya ko motsi”. A hankali ya furta “ Sorry Abbu I can’t “. Mi’kewa Big Boss yayi zai fita ba zato ba tsammani Abbu ya tsugunna . A razaje Big Boss yayi kneeling a gabansa cikin Sauri yana kallan fuskar Abbu.

Haba Abbu why?” Yana magana yana tsukawa kansa mari , ganin hakan Abbu yayi saurin mi’kew lokacin fuskar Big Boss har ta soma ja duk da shatin marin da yayi wa kansa bai fito ba . Har lokacin da Abbu ya zama kuma bai tashi daga kneeling d’in da yayi . “ kayi ha’kuri Son”, cikin sauri Big Boss ya girgiza masa kansa “ Am sorry Abbu. Am sorry . Am sorry “. Da mamaki sosai Abbu yake Kallansa ganin yadda yake bashi ha’kuri . Cikin sanyin murya Abbu ya furta let’s talk “. Da haka ya zauna a ‘kasan yadda shima Big Boss d’in zai iya zama . “ Bance ka yafe mata ba . Wannan ra’ayinka ne hakan amma kai kanka kasan tana cikin mawuyacin hali, ko ba komai …. Ko ba komai..” Abbu kasa ‘karasa magana yayi yana jan nunfashi. Hannunsa Big Boss ya kamata , a bazata ya furta “ Zan dawo maka da ita “, cikin sauri Abbu ya furta “ Dagaske kake ? Tell dagaske kake ?” Kansa Big Boss ya jinjina alamar “ E” yana kallan yadda farin cikin ya bayyana  sosai akan fuskar Abbu wanda ya dad’e bai yi irin saba . A haka Big Boss ya zauna wajan Abbu, sosai Abbu yake farin ciki dan ko ta maganar sa ana gane irin hakan , sosai yake jansa da hira , tun suna a ‘kasa har suka koma kan gadon. A haka sukai baccin su tare su biyu.
       
       Gabaki d’aya bayan su Ammi babu wanda yasan abun da ya faru a falourn Abbun. Dan Little su Bobo suna rakashi d’aki ya güdü wajan Fanan, da ganinsa kawai da tayi ya saka ta farin ciki. Wası wası ko akwai abunda ya faru duk ya göğe daga cikin zuciyarta . 

***** Big Boss yai bai koma part d’insa ba sai bayan sallah isha’i, yana shiga kuma ya tarar da Abla a kwance kamar mai bacci . ‘Karasowa kan bed d’in yayi tare da kissing forehead d’inta , cikin sauri ta bud’e idanuwanta daman ba bacci take ba . Ganinsa agabanta ne yasa ta d’an ’bata fuskarta , zata juya masa baya ya ri’ko ta “ Am sorry!” Ya fad’a yana kama kunnuwansa , a sanyaye Abla ta furta “ Na d’auka wani abu ya faru , gabaki d’aya na damu , duk lokacin da bazaka dawo gida da wuri ba please ko ta chart ka fad’a mun. Naji tsoro sosai “, ganin yadda ta soma hawaye ne sosai ya saka ya girgiza mata “ Am sorry Lovely , bazan sake ba amma karkiyi kuka kinji? “ kanta Abla ta jinjina masa lokacin da ya temaka mata ta zauna , a jikinsa ya rungumota yana tapping bayanta a hankali , d’aya hannunsa kuma yana kan cikinta da ya fito sosai yanzu. Itama Abla kamar wacce aka ce za’a kwace mata shi ta saka hannuwanta duka biyu ta rungumosa . Murmushi Big Boss yayi amma a cikin zuciyarsa tunanin yadda zai mata bayanın tafiyar da zai yi yake , baya so hankalinta ya tashi idan tasan inda zashi, ganin yadda take sakin ajiyar zuciya yayi lokaci zuwa lokaci kuma tana lumshe idanuwanta kamar mai jin bacci , bata fi 20 minutes ba bacci ya d’auketa . Ajiyar zuciya ya sauke tare da gyara mata kwanciyar ta , saida ya tabbatar baccin ya d’auketa sosai tukunna ya kunna system d’insa tare da d’auko wata jaka mai cike da na’urori , yadda yake abu cikin system d’in zai tabbatar maka da abune mai muhimmanci yake yi , ga wasu na ura da ya kunna bayan yayi connecting system d’insa . Gabaki d’aya yinin daren bincike ya tsaya yi wanda shi kad’ai yasan akan abunda yake bincikawar. 

     Haka kwanakin suka cigaba da tafiya , kusan kullum bai fiya zama a cikin gidan ba , shiyasa Abla kullum suke tare da su Fanan ko Ammi da Mamy da kullum suke kula da ita sosai. 

     Yau ya kama Friday , kuma a yau Abbu ya bawa kowa umarnin ya saka manyan kaya sabida masallacin juma’ar da yake san süje gabaki d’aya . A lokacin Big Boss baya cikin gidan . Harta su Little manyan kaya suka saka wanda basu ta’ba saka wa ba . Ba ‘karamin kyau kayan yayi musu ba , kamar wasu labarawa haka suka fito , ko wannan su kuma yau ya gyara gashin kansa , Little da yake gyaran gashi har wajan fuska yau babu wanda gyaran sabida hular da suka saka . Tun d’azu Little yake neman ta Inda Big Boss zai shigo amma bai gansa ba , shi da Prince sai faman bin su Bobo da vidoe da hoto suke dan kusan abunda bai ta’ba faruwa ba kenan. Haka kawai gabaki d’aya ko wannan su ya tsinci kansa cikin tsananin farin ciki d annashuwa, ganin lokacin sallah na ‘ko’karin yi , cikin rantsara rantsara motocin da aka shigo da su suka kama hanya suna babban masallacin juma’a , ta ko ina tsaro ne , babu wanda baisan da fitowar President ba , ko ba’a fad’a maka ba , yadda jerin security’s da manyan motocin da suke yawo zaka tabbatar da His Excellency yana ‘kasa . A cikin babban masallacin juma’ar ma , waje na musamman a halin His Excellency suka zauna , wajan sai ya kasance kamar special waje dan sosai masu mu’kami a gwamnati suka halarci sallar kuma’ar da Abbu zai ja da kansa , ciki kuwa harda mataimakin shugaban ‘kasa da governors . Har lokacin Big Boss baya cikin wajan . Abbu da kansa yaja sallar juma’a , kuma da kansa yayi hud’u ba mai ratsa zuciya da bargon jiki. Ana gamawa su Bobo suka mi’ke amma Uncle ya dakatar da su , hankalin su baya kan su Abbun ganin yadda kamar manya ne sosai a wajan shiyasa suka kowa daga wajan Uncle . Babu zato babu tsammani abunda ake fad’a ya girgiza zuciyoyin su cike da tsantsan mamaki. Kusan ‘kara nutsuwa sukai dan gani sukai kamar kunnuwan su baya ji daidai shiyasa suka ‘kara nutsuwa dan sauraran abunda suka ji wani mutumi yanzu. 
       “ Alhamdulillah An d’aura Auran Abdulmaleek Mohammad Taufeeq tare da amaryarsa Eshaal Adam, sai kuma Sauban Muhammad da Amaryarsa Nabila Isma’il Al-Taufeeq ( Baby) sai kuma Ameer Mohammad da amaryarsa Arwa Kabeer, and ‘dan gata Adil Mohammed Taufeeq da Amaryarsa Fanan Mohammad.” Wanda hakan yayi daidai da shigowar Big Boss wajan , cikin shigar manyan kaya da Little tunda aka haifesa bai ta’ba ganin yayan nasa dashi ba …

Gabaki d’ayan su tsaya kallan sa sukai. Tubarkhallah Masha Allah , tabbas Allah yayi halitta , dan ba ‘karamun kyau Big Boss yayi ba cikin manyan kayan jikinsa , sai ya fito kamar kyawunsa na yau na mussamman ne saka da ko yaushe , kansa sanye take cikin hular da yasa blue colour , ga shaddarsa blue da sai faman ‘kyalli take , ganin yadda gabaki d’aya suka tsura masa ido suna binsa da kallo ne yasa ya d’an kawar da kansa gefe yana ‘bata fuska. Da mutane sosai a wajan amma Bobo da Sauban kasa ha’kura sukai dan sosai suke san hakan. Little ma da Prince kusan suman zaune ne ya kama su , abu na farko kalmar auren da sukaji an ambata , dan shi Little gabaki d’aya bai yadda da abunda aka ce ba dan kawowa yake wasu ne masu irin sunansa . Abu na biyu kuma kallan Big Boss yake ko ‘kwa’k’kwaran motsi ya kasayı bayan idanuwansa kawai da yake motsawa. Lokacin da ya ‘karaso side d’in Big Boss , sai suka taka shi a tsakiya shida Sauban. Ga Bobo da yake side d’in Sauban d’in shima .

Cikin ‘kan’kanın lokaci auran ‘ya’yan president ya karad’e ko ina a cikin fad’in Nigeria .

Iya had’uwa da tsaruwa gidan yayi ta ko ina sai san barka. Suna shiga cikin gidan Big Boss bai zauna a falour ba ya wuce warsa d’akinsa da yake sama dan ya tabbata idan ya zauna a falourn zasu dame sa da hayaniya ne .

Hakan ne yasa su Uncle suka dawo tsokanar su. Bobo a sace yayi ‘ko’karin dialing number Eshaal amma switched up , yayi mamakin hakan dan bata kashe wayarta . A karo na biyu ya sake kira a tunaninsa matsalar network ne amma still switched up . Tun yana trying kiran har ya ha’kura ya koma wajan su Abbu . A sanyaye suka gaishe da su Hjy Noori, ko wannan su fuskarsa cike da murmushi ya amsa , abunda ya biyo baya ne yafi d’aure musu kai sabida towel d’in da Kaltoom tace ko wannan su saka ba . Baby kamar tayi musu amma sabida jan kunnan da su Mamy sukai musu yasa dole ko wannan su ya saki towel d’in. Harta Ac d’akin kashewa suka mayar da ita mai dumi, cikin ‘kan’kanin lokaci suka soma zufa dukan su , harta Abla da take bacci sai da ta d’an yaye duvet d’inta . Wani abu mai kama da kurkur suka had’a tare da madara haka suka bi su Baby gabaki d’aya suka soma shafa musu. Babu abunda suke su Fanan banda kallan kallo dan gabaki d’aya sun d’aure musu kai gashi basu fahimci komai ba.

     Hajiya Falmata ce zaune akan kujera , dan yau wani irin kwalliya tasha , a cewarta dan taja hankalin Dadyn Harry idan ya dawo , shiyasa lokaci zuwa lokaci take kallan agogo.

Har lokacin kuma Falmata bata da alamar tanka mata balantana ta nuna tasan da zaman ta a wajan. ‘Dan shiru ne ya biyo baya kafun Hjiya Kareema ta furta “ Daman nazo na sanar miki ne , zamuyi family meeting iya mu kad’ai nan da 30 minutes tunda duka mazan gidan basanan , zamu samu ayi komai a tsakane .  Kamar an fad’a mata wani magana ta wani ‘bata fuska “ wace magana ce haka da sai da suka fita za’ayi idan ba salan munafurki ba kuma mene ne na zuwa ki fad’a mun yanzu? Mai yasa Alhaji tun d’azu da muke tare dashi bai fad’amun ba ? Ko akwai abunda ake ‘kullewa “. Kallanta Hjy Kareema tayi bayan ta mi’ke tsaye “ ba zuwa nayi naja dogon magana da ke ba , sannan duk cikin gidan nan wa kike tunanin zai miki munafurki? Ke awa ? Naga abun naki yana ‘ko’karin wucewa , idan kin ga dama kizo , idan kinga dama kuma kar kizo, daga ‘karshe inaso ku tayamu murya sabida angwancewa da ‘ya’yan ki sukayi”.       Hjy Kareema batsa biyewa Falmata ba , tana ‘ko’karin nufar part d’in Amarya sai gata ta fito cikin shigar abaya , cike da girmamawa ta gaishe da Hjy Kareema kafun ta sakar mata murmushi sosai “ Allah ya sanya Alkairi , yanzu nake samun labarin auran da akayi”, sosai itama Hjy Kareema ta murmusa mata sabida abunda tace , gashi ko a fuska babu alamar jin haushin auran ko ba’kin ciki a tattare da ita . “ Allah yasa ba fita zaki yi ba ? Dan yanzu nake ‘ko’karin sanar miki taron da zamuyi nan da mintuna 30”, kallanta Amarya tayi fuskarta a sake ta furta “ ko kad’an Yaya daman fitowar da nayi zanzo nayi muku Allah ya sanya alkairi ne sai gashi kenan kinzo”. Hakan kuwa y dad’ad’awa Hajiya Kareema ganin Amarya amaimakon ta koma part d’inta zuwa nan da minti 30 d’in sai kuma ta biyota suka bar Hajiya Falmata da ta sume ido bud’e akan kujera .

**** Amal kuwa ita da Kubra ne suka nufi part d’in Hajiya Sa’adatı , dan su sanar wa Yasmeen ‘kunshi da kıtson da zasuyi, lokacin suna zaune itama da mahaifiyarta a falourn , dan a lokacin kamar popcorn Yasmeen take ci ga wayar ta da take faman latsawa gabaki d’aya ta mayar da hankalinta kan abunda take yi . Sallamar su Amal ne yasa ta d’ago da kanta , sai kuma ta mayar tana cigaba da charting d’inta abunta , Hajiya Sa’adatu ma kallan su tayi ta d’auke kanta , kö da suna gaisheta ko kallo basu isheta ba ballan tana su saka ran zata amsa . Suma basu damu ba suka zauna kan 3 sitter d’in da Yasmeen take ganin ta’ki kallan su itama Amal ta furta “ Wajan ki muka zorda , ko baki da labari? Kinsan ya kamata muma muje ayi komai damu”. Hjy Sa’adatu dakatawa tayi daga abunda take jin abunda Amal tace , sai kunnuwa da ta zuba musu tana jiran jin me zasu fad’a . Kallan su Yasmeen tayi kafun ta furta “ kamar ya ? Ni ban fahimce ku ba “, a wannan karan Kübra ce tayi magana dan kamar wani lokaci tafi su saurin hawa , a ‘kufule ta furta “ Ke bikin su Yaya Bobo da za’ayi mana ko baki da labarin d’auri auran sune ?” Ba Yasmeen da akayi yiwa magana ba , kafun ta zabura akan maganar Hajiya Sa’adatu ta rigata bayan wani shegen ashar data ‘kunduma ta ‘kara da zagi kuma . Bakin Yasmeen har rawa yaje wajan furta “ d’aurin aure kuma kamar ya ? Ban gane me kuke so kuce ba . Banasan irin wannan rainin hankalin “ da mamaki Amal da Yasmeen suka kalleta jin abunda tace . Amal zatayi magana Yasmeen tayi saurin mi’kewa tsaye tana nuna musu hanya “ dallah malamai ku tashi ku bar mana d’aki” da haka ta juya a guje ta nufi d’akınta tana kuka , a tsawace cike da tashin hankalin da ya soma bayyana akan fuskarta ta nuna wa su Amal hanya “ munafukai, zaku tashi ku bar wajan nan ko sai na sassa’ba muku? Pillow da ta jefa musu ne yasa suka mi’ke tsaye a rud’e , tun kafun suyi wani yun’kuri Hajiya Sa’adatu ta biyo su a guje , ba shiri suma suka arta a guje ganin yadda take jiyo su kamar zata zane su.

   A ‘bangaran su Abbu lokacin da suka zo yin lunch ganin Big Boss bai sakko ba yasa ya kalli Little . “ Auta kira mana Yaya a sama “, kansa Little ya jinjina masa daman so yake yaje wajan sa, yana barin wajan Prince ya furta “ Abbu shima fa bazai fito yanzu ba, ko Yaya Bobo?” Ya ‘karasa yana kallan Bobo. ‘Dan murmusawa Bobo yayi yana jinjina masa .

      Little yana hawa saman ya rasa a wana d’aki Big Boss yake , sai da ya bi duk ya duba rooms d’in, har zai juya sai ya tuna d’aki d’aya da bai duba ba haka Kawai jikinsa yake basa yayansa yana ciki , shiyasa cikin sauri ya nufi ‘kofar , bakin sa d’auke da sallama ya tura ‘kofar d’akin. Ta ko ida babu haske sai wani dum light kawai da take  a kunne , ta haka Little ya hango bed d’in Big Boss d’in. Kamar mai rad’a ya furta “ Yaya ?” Shiru ba’a amsa masa ba , ‘kara shigowa d’akin yayi a karo na biyu ya kuma ambata sunan “ Yaya “, nan ma shiru babu reply . Jikin gadonsa da yake d’an hango wa ya soma takawa zuwa wajan har ya ‘karasa , hannunsa d’aya ya d’ora akan bedside d’in wajan duk da bai tabbatar da ko menene ba , cikin sauri ya d’auke hannunsa yana mayarwa kan bed d’in a hankali ya soma yawo da hannunsa , bai aune ba yaji ya ta’ba hannun Big Boss . Ajiyar zuciya ya sauke sosai yana zama a gefen bed d’in kamar wani yaro ya furta “ Yaya shine ka share ni ko? Shikenan tunda bakasan yin magana da ni “, jiki a sanyaye ya mi’ke zai fita sai kuma yaji muryar Big Boss da tunda ya shigo ya jisa , magana ce kawai baiga damar yi masa ba . “ what do you want ?” Ya fad’a a fuske , da sauri Little ya koma ya zauna yana furta “ Yaya ! Abbu ne ta yace za’ayi lunch kuma baka fito ba “,  katseshi Big Boss yayi “ later ! Bacci zanyi”, cikin sauri Little ya furta “ Yaya Nima please zan kwanta kaji ? Should i?” Yanzu ma da “ No”, Big Boss ya basa amsa shiyasa yayi shiru ya rasa abunda zai ce. Sarai Big Boss ya fahimci mood d’in da Little ya shiga shiyasa ya furta “ you’re no more Little kamanta yau aka d’aura Aurenka?” Little bai san lokacin da ya kwanta daga bayan Big Boss ba yana sakin wani nunfashi , kamar zaiyi kuka ya furta “ you’re always the best Yaya. Ina sanka sosai da sosai “, shiru Big Boss kamar bazai amsa masa sai kuma ya furta “ Are you happy now ?” Kansa Little ya jinjina kamar Big Boss na kallansa “ you’re my best hero, kullum ina farin ciki because of you , I can’t leave without you Yaya” Big Boss bai bashi amsa ba sai duvet d’in sa da ya lullu’ba masa a hankali ya furta “ sleep up “, hannun sa Little ya ri’ke lokacin da ya kwanta , ko kusa Big Boss bai ce masa komai ba sai lumshe idanuwansa da yayi yana tuno maganganun Little . Shima Little yayi shiru ne dan yasan ba ko da yaushe ya fiya san dogon magana ba . Abu na biyu kuma Tuna’nın Fanan kawai yake , ya kasa yadda shine aka aura wa ita . Wani irin dad’i ne yaji yana taso masa daga ‘kasan zuciyarsa . Idan dad’in da yake fitowa da zallan annashuwa da muradı . Shi kad’ai sai faman murmusa wa yake , a haka bacci ya d’auke sa , sabida yadda ya sakawa ransa tunaninta sosai a ransa da mafarkinta ya soma bacci. 

        ***** Abbu ganin yadda Little ya jima bai fito bane yasa ya kalli su Uncle Isma’il “ Kuci abincin , ina nan zuwa “, da haka ya mi’ke ya nufi saman shima . Yana shiga d’akin ya tarar da ba haske , haka kawai jikinsa ya basa baccin suke kamar yadda yayi hasashe , bai kunna hasken d’akin ba sai hasken wayarsa da ya kunna , a kan gado ya hango su , ga Little da ya d’ora kansa a bayan Big Boss , hannunsa yana cikin nasa kamar wanda aka cewa zai gudu, gabaki d’aya ya cukui kuye sa. Murmushi Abbu ya saki tare da ‘karasowa kan gadon, a hankali ya zare Little daga yadda ya cukurkud’e ya gyara masa kwanciyar sa tare da sumbatar sa a goshi, shima Big Boss , duvet Abbu ya ‘kara lullu’ba masa kafin yayi pecking d’insa a goshi kamar yadda yayi wa Little . Bai bar d’akin ba sai da ya rage gudun Ac d’akin , duk dan kar suyi mura tukunna ya ja ‘kofar a hankali lokacin da zai fita , har lokacin fuskarsa da kyakkyawan murmushinsa , dan duk lokacin da ya gansu tare ba ‘karamun nishad’i hakan yake sa saba , duk da Little ya fad’a masa yana san Yayansa , shi kansa ki Big Boss bai fad’a ba , soyayyar da take tsakanin su babu mai iya rabata sai Allah , soyayya ce kamar wanda d’a da uba suke yiwa junan su dan kamar mahaifinsa haka Little yake d’aukan Big Boss , duk duniya kuma babu mai yi masa shiriritar nan sai Little. Dan ko mai yayi yaci buluş .
        
        Yana sakkowa ‘kasa Prince ya furta “ Abbu yayi bacci a d’akin Yaya ko?” Kansa Abbu ya jinjina yana zama “ ka riga kasan da hakan ko?” ‘Dan ‘karamun dariya Prince ya saki “ Abbu duk lokacin da Yaya zaiyi bacci da safe haka Little yake zuwa wai shima bacci zai yi , amma yanzu da Yaya zai fito shima zaka gansa , haka zai ce maka ya gama baccin”. Gashi kansa Abbu ya shafa “ Don’t worry Son , nasan yunwa ka ke ji, let’s it anjima sai suma su ci nasu ko?” A hankali Prince ya furta “ Eh Abbu”, da haka suka soma cin abincin su, Sauban da Bobo cin abincin kawai suke dan har Allah Allah suke su koma gida ko zasu ga sanyin idanuwan su.

A cikin gida wani irin gyara akayi musu duk da cewa gyaran yini d’aya ne amma babu wanda baya ‘kamshin turare, hatta Abla nata daban sai da akai mata sai faman tashin ‘kamshin turare suke . Har yanzu kuma basu san da maganar auran nan ba . Ganin yadda jikin su ya soma murjewa yasa suka saki jiki aka ci gaba da yi musu. 
   M. Sarah ce tashigo d’akin hannunta d’auke da babban tray sai Jenny da take bayanta itama d’auke da wani jakar a bakin ci. Tsayawa kallanta sukai , lokacin kuma Kaltoom da Hajy Noori sun d’an fita .  “ Good Day Madam’s “. Cewar  M.Sarah , Baby a maimakon ta amsa ta d’an zaro idanta waje “ Ta tabbata babu Inda zamuje yau kenan ? Har abinci ma saidai a dunga kawo mana nan? Mai yasa ne please “, Fanan ce ta bata amsa “ Ke dai kawai tunda yau kulle mu ake san yi sai kiyi biyayya and ni babu abunda yafi bani mamaki kamar su Mamy , yar wayoyinmu Mamy ta kar’ba , and ko kusa na tabbata suna ‘kasa”. ‘Yar dariya Abla tayi tana d’ağa musu wayarta “ Ayya ‘yan yara aushe baku da waya yanzu . Ku fad’a mun gaskiya mai zakuyi da wayan? Kingan ki Baby? Tun d’azu sai kallan agogo kike , ko duk a cikin tunanin Yaya Sauban d’in ne ?” harararta Baby tayi tana d’auke kanta , ganin yadda Arwa da Eshaal suka soma Abla ta kalle su d’aya bayan d’aya “ bari dai abar kaza cikin gashinta amma gabaki d’ayan ku sirrin zuciyar ku ta fito fili, kunga duk ba yanzu ba Baby na yunwa yake ji, nima uwar Babyn yunwa nake ji , idan bazaku ci abincin ba ni dai zanci “, d’an harararta Baby tayi “ Daman haka zakice mana , kullum sai shegen ci, muma idan mukai zuciya ai zamuyi cikin dan mene ne abun wahala . Idan na tashi haihuwa ma sai nayi 5 ajere abuna, ba dai haihuwa bace ?” Wani irin shegen dariyar mugun Abla ta soma , Arwa dake side d’inta itama ta fara dariyan sabida abunda Baby ta fad’a . Dariyar da suke sai yasaka gabaki d’aya suka tsargu. Wani dariyar Abla tayi kafun ta furta “ ba komai fa abu kawai na tuna shine ya d’an ban dariya” sai kuma ta kalli Arwa , itama cikin sauri ta furta “ Nima na d’an tina wani abu ne fa amma yanzu kunga abincin namu kar yayi sanyi , ku taho muci kawai”, ta fad’a hakan da ta kashe maganar, da haka suka sakko suka soma cin abincin su hankali kwance . 

   ‘Karfe 6:10pm na yamma su Mamy suka shigo da wasu manyan ledo ji , daidai lokacin da suke ‘ko’karin yin sallar magriba . Mamy da Ammimi basu ce musu komai ba sai da suka tabbatar sun idar da sallan nasu, kafun  Ammi ta nuna musu ledo jin “ Ku shirya cikin kayan da suke cikin ledo jin nan , bayan sallar isha’i zamuje wani waje , kun jini?” Cikin sauri Abla ta furta “ Ammi har dani ko?” Ammi bata amsa mata ba sai Mamy da ta furta “ ‘kwarai ma kuwa Daughter , idan babu ke ai babu inda za’aje , kar kuyi letti dai musamman ke Fanan da shegen la’ka’kin nan naki, ana idar da sallar ku sakko ‘kasa kunji ni?”, kusan a tare suka furta “ insha Allahu”. Da haka su Mamy suka bar d’akin. Bubbud’e ledojin suka somayi , Abaya ne masu shegen kyau da d’aukar hankali , duk wanda ya gansu zai tabbatar ba ‘karamin kud’i aka kashe wa Abaya’s d’in nan ba . Ga Under wears da aka saka wa ko wacce a ledan ta dan sai da Mamy tayi musu bayanı. Basu ‘bata lokaci ba sukayi wankan su gabaki d’aya tare da alwala . Haka suka shirya gabaki d’aya cikin Abayiyin da ko waccen su ta d’auka, kusan ko waccen saida a bayan ta haska su kamar wasu ‘yan biyar , ba ‘karamun kyau hakan yayi musu ba . Basuyi makeup a fuskar su ba ko powder babu wacce ta saka sai lipgloss da suka shafa fari dukan su amma banda Abla şunda tasan Sunsine d’inta ya hanata saka wa sai in yananan shi kad’ai. Suna ‘ko’karin fesa turare tayi saurin furta “ ku tsaya please”, dakatawar sukayi dan shaf sun manta bata san ‘kamshin turare , saida suka bari ta fita daga d’akin tukunna suka fesa , shima kad’an yadda bazai dame ta ba . Sai da ta bata kusan good 5 minutes tukunna ta dawo d’akin lokacin ‘kamshin ya fara guduwa daga d’aki, ga kiran sallar isha’i da ake , sallar su kawai sukayi tare da sakkowa ‘kasa ba tare da sun ‘bata lokaci ba , ko wannan su tunanin inda zasuje cikin zuciyarsa yake dan sai abun ya zamar musu kamar sabo, fita da daddare ba ma safe ba . 
     Sai da suka kusa 20 minutes a falourn su kad’ai kafin su Aunty Nusaiba suka shigo d’akin ita da Aunty Mubina ( Amarya )da kuma Hajiya Kareema . 
        “ Masha Allah, gashi nan kun fito tass kamar zana ku akayi , tubarkallah Masha Allah “. Cewar Aunty Nudaiba. ‘Dan murmusawa su Aunty Mubina sukai kafun Hajiya Kareema ta furta “ ku taso yarana muje , bamu da lokaci” kallan juna sukai su Abla sabida yadda kan su yake ‘ko’karin kullewa , da farı zuwan su Mamy , yanzu kuma ga zuwan su Aunty Nusaiba , basu da wani za’bin ne sai su bisu shiyasa babu musu suka mi’ke tare da biyo su. Su Hajiya Nusaiba suna gaba su kuma suna bayan su, suna tafiya zuciyar su na harbawa dum dum ba tare da sunsan dalilin hakan ba”.
        Ganin sun nufi part d’in Abbu gabaki d’aya sukayi tsuru tsuru , ko wannan su tunanin dalilin zuwan falourn Abbu suke duk da ba yau aka fara hakan ba. 

Suna shiga Abbu sukatar a falourn sai su Ammimi dan ko Mama da Didi basa cikin falourn yau . Abla mamaki ne ya kamata sosai ganin su Little da manyan kaya , dan tunda ta sansu bata ta’ba ganin su da manyan kaya ba , harta shi gogon nata dan kusan kullum ‘kananan kaya ne a jikinsa .  
     Tunda Suka shigo su Bobo suke kallan su ta ‘kasan ido , kowa ya zubawa matar sa ido , ganin gani suke kamar canza musu a kayi . A ‘bangaran su Baby basu san me ke faruwa ba shiyasa lokaci zuwa lokacin suna satar kallan su , dan suma manyan kayan da suka gani a jikin su ba ‘karamun mamaki ya basu ba , gwanda Baby da Sauban yake sakawa lokaci zuwa lokaci . 
     Sai da suka gaishe da su Abbu tukunna suka samu waje daga side d’in su Mamy suka zauna.
         Tun shigowar su falour tasan baya ciki,amma duk da haka bata gama gasgatawa ba sai data d’an ‘kara satar kallan inda su Little suke taga baya ciki. Gashi duk da dare ne babu wanda zai ce had’uwar manyan kayan bata haska su ba. Gyara zama Abbu yayi sosai yana kallan su , kafin ya ce komai yasa Uncle Isma’il ya bud’e musu taro da addu’a. Ko da ya gama bai ce musu komai ba sai nasiha da bin iyaye da ya nutsar dasu. Abun mamaki babu Hjy Falmata da Harry a falourn, harta Hjy Sa’adatu da ‘yar ta Yasmeen basa cikin falourn dan ko meeting d’in d’azu da aka ce musu suzo ‘kin zuwa sukai gabaki d’ayan su , shiyasa suma su Mamy duk suka share su.
         
    Shiru ne ya d’an biyo baya na wasu mintuna kafun Abbu shima ya d’anyi nasiharsa kafun yazo kan maganar da ya tara su dominta . “ Nasan wasu daga cikin ku suna mamakin wannan kiran da akayi muku, duk da ba saban abu bane amma ya zama ha’k’kin mu kuma mu sauke nauyin da Allah ya d’ora mana. Alhamdulillah gabaki d’aya munyi abunda ya dace yanzu saura biyayyar ku a garemu, bazan ja abunda da tsaho ba , ina tabbatar wa da gabaki d’ayan ku, a rana irin ta aka d’aura muku aure , aure kuma bada ‘yan uwanku na bare ba , face ‘yan uwan ku na jini.” Gabaki d’aya wani irin harbawa zuciyoyin su sukayi sabida jin abunda yake fad’a , dan ita Fanan ji tayi kamar jiri jiri yana neman shigarta , fargabar su gabaki d’aya ba ‘a kan auran bace yanzu face da wanka aka d’auka , Baby kamar zatayi kuka amma haka kowa ya d’aure babu wanda yayi magana , Abla kuwa zuru zuru tayi jin abunda Abbu yace , sai kuma murmushi da ya ‘kwace mata dan sai yanzu ta fuskanci dalilin hana su fitowa da akayi d’azu.
     Maganar Abbu ne yasa ta dakata da tuna’nın zucin da take “ Babu wanda za’ayi wa dole a cikin ku, kuna da kwana biyu duk wacce taga bata amince da mijin da aka bata ba , ta zo ta sameni , dan ni da kaina zan raba auran, babu wanda za’ayi wa dole . Abu na ‘karshe kuma “ sai yayi shiru yana duba wasu files “ wannan takaddun shagunan da aka bud’e muke amaimakon bidi’ar da zakuyi, akwai mai magana ?” Shiru duk sukayi kowa ya kasa motsawa a cikin su . Ganin sun ‘kasa magana Uncle Kabeer ya furta “ Mun gode sosai Abbu, Allah ya ‘kara arziki” gabaki d’aya suka amsa da Ameen , suma su Fanan cikin zuciyoyin su duk suka amsa dan bakin su yayi musu nauyin da bazasu iya cewa komai ba . Shima Abbu ya fahimci yadda suka kasa sakewa shiyasa ya furta ya sallame su. Jiki a sanyaye sukayi masa godiya da addu’ar da saida ta saka shi ya murmusa sosai kafin su mu’ke ciki a sa’bule zasu bar falourn . Su Bobo kamar wanda ake tsikara gabaki d’aya sun kasa motsawa , jira kawai suke su fita sai su biyo su a baya suma . 
     
    “ Wait “ shine kalmar da ta daki kowa na falourn, yadda akayi maganar a fusge yasa gabaki d’aya kowa ya kalli wajan da muryar ta fito duk da kasancewar sun san wanene mamallakin muryar . Fuskarsa ba a sake take ba kuma ga a had’e ba ya ‘karaso cikin falour, yanzu ma cikin wani yadi mai shegen kyau da santsi, Abla kasa d’auke idanuwanta tayi daga kansa sabida bata ta’ba ganin sa cikin irin wannan shigar ba ,kansa baby hura da gyaran gashin kansa da yayi masifar yi masa kyau ba kad’an ba , wani irin turare ne mai sanyaya zuciya , gashi mara hayaniya ya saka a jikinsa . Da hannu yayi musu alamar su koma su zauna . Babu musu kuwa duk suka zauna suna jiran jin abunda zai ce . Wasu files Big Boss ya mi’kawa Uncle Kabeer . Da mamaki Uncle Kabeer ya kallesa sabida bu’katar 'karin bayani da yake so. Sai da ya mula dan kansa tukunna kafun ya soma magana “ Bayanin takardur asibitinta ne da gidan marayun da ta zauna, da gaske ne she’s your daughter” a zabure Uncle ya mi’ke tsaye har yanzu bai fahimci abunda Big Boss yake cewa ba , a hankali ya furta “ Mai kake nufi Farooq?” ‘Dan shiru ne ya biyo baya na kusan sakanni 60 kafin ya şarta hannunsa zuwa saitin inda Arwa take “ Uncle ! She’s your daughter “, wara idanuwanta Arwa tayi , lokaci d’aya taji wani irin hawayen da batasan ko ta ina bane yana ‘ko’karin sakko mata a idanuwa , cikin sauri ta dam’ke hannun Abla da ke side d’inta. 
    
       Duk da Nani ta fad’i hakan amma gabaki d’aya sai maganar ta zowa kowa kamar a bazata . Babu wanda baiyi farin cikin hakan ba . Tsabar murya Uncle baisan lokacin da yayi sujjada ba yana yiwa Allah Godiya . Gabaki d’aya kasa d’agowa yayi saida su Bobo duka d’ago da shi , cikin su Abla babu wanda baiyi hawaye ba , ganin abunda Uncle yayi , ga kuma ‘karin farin cikin da ya same su , su kansu kowa murmushi yake dan harta su Mamy saida suka göğe ‘kwallar da ta tarar musu a cikin idanuwa. Dan tabbas Uncle mutum ne , ya cancanci ko wace irin kyautatawace , sosai Arwa take kuka , bata sani kukan farin ciki zatayi ko kuma akasin hakan. A hankali Abla ta soma tapping bayanta alamar tayi shiru itama tana göğe hawayen da yake ‘ko’karin sakko mata a kan fuskarta . 
       
        “ Ya isa haka Daughter, yanzu ba lokacin kuka bane kinji?” Cewar Uncle Isma’il da yake kallanta , a hankali Arwa ta jinjina kanta tana share hawayen fuskarta . Allah sarki Uncle Kabeer idanuwansa gabaki d’aya ja sukayi sai kallan yadda Arwan take kuka yake , cikin ‘kasan zuciyarsa kuma godiya da kirari kawai yake wa ubangijinsa , ga addu’o’in da yake yiwa Big Boss da ahalin gidan wanda shi kansa bazai ce ga adadın addu’ar da zaiyi musu ba . 
         Duk gabaki d’aya sun fahimci yadda Uncle Kabeer yake bu’katar ganawa da ‘yarsa , dan ba ‘karamun halacci yayi wa a halin gidan ba shiyasa gabaki d’aya aka yi addu’o’i da ga Allah , sannan aka tashi cikin taron gabaki d’aya . Ammi da su Mamy gabaki d’aya suka tattara kan su Baby suka tafi da su , sai a lokacin Uncle Kabeer ya samu damar ke’bewa da ‘yarsa , Arwa na ganinsa ta rungumesa tana sakin kuka ‘kasa ‘kasa . Shima dauriya ce kawai irin tasa yake yi , gashi ya kasa magana sai tapping bayanta da yake alamar lallashi , a hankali Arwa ta furta “ Ina sanka Baba na .” Sosai Uncle ya murmusa har saida ha’kwaransa suka fito waje , ga wani hawaye da yaji ya sakko masa . A jiyar zuciya ya sauke yana ‘kara rungumarta “ Nima ina sanki sosai “. Murmushi Arwa ta saki tana kallansa kafun ta furta “ Dagaske ?” Kansa ya jinjina mata tare da share mata hawayen da ya d’an sakko mata “ Yau ba ranar kuka bace, stay happy always , Allah ya albarkaci rayuwar ki “ hawayen fuskarta be dena sakkowa a face d’inta ba a haka ta amsa da amin. Sun d’an jima sosai kafin ya sa ta koma cikin gida tunda dare yayi shi kuma ya koma falourn Abbu da yasan su Big Boss har lokacin suna ciki. 
         Abla kai tsaye part d’inta ta koma sabida Mamy da ta kora ta . Tana zuwa wanka kawai ta somayi tare da saka kayan bacci mai d’an kauri a jikinta , sai humra da ta saka . A kan bed ta zauna tana kiran dawowar sa dan har yanzu bata dena mamakin auran su Baby ba kamar Almara , tun tana saka ran dawowar sa har bacci ya d’auketa bai shigo ba .
         
       ***Su Bobo kuwa koda suka fito trying number matan su sukeyi amma ko wacce wayanta switch up , gashi babu damar suje part d’in yanzu. Duk wata hanya da suka san zasu same su , su Mamy sun toshe wannan hanyar , babu yanda suka iya dole haka suka ha’kura suka nufi part d’in su .
       
  Su Baby ma tunanin auran da aka ce anyi musu da rashin sanin ko wanene angon yafi komai d’aga musu hankali . Basu zauna wani hira bai ko wannan su ya kwanta da tunani fall cikin zuciyoyin su . Ko da Arwa ta dawo d’akin sun kwanta shiyasa itama ta samu waje ta kwanta sai faman murmushi take, moment d’inta da mahaifinta sosai ya tsaya mata cikin zuciyarta.

***** Lokacin da ya koma part d’insa murmushi kawai yayi kad’an tare da ‘karasa kan bed d’in da take , d’an rankwafowa yayi kad’an tare da kissing goshinta , Abla har saida ta d’an motsa amma bata bud’e idanuwanta ba sabida yadda baccin ya soma cin ‘karfinta , gyara mata kwanciyarta yayi sosai tare da lullu’beta da duvet . 
      Sai da ya sake wanka ya saka kayan bacci tukunna ya kunna system d’insa da yake yawan anfani da ita akwana kinan, yanzu wani aikin yake yi a cikin sa , sosai ya mayar da hankali a kan abunda yake . A wannan karan ma sai da ya raba dare sosai yana aiki cikin ta , sai da tare ya tsala sosai ya kwanta , tare da rungumo Abla ta koma jikinsa , a haka sukayi baccin nasu rungume da zuna .


THE NEXT DAY 
Yau ma su Mamy basu bari su Fanan sun had’u da mazajan su ba , sai phone d’in su da aka mi’kawa ko waccen su. Ko da aka basun ma babu wanda yabi ta kanta , dan har yanzu basu dena tunanin auran ba , gashi abunda ya fi damun su rashin sanin ko wane ne mijin da basu yi ba . Suna gama breakfast aka cigaba da musu gyara, babu wanda ya sake bi takan su Falmata duk da su Mamy sun bu’kaci ayiwa Harry gyara da su Fanan amma suka nuna basa bu’kata shiyasa suma suka rabu da su ko sau d’aya kuma babu wanda ya kuma bi ta kansu dan duk cikin su Ammi da Mamy suna da zuciya , ko sau d’aya basu kuma bu’katar Inda suke be balantana su saka su a cikin sabgar su.

 “ Sunshine ?” Cewar Abla tana kallan Big Boss da bai dad’e da shigowa ba .
 Hannunsa ya mi’ka mata alamar tazo , babu musu kuwa ta nufi inda yakın. Akan laps d’insa ta zauna tare da jingina kanta a kafad’un sa shi kuma ya d’ora hannunsa akan cikinta da kullum yake ‘kara tasowa “ Am sorry! Na barki kina ya jira ko?” Girgiza masa kai Abla tayi tana d’ora hannunta d’aya akan sumar gashin kansa “ Ai nasan abubuwa ne sukayi maka yawa shiyasa. Amma…” sai kuma tayi shiru tana kallansa. Shima kallan nata yayi “ Amma me ?” ‘Dan shiru Abla tayi sai kuma ta sake kallansa . A hankali ta furta “ Auran su Fanan dagaske Abbu yake ? Wane ne mijin su? Yaya Little fa Fanan yake so, Yaya Prince kuma Arwa, Yaya Bobo kuma Eshaal, sai Yaya Sauban kuma Baby…" cikin sauri kuma ta toshe bakinta tana zazzare idanuwa dan bata san lokacin da ta fara fad’a ba. Hannun ya zare daga bakinta “ Oh already kin sani kenan?” Fiki fiki tayi masa da ido, ganin hakan yasa ya matso da fuskarsa daidai saitin tana har suna jin nunfashin junan su “ Now tell me . Farooq kuma wace ce budurwarsa?” Ajiyar zuciya ta soma saukewa , cikin sauri tayi ‘ko’karin tashi amma sai ya rigata , both hannayensa ya saka ya zagayo ‘kugunta yanda bazata tashin ba . “ Oya tell me !” Ya fad’a da wani irin salo da saida tsigar jikinta ta shi, murmur ta soma yi da bakinta , sai ta kasace masa komai dan gabaki d’aya ya kashe mata lakar jikinta.

Murmushi Abla ta saki tare da jan hancinsa har saida ya d’an ja baya . ‘Kara sakin dariyar tayi sosai sabida yadda taga ya ‘bata fuska.

Ki shirya biyan kwanakin nan now”. Cike da tsoro Abla ta zaro idanuwanta , zata soma masa complain d’inta na kwana biyu ya had’e lips d’insu. Tsoro ne ya d’an kama Abla sabida last be mata da sau’ki ba shiyasa take tsoro.

Big Boss kusan mantawa yayi da cikin dake cikin Abla, dan sosai ya murjeta san ransa, duk cizo da ya kushin da take masa bai ‘kyaleta , har saida ya samu nutsuwa sosai. Sai a lokacin ya soma jin shash she’kar kukanta da take masa. Cikin sauri ya mayar da dubansa kan cikinta da ta d’ora hannunta d’aya a wajan . “ Ya Allah”, ya fad’a ‘kasan zuciyarsa , hannunsa d’aya ya saka ya zare hannunta da ta kulle fuskarta. Cikin sauri Abla ta ‘kwace hannunta tana ‘kara kulle fuskarta . ‘Kara matsowa kusa da ita yayi “ Are angry with me ? Kuka kike ?” Ya fad’a a sanyaye , girgixa kanta Abla tayi tana juyar da fuskarta gefe “ Ni ba kuka nake ba , abune ya shigar mun ido”, ta ‘karasa kamar me shirin sakin wani kukan. Ganin yadda ta bashi baya yasa ya kwanta daga bayanta yana matso da ita jikinsa “ Am sorry!” Ya fad’a a hankali, a jiyar zuciya Abla ta sauke tana had’e kukan ta , a shagwa’be ta furta “ Ni fa abune ya shigar mun cikin ido, kuma…” sai ji tayi ya ‘karasa mata “ Kuma I hurt you .”murmushi ta d’ora sosai kan face d’inta tana juyowa wajan sa “ Ni ai bakayi mun laifi ba “ ta ‘karasa maganarta tana ja masa hancin sa cike da d’an mugunta”, shima hannu yasaka zai ta’ba hancinta tayi saurin ‘boye fuskarta a jikinsa tana dariya ‘kasa ‘kasa . Hugging d’inta Big Boss yayi kafun ya furta “ What’s your biggest fear?” Yana fad’a mata hakan sai taji zuciyarta ta buga da ‘kirfi tsoran wani na shiga cikin zuciyarta da bata san ko na mene ne ba . Cikin sauri ta d’ago fuskarta tana kallan tasa da ya d’auke “ My Biggest fear?” Ta ‘kara nanatawa , kansa ya jinjina mata a wannan karan maimakon ya amsa mata “ Bana so ka tafi ka barni , baba so kayi nesa dani, just don’t leave me alone”, sai kuma cikin muryar kuka ta furta “ I can’t leave without you”, 
  “Ya Allah !” Shine abunda ya shiga cikin zuciyarsa , so yake yayi controlling kansa amma tana san fallasa abunda ke cikin zuciyarsa , shiyasa bai tsaya ba ya d’auketa gabaki d’ayan suka nufi toilets tana hannunsa.

***** Suna fitowa daga wanka tare suka shirya abunsu, zai fesa turare ta furta “ wait “ zata matsa ya hanata sai turaren da ajje ya d’auki irin nata ya saka “ Yanzu fa?” Ya fad’a yana kallanta , da ‘yan yatsu ukun ta yayi masa alamar perfect tana d’age masa gira . Girgiza kansa yayi kad’an tare da pecking d’inta “ I want to go somewhere now , naje ko karna tafi ?” Yadda yayi maganar Abla ba shiri ta soma dariya sai kuma ta tsaya “ Nima please zanje wajan su Fanan kaji?” Lumshe mata idanuwa yayi kafun ya furta “ karki dad’e amma , let’s go”, da haka suka fito daga da’kin har suka fito part d’in , hannun su sar’ke da na juna . Part d’in su Ammi suka nufa lokacin Abbi na cikin falourn shida Ammi , cikin sauri Abla ta zare hannunta , tana nufar Abbi. “ Aby barka da rana “, kallanta Ammi tayi “ sannu masu Abby mu kuma ko oho ko? Allah yasa wata yarinya tace tanasan abu”, marairaice fuska Abla tayi tana kallan Abby “ Rabu da ita , kina da Abby wa ya isa ya ta’ba mun ke, ko me kike so just tell me zan sa a kawo miki “ cikin sauri ta furta “ Dagaske ?” Kansa ya jinjina mata yana murmushi , ita shaf ta manta tare da Big Boss suka shigo “ Abby zansha Ice cream da Youghurt “ kallan side d’in a Big Boss yayi ganin yadda ya murtuke fuskarsa , zuru zuru tayi da idanuwa ganin kallan da ya jefa mata , cikin sauri ta furta “ No ! Abby na fasa bana sha , an hanani shan abu mai sanyi”, Ammi ce ta kalli Big Boşs “ Rabu dasu Son, ka zauna mana “, girgiza kansa yayi “ No Ammi , zance wani waje yanzu , amma idan na dawo zan zo nayi dinner . Uncle I’m off”. Ya fad’a yana juyawa . Kallanta Uncle yayi “ Daughter jeki raka mijin ki maza” a sanyaye ta mi’ke ta fito itama lokacin har ya shiga mota antayar, tana ganin motocin sun soma tafiya taji hawaye suna sakko mata , hannunta duka biyu ta saka ta rufe fuskarta zata juya a guje Big Boss da ya fito daga motar ya ri’ko hannunta “ Becareful”, ya fad’a a hankali, cikin sauri Abla ta kallesa “ Sunshine am sorry kaji” bai amsa mata ba sai hawayen da ya göğe mata “ bana san kuka fa , bana hanaki shan kayan sanyi ba ? Mai yasa kike so Uncle ya siya miki?” Cikin sauri ta girgiza masa kai “ Bazan sha ba I promise , na dena”, hancinta ya d’an dalla “ okay fine , ki koma ciki yanzu “, kanta ta jinjina masa a hankali zata juya ya kuma tsayar da ita “ list anything you want amma banda kayan za’ki da sanyi “. Shiru tayi sai kuma ta furta “ kad’an fa nake so , yawwa sai capri-sun”  
     “ okay fine Bobo zasu kawo miki, take care”, kanta Abla ta jinjina masa, sai da yağa wucewarta tukunna ya shiga mota suka bar wajan shima . 
     Abla tana shiga falourn ta furta “ Ammi na” Harararta Ammi tayi  “ wannan ne kuma baki isa ba , da kika shigo wajan Abbyn ki kuka nufa , dan haka nima babu ruwana dake “, kamar zatayi kuma ta furta “ Abby”, waje ya nuna mata “ Don’t worry , tana kishin mune, don’t mind her “, murmushi sosai Abla tayi , mi’kewa Ammi tayi ta nufi kitchen , sai kuma ta dawo d’auke da wani bwol ne kyau da spoon “ gashi ba daban halin ki ba “, ta fad’a tana mi’ka mata had’in zogalan da tayi mata , Abla har da ‘yar dariya lokacin da ta amsa tana godewa Ammin, spoon d’in farko Abby ta kaiwa baki , sai ya girgiza mata kai “ Please Abby”. Ta fad’a tana mi’ka amsa spoon d’in , ba musu ya bud’e bakinsa ta saka masa spoon d’in zogalan, yana soma taunawa ya furta “  daughter you have sweet hand , kinji yadda d’and’anan ya banbanta?” Dariya Abla tayi tana satar kallan Ammi da ta share su, da kansa Abby ya kar’bi zogalan yasoma bata a baki, sai da tacı sosai tukunna ya ‘kyaleta . Abla ta dad’e a sashen su tana hira da su Abbu , har saida akayi sallar azahar bayan tacı abinci ta güdü wajan su Fanan , da tun da ta doso wajan ta soma jin ‘kamshin turaran da ake musu gyara dashi, tana shiga tayi saurin jan baya tana toshe hancinta “ idan ‘kamshin ya ragu zan dawo but not now “, ta fad’a tana fita daga d’akin da sauri . Su Fanan kuwa yau ba ‘karamin gyara suka shaba , dan sosai su Hajy Noori suke gwangwaje su.

Abla tana sakkowa ‘kasan ta had’u da Sauban da Bobo da suka shigo falourn yanzu. Tana gaishe su Bobo yayi saurin furta “ ina Ammi da Mamy?” A hankali Abla ta furta “ Ammi tana part d’inta , Mamy kuma ina tunanin tana d’aki dan yanzu zan shiga wajanta . Tana kallan yadda suka wani saki ajiyar zuciya kusan a tare , Sauban ne ya furta “ Sister’s d’inki fa?” Yanzu ma reply tayi musu da suna sama , kallanta Bobo yayi “ Sister can you do me a favor ?”, kanta Abla ta jinjina masa da sauri , “ Called your sister for me , zan jira ki anan corridor d’in kinji?” Abla kamar zatayi dariya ta jinjina masa kai , Sauban kasa magana yayi sai ‘keya da yake ta ‘bawa “ bari na kira muku su” ta fad’a tana juyawa .

Abla tana shiga d’akin taga suna binta da idanuwa , kallan Eshaal ta somayi “ kizo inji Ammi”, bata bari sun bata damar magana ba tayi saurin fita , kallan juna sukayi sai kuma ta kalli jikinta ganin towel ne kawai, hijab d’inta Fanan ta nuna mata “ Ga hijab can , ki saka mana kawai kije ki dawo tunda Ammi ke kiran ki”. Kanta Eshaal ta jinjina , bata kawo komai cikin ranta ba , ta fito daga d’akin cikin dogon hijab d’in Fanan. A kan step ta tarar da Abla , zatayi magana Abla ta soma tafiya sai da suka sakko tsakiyar Falourn tukunna Abla ta dafe goshinta “ kash namanta aushe har da Baby Ammi tace na kira” sai kuma ta kalli Eshaal , “ Ammi tana corridor d’in can , kawai ki ‘karasa kar mu barta tana jira ni kuma bari na koma na kira Baby”,  toh kawai Eshaal tace mata tana nufar corridor d’in , dan duk a tunaninta Ammin ce a ciki kamar yadda Abla ta fad’a .

Tana shiga sai ta tarar da ba Ammi, duk a tunaninta Ammi tana can çıkı ne shiyasa itama ta nufi cikin, har kwanar da zatayi a wajen kawai taji an janyota, baki ta bud’e zata ‘kwala ihu yayi saurin rufe mata bakin , dai dai saitin kunnanta ya furta “ Ni ne” a jiyar zuciya Eshaal ta sauke fahimtar ko wane ne , sai kuma bugawar da zuciyarta ta somayi da Sauri Sauri ganin yadda ya ri’keta sosai gashi ko ‘kwa’kw’kwaran motsi ta kasa . Cikin sar’kewar harshe ta bud’e bakinta “ ina.. ina wuni”, Bobo bai amsa mata ba sai kallanta da ya tsaya yi hakan yasa gabaki d’aya ta soma jin wani irin a jikinta .  “ kinyi kyau” ya fad’a kamar wanda ake masa dole . Cikin sauri Eshaal ta furta “ Ammi tana kira na..” ‘kin sakinta Bobo yayi ganin tana ‘ko’karin kawar da kanta gefe ya furta “ Look at me “ ‘kin kallansa tayi kamar yadda ya fad’a , ba zato ba tsammani ya saka hannunsa a ‘kugunta , a tsorace Eshaal ta d’ago tana kallansa , jikinta har ya soma rawa , lips d’inta sai motsi yake , hakan kuma ba ‘karamin jan hankalin sa yayi ba shiyasa ya ‘kara rungumota cikinsa , dan tun a ri’ke war farko da yayi mata ya fuskanci babu kaya ajikinta . Eshaal kamar zatayi kuka ta furta “ Ni ka sake ni, Ammi na kira na “, le’kowa fuskarta yayi tayi saurin kaucewa , ‘kara kallanta yayi ganin yadda ta tsorata “ tsoran me kike ? Ko bakiji abunda Abbu ya fad’a ba ? You’re now my wife , I can do anything to you now, kamar haka”, ya soma ri’ke hijab d’inta ,cikin sauri Eshaal ta ri’ke hannunsa tana kallansa “ kayi ha’kuri please”, sakin hijab d’in yayi kamar yadda ta bu’kata “ na ha’kura amma ki kunna wayar ki, if not yau a d’aki na zaki kwana , and i mean it, kinji?” Cikin sauri ta jinjina masa kanta “ zan kunna”, murmushi yayi tare da furta “ Good” Eshaal kamar zatayi kuka ta furta “ Su Ammi sun hana mu fita kuma zasu iya zuwa yanzu” kanshi ya jinjina mata tare da sakinta , babu shiri ta juya zata saka güdü ya ri’kota , d’an zaro ido Eshaal tayi batayi aune ba ya had’e lips d’in su , a tsorace Eshaal ta soma kokawar ‘kwace wa amma ‘karfin su ba d’aya ba , sai da ya sake ta tukunna ta saka güdü ba tare da ta ‘kara waiwayo wa ba , shi kuma kasa motsawa yayi daga inda yake sai jingina da yayi da jikin bangon wajan yana lumshe idanuwansa.

***** A ‘bangaran su Baby ba haka Abla taje ta kira ta wai Mamy na kiranta , Hijab d’inta Baby ta saka ta sakko ‘kasan tana d’an wa’ka ’kasa ‘kasa abunta . Tana sakkowa ta tarar da babu Mamy , har zata nufi d’akinta sai kuma wuce na su d’akin , tuno a can tabar wayanta , tana shiga ta tu’be hijab d’inta tare da hawaye kan gado tana rufda ciki ,  dai dai lokacin da take ‘ko’karin kunna wayarta, bata san da shigowar mutum ba sai ji tayi an zauna a gefenta, a rud’e ta juyo, Sauban data gani a gefenta ne ya ‘kara tsoratar da ita , cikin sauri ta zabura zata mi’kewa ya ri’ko hannunta , hankad’ashi tayi ta zata saka güdü ya janyo baya tare da d’ora ta kan gadon, tana ‘kasa yana samanta gudun karta güdü, tsu’ke fuskarta Baby tayi “ Ni fa ba yar iska bace , kuma wallahi sai na fad’a ka shigo mana d’aki”, d’an waro idan sa yayi kad’an Jin abun tace  “ Mai yasa kika kashe wayar ki?” Ya fad’a yana kallanta , ‘bata fuska Baby tayi sosai , Nidai ka sake ni bana so.” Ta kuma fad’a murmushi yayi mata yana sakar mata nauyinsa , Baby kamar zatayi kuka ta furta “ wallahi kai da Allah, kasan dai ba kyau ko? Allah kuma ..” katseta yayi ta hanyar furta “ bakin ki baya shiru ko? ‘Dan murgud’a bakinta tayi kafun ta furta “ toh ka sake ni sai nayi shiru ko kuma na fad’awa su Mamy ka matseni “ murmushi yayi sosai akan face d’insa , kafun ya saka hannu ya fusgi towel d’inta , zatayi magana kuma ya had’e lips d’insu , a tsorace Baby ta soma zare ido ganin abunda bata ta’ba gani ba , wani irin futsarin tsoro ne taji yana ‘ko’karin sakko mata , bata gama rud’ewa ba saida taga ya saka hannunsa akan breast d’inta , da iya ragowar ‘karfin da yayi mata saura ta bige masa hannun tana kare ‘kirjinta , ganin ya’ki sakar mata le’be ta gantsara masa cizo, yana sakinta a guje ta shige toilet tare da saka lock , kwanta wa yayi akan bed d’in yana maida nunfashi, tsokanar ya so yi amma sai gashi ta barsa da aiki, dan lokaci d’aya ciwan mara ya saukar masa ,wani irin feelings na bu’katar tane ya soma masa yawo cikin jiki, da ‘kyar ya iya saita , amma duk da hakan bai fita sai ya nufi sai tin toilet d’in yadda zata jisa , “ ki kunna wayar ki, zamuyi magana anjima , if not abunda nayi yanzu wani daban zanyi anjima “ yadda yayi magana kamar wani d’an maye , a haka ya bar d’akin, ita kuma Baby saida ta ‘kara kusan 10 minutes a toilet tukunna ta re’ko zufa duk ta tarar mata a fuska , kamar zatayi kuka ta furta “ wallahi Abla ke da Allah tunda iskanci daman kika kawo ayi dani”,ita kad’ai sai mita take , tana ‘ko’karin d’aukar wayarta taji kamar har yanzu yana kissing d’inta, inda ya zauna ta soma harara kamar ance mata zata ganshi a wajan. 

Abla kuwa tana gidan Baby sai ta güdü d’akin Mamy tayi zaman ta gudun ma kar ta had’u dasu, ita kad’ai sai faman dariya take cikin zuciyarta.

****** A d’akin su Harry gabaki d’aya kusan jiya basuyi bacci ba shiyasa ko da aka kira meeting suka ‘ki zuwa tsabar ba’kin cikin da yake cin zuciyoyin su. Dadyn Harry sarai yana sane da abubuwan da suke , kallan su kawai yake kamar baisan sunayi ba , harta gyaran jikin da suka ‘ki tsayawa ayi wa Harryn duk ya sani, gobe kawai yake jira dan duk haukanta gobe sai ta tare a gidan mijinta .

Ana sallar magrib Abla ta koma d’akin da su Fanan suke , wani irin harara Baby da Eshaal suka soma yi mata , duk yadda taso ri’ke dariyar ta sai da ta ‘kwace mata , shiyasa ta şakasu a gaba sai faman dariya take , ‘kara ‘kuluwa Baby tayi ganin yadda take musu dariya, Eshaal ba a ‘kufule ta soma harararta, tsura musu idanuwa Arwa da Fanan sukai kafun su furta “ wai me akai musu? Tunda suka dawo sai faman kukkun bura suke su biyu” ‘kara kwashewa da dariya Abla tayi tana d’aga hannunta sama “ Nidai babu ruwana wallahi, kawai dai..” Eshaal ce ta tsayar da ita ta hanyar furta “ Kawai dai me?” Ido d’aya Abla ta kashe mata tana d’aga mata ido d’aya , d’auke idanta Eshaal tayi daga kanta ganin wayarta ta soma haske , “ My Love” shine abunda ya fito a cikin wayar, tsoran kalamansa da ya fad’a d’azu ne ya saka ta d’auki kiran, Daidai lokacin itama da Baby aka kira ta awaya , amma amaimakon ta d’aga kiran sai ta saka ta a silent , kallanta Abla tayi “ Mai yasa bazaki d’auka ba?” Share ta Baby tayi tana ‘kara tsuke fuskarta .  Shigowar Mamy ne ya hanata Abla furta abunda tayi niyar furtawa “ Kuna yin sallar isha’i kuje ku kwanta dan za’ayi ba’ki and gobe da wuri za’ayi muku henna da saloon kafun a tafi dinner okay ?” Fanan ce ta furta “ Dinner kuma Mamy? Ta mece ce ?” Katseta Mamy tayi “ idan goben tayi kin gani , kin dai ji abunda nace muku ko?” Da tom suka amsa mata gabaki d’ayan su. Abla tana idar da sallar isha’i ta güdü part d’inta gudun kar ya dawo bai sameta va . Suma kuma su Baby kamar yadda Mamy ta fad’a suna cin abinci suka wuce d’aki dan su kwanta . Baby harta kwanta cikin fingilalliyar rigar ta zata janyo wayar ta sai taga bata nan , d’an tsaki ta saki kad’an dan ta barta a gaban mirror a sama , kamar zata share sai kuma ta kasa , sanın cewa babu wanda zai shigo a irin wannan lokacin ta saka takalmi kawai tayi fitowar ta ‘kafarta duk a waje . Saman ta nufa, a gaban mirror d’in kuwa ta hango wayar ta , tana d’auka Sauban da tun d’azu yake part d’in ya shigo d’akin, ja baya Baby ta somayi shima yana matso ta “ mai ya hanaki d’aukar wayata ? Ba kyaji ko?” Hannunta Baby ta soma yar fawa tana kuma ja baya “ wai mene ne haka ne ?  Zan maka ihu Allah , gwanda ma ka fita “, tsayawa yayi jin abunda tace “ Ihun me zakiyi mun?” A tunaninta dan ta tsoratar dashi ya fita sai ta furta “ zakamun fyad’e”, d’an dariya Sauban yayi yana jinjina mata kai “ kwarai ma kuwa , dan abunda zanyi kenan , yau zan amshi budurcin ki, just wait and see “, Baby ganin yana nufota tayi saurin d’anewa kan gado, yazo zai kamata ta zille zata fita amma yayi saurin ri’kota , har yanzu kuma bakin bata ya ‘ki mutuwa “ Wayyo Allah , wallahi abunda kake zunubi kake yi kuma ba’a kar’ban sallan ka ,  kaji tsoran Allah wallahi..” ta fad’a shi kuma ya had’e lips d’in su , wani irin d’age hannunta Baby tayi a dole bazata ta’ba saba kar zunubinsa ya shafeta.

Uhm ? Girgiza masa kai tayi kamar ba ita ba har da du’kar da kai “ Ni fa ba haka nake nufi ba , kayi ha’kuri bazan sake ba kaji?” Yadda ta fad’a a sanyaye mutum sai ya d’auka da gasken take , matso ta ya somayi itama ta soma ja baya , fa fuskarta da ta marairaice masa gwanin ban tausayi “ okay fine . Am sorry , babu abunda zan miki, just don’t ignore my calls kinji?” Yanzu ma kanta ta jinjina masa , bai kuma ce mata komai ba ya nuna mata hanya “ Good night Angel”, kamar mara gaskiya sai ta soma takı , tana zuwa daf dashi kuma sai ta d’an ja baya duk a tunaninta kama ta zaiyi, sai da ta dam’ke wayarta sosai sannan ta wuce a guje, bai motsa daga inda take ba sai binta da kallo da yayi , tana zuwa bakin ‘kofar ta juyo tare da d’an murgud’a bakinta kad’an “ kuma Allah babu ruwa na da kai tunda so kake ka lalata ni”, tun kafun yace zaiyi wani yun ‘kuri kuma ta ruga a guje abunta.        BLACK SPIDERS 

A kwance take inda take kullum a d’aure ga sheda abunda suke ‘kulletan duk ya fito mata a hannu “ Ruwa ! Ruwa ! Ruwa !” Shine abunda take iya furta wa a sha’ke , ko hannuwanta bata iya motsawa balantana tayi magana da ‘karfi yadda zasu jitan “ Ruwa “ ta kuma fad’a lokacin da ‘yan ya tsun hannunta suke karkarwa . Turo ‘kofar wajan akai, mutumin da baza’a iya tantance ko wane ne ba ya shigo cikin wajan hannunsa d’auke da wani ‘karamun jug, yana zuwa daidai saitin fuskarta ya soma zuba mata ruwan, jikinta har rawa yake lokacin da take tana hannuwanta dan tasha ruwan, bai hanata ba har saida ya juye gabaki d’aya ruwan tukunna ya tsugunna ganin ta mayar da kanta inda take a kwance tana sakin ajiyar zuciya mai ‘karfi “ Shekara 22 da biyu kenan har yanzu bazaki sauke makaman ya’kin kiba ? Mai yasa taurin kanki yayi rawa Safreena ? Mai yasa ? Kina da taurin kai sosai , zuwa yanzu da kin bada had’in kai da duk wannan abun bai faru ba , da tuni kina nan kina mulkar duniya yadda kike so , amma kika za’bi ‘kas’kancin rayuwa sabida abu d’an ‘kalilan? Shiru Safreena tayi masa , sai ajiyar zuciya da take saukewa a hankali a hankali, hakan da tayi ba ‘karamun ‘kara tun zurashi yayi ba shiyasa ya fegar da jug d’in hannunsa ‘kasa , yadda ‘karan ya karad’e ko ina sai data d’an tsorata , bai kuma tanka mata ba yayi ficewarsa daga d’akin . Shekara 22 kenan , tun bayan zuwan ta yake da muradin cikin burukansa akanta amma ta’ki basa damar hakan , sau dubu idan zaiyi mata magana bazata ta’ba kula sa ba , hakan da take ba’karamun ta Fas’a masa zuciya yake ba. Shi kad’ai sai faman huci yake har yazama kan kujera, d’aya daga cikin giyar da suke kan table ya d’aura , abun murfinta kawai ya cire ya soma tuttulawa kansa a cikinsa ba tare da damuwa da d’aukar cup ba . 
    Yana fita ta d’an d’ago da fuskarta zuwa hanyar da ya fita , kafun ta mayar da kanta ‘kasa tana lumshe idanuwanta, abubuwa da yawa na mata yawo cikin ‘kasan zuciyarta.

**
Baby kuwa tana komawa d’aki ta tarar da sun kashe fitila alamar sun soma bacci , ajiyar zuciya ta sauke mai ‘karfi “ ‘Dan iska kawai” ta fad’a a hankali , a maimakon ta kwanta baccin kamar su Fanan sai ta samu waje ta zauna a gefen bed d’in, babu abunda yake mata yawo cikin zuciya sai abunda Sauban yayi mata, gashi ita har ga Allah take san sani idan dagasken shid’an iska ne, dan bai ta’ba yi mata irin wannan abun ba sai yau, wani gefe na zuciyarta kuma yana raya mata haka kalar tasa soyayyar take. Ganin kanta na ‘ko’karin yi mata ciwo ta kwanta kawai tare da lullu’be har kanta da duvet, ita kad’ai sai faman mutsu mutsu take tanasan bacci ya d’auketa amma hakan ya gagara sabida tunanin da ta sakawa zuciyarta, da ‘kyar bacci ‘barawo ya sace ta a yadda ta kulle fuskarta .

*****
Cikin d’akin da kullum baya barin sa da haske yake zaune , cikin tsakiyar wasu candles jajaye da gabaki d’aya suka zagaye sa, sai hasken wutar su da take d’auke da kalar ja. Daga gefensa sa kuma ‘yar tsanar da ya caccakawa allurai ne , shi kad’ai sai faman jan carbi yake yana motsa bakinsa da babu wanda zai fuskanci mai yake furtawa ba , duk jar car’bi idan yayi sai ya dakata , sai ya gama motsi da bakinsa tukunna zai cire allura d’aya daga cikin ‘yar tsanar ya cakawa candle d’in, da haka ya cigaba da sossoke alluran har saida ya gama zare su gabaki d’aya daga jikin ‘yar tsanar tukunna ya d’auko wani ba’kin gari da mutum bazai yi saurin fahimtar ko mene ne ba ya d’urawa ‘yar tsanar a baki sannan ya samu allura ya d’inki bakin. Yana gama wa ya soma wani irin dariya mai cike da zallan mugunta da rashin imani , shi kad’an yasan mai yake ‘kullawa cikin ‘kasan zuciyar sa . Yana gamawa kamar wani matsafi ya tafa hannunsa sau biyu sai duka candle d’in suka ‘bace a lokaci d’aya , d’akin yayi duhu sosai yanda ko tafin hannunsa bazaka iya gani ba , sai motsin takun tafiyarsa.

WASHE GARI 

 Kamar yadda su Mamy suka sanar da su, suna idar da sallar asuba bayan sunyi abubuwan da suke bu’kata a ka ci gaba da gyara su , dan da wuri su Ammi suke san kammala komai yau, harta saloon da ‘kunshin da za’a yi musu.

Jin gina tayi da jikin ‘kofar d’akin tana tunanin maganganun Dady. “ ina ne inda zamuje? Kodai shopping zamuje? Wayyo Allah na” tana cikin za’kuwa dan gabaki d’aya tunaninta yafi bata shopping zasu je, bata tsaya ‘bata wa kanta lokaci ba ta soma har gıtsa kayanta, sai da ta gama za’bar duk abunda take bu’kata tukunna ta koma kan gadon, gudun karta manta fitar da zasuyi sai ta saita lokaci a cikin wayarta mai had’e da reminder.

***** Su Abla tun wajan ‘karfe 9 take sashin Mamy dan da kanta Mamy taje ta d’auko ta sabida saloon da za’ayi mata da ‘kunshi.

Nima da zaki tajen so nake” , kallan side d’in su Baby tayi ita da Fanan ko wannan su ya d’aure fuskarta, d’an dariya tayi kad’an kafun ta furta “ Wai mene ne sai faman d’aure fuska kuke ? Ni mene ne laifi na a ciki?uhm?” ‘Dan sauta fuskarta Eshaal tayi “ amma kema ai tun farko sai ki fad’a mana gaskiya, kawai… kawai” sai kuma tayi shiru dan bazata iya fad’an abunda yayi mata ba”, tsura mata ido Abla tayi itama “ Kawai me ? Wallahi tun wuri ku yiwa kanku karatun ta natsu, ah toh , nidai azo a tajen gashi in ba haka ba gabaki d’aya na har gitsaku dan wallahi Simba zan saka a kawo mun har cikin d’akin nan, kuma ku musu kuga cika aiki, kar ku ganku amare , ba ruwan Sunshine d’ina” ta ‘karasa tana d'an musu farı da idanuwa”, hararar ta Baby tayi “ wallahi ki dunga jin tsoran Allah Abla , dan kin san muna tsoran mijin ki shine zaki dunga mana bata Zana ? Matar soja ? Mun tuba mun miki biyayya”, gira Abla ta d’aga mata , zatayi magana taji cikinta ya motsa , cikin sauri ta saka hannu a cikin, a tunanin su cikinta ne yake mata ciwo sai gabaki d’aya sukayo kanta “ Mene ne ? Cikin kine yake miki ciwo? Mu kira miki su Ammi?” Shine tanbayoyin da suke mata a rud’e, girgiza musu kanta tayi “ Lapiya ta ‘kalau fa , d’an cikina ne Kawai naji yayi motsi” inda ta saka hannu a wajan Eshaal itama ta d’ora nata hannun, “ a nan wajan?” Kanta Abla ta jinjina mata , kafun Eshaal tayi wani yun’kuri cikin ya ‘kara motsawa , wani irin ihu Eshaal tayi tana d’anewa kan gado dan ya bata tsoro yadda ya harba d’in, fuskarta cike da tsoro ta furta “ ke hakan baya baki tsoro?” Kallanta Baby tayi “ Babyn ne ya motsa wai? Ni ban fahimta ba “, kanta Eshaal ta jinjina mata , ganin yadda Baby ta saka duka hannayenta akan cikin Abla ta kuma ja baya , kusan second 10 cikin bai motsaba , zare hannayen su Abla tayi “Bazai motsa ba ai , sabida ihun da Eshaal tayi , may be kuma sai zuwa anjima”, ‘bata fuska Baby tayi dan dagaske so take taji cikin yayi motsi.

Har zuwa wannan lokaci Yasmeen da Harry basu wajan ba . 
      
      Abla aka soma yiwa ‘kunshin, kasan tuwar ja da ba’ki za’ayi musu dukan su, ana gamai mata aka soma yiwa Arwa , abun gwanin burgewa , harta masu ‘kunshin ganin yadda suke labarin su hankali kwance sai suma suka saki jikin su , da farko sun d’an soma d’arı d’ari gudun kar suyi musu wula’kanci , har lokacin da suka gama yi musu red henna basu dena mamakin sau’kin kan su ba . Ana gamawa lokacin na Abla yayi kusan 2 hours shima aka soma cire mata bata lallan, yadda take fara sosai haka lallan da akai mata yayi matu’kar yi wa fararta kyau , su kansu masu ‘kunshin yawa yadda yayi kyau suke, ga shi kwata kwata babu ta inda ‘kunshin ya lallace , ita kad’ai sai faman murmushi take tana ‘kara bin hannunta da ‘kafarta da kallo, sunyi bala’in yi mata kyau kamar Itace amaryar, ana gamawa bata bari anyi mata ba’ki saida tayi sallar la’asar tukunna , lokacin tayi alwala ‘kunshin ya ‘kara fitowa ba kad’an ba . A daidai time da za’a fara mata black henna itama Arwa aka cire mata nata , sosai kunshinta ya fito itama , kamar yadda Abla tayi sallah itama sallar taje yi, ita kuma Abla ana tsantsara mata ‘kunshinta .
